linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. “ប្រពៃណីព្យាបាលជំងឺរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ” corresponds well to “Truyền thống chữa bệnh của người Khmer,” with the addition of “ជំងឺ” making the object of healing explicit but not altering the meaning. “នៅតែមានមកដល់សព្វថ្ងៃ” naturally expresses “vẫn còn hiện hữu.” “ជាពិសេសចំពោះអ្នកចាស់អ្នកទុំ” correctly conveys “đặc biệt với người lớn tuổi.” The final clause “ព្រោះពួកគាត់ជឿលើការផ្សំគ្នារវាងធម្មជាតិ និងជំនឿផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ” faithfully renders the idea of belief in a combination of nature and spirituality. The phrase “ជំនឿផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ” slightly explicates “tâm linh” as spiritual belief, but this is semantically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun choice is pragmatically appropriate. The source uses the neutral Vietnamese pronoun “họ,” referring to older people. The hypothesis uses “ពួកគាត់,” which is respectful and natural when referring to elders. “អ្នកចាស់អ្នកទុំ” is also a culturally appropriate Khmer expression for older/respected people, matching the social context well.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliterations or hallucinated lexical items are present. The vocabulary used is legitimate Khmer: “ប្រពៃណី,” “ព្យាបាលជំងឺ,” “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ,” “អ្នកចាស់អ្នកទុំ,” “ធម្មជាតិ,” and “ជំនឿផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ” are all valid and contextually appropriate. The provided localized dictionary context does not introduce any relevant competing regional term that would affect this evaluation.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. Clause ordering mirrors the source while remaining idiomatic. The causal connector “ព្រោះ” is appropriate, and the structure “ជឿលើការផ្សំគ្នារវាង X និង Y” is syntactically correct and fluent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality translation that preserves the meaning, uses respectful and contextually appropriate pronouns for older people, contains legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and reads fluently. Minor explicitation such as “ជំងឺ” and “ជំនឿផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ” does not reduce fidelity and may even improve clarity.

per_sample.text: Tôi được nghe rằng có hình thức thổi và niệm chú trong chữa bệnh, anh có thể giải thích chi tiết hơn không?
label: ខ្ញុំបានឮថាមានទម្រង់នៃការផ្លុំ និងសូត្រមន្តគាថា ក្នុងការព្យាបាល តើបងអាចពន្យល់លម្អិតបន្ថែមបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំបានឮគេថា ក្នុងការព្យាបាលជំងឺ មានរបៀបផ្លុំ និងសូត្រមន្ត បងអាចពន្យល់ឲ្យលម្អិតជាងនេះបានអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi nghe nói trong việc chữa bệnh có hình thức thổi và tụng thần chú. Anh/chị có thể giải thích chi tiết thêm được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the source meaning: “Tôi được nghe rằng” is rendered as “ខ្ញុំបានឮគេថា,” meaning “I heard people say/it is said,” which is semantically natural. “Trong chữa bệnh” is rendered as “ក្នុងការព្យាបាលជំងឺ,” adding “ជំងឺ” but this is fully consistent with “chữa bệnh.” “Có hình thức thổi và niệm chú” becomes “មានរបៀបផ្លុំ និងសូត្រមន្ត,” which conveys the same idea of a healing practice involving blowing and chanting/reciting spells or mantras. The request for further explanation is also preserved. No important information is lost.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The Vietnamese pronoun “anh” is appropriately rendered as “បង,” a natural Khmer kinship/pragmatic term for an older male or respectful familiar addressee. The use of “បងអាច...” is socially appropriate and matches the interpersonal tone of the source. The ending “បានអត់?” is slightly more colloquial than the reference “បានទេ?” but remains natural and pragmatically acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. “របៀប,” “ផ្លុំ,” “សូត្រមន្ត,” “ព្យាបាលជំងឺ,” and “លម្អិត” are valid and contextually appropriate. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional issue, and nothing in the hypothesis requires penalization on Khmer Krom lexical grounds.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer: “ខ្ញុំបានឮគេថា ក្នុងការព្យាបាលជំងឺ មានរបៀបផ្លុំ និងសូត្រមន្ត...” has clear topical structure and natural word order. The second clause “បងអាចពន្យល់ឲ្យលម្អិតជាងនេះបានអត់?” is fluent and idiomatic. The only minor stylistic difference is that it is somewhat conversational, but this does not harm grammaticality or meaning.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, fluent, and pragmatically suitable. It preserves the source’s informational content and uses natural Khmer phrasing. Minor differences such as using “របៀប” instead of a more formal equivalent for “hình thức,” and the colloquial question ending “បានអត់,” are acceptable and do not reduce comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Khi bệnh nhân đau đầu hay sốt nhẹ, thầy mo thường thổi hơi và niệm chú để truyền năng lượng tích cực, xua đuổi tà khí.
label: នៅពេលដែលអ្នកជំងឺឈឺក្បាល ឬក្តៅខ្លួនតិចតួច គ្រូសូត្រមន្ត តែងតែផ្លុំខ្យល់ និងសូត្រគាថាដើម្បីបញ្ជូនថាមពលវិជ្ជមាន បណ្តេញអំពើអាក្រក់ចេញ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពេលអ្នកជំងឺឈឺក្បាល ឬក្តៅខ្លួនស្រាលៗ គ្រូមន្តតែងផ្លុំខ្យល់ ហើយសូត្រមន្ត ដើម្បីផ្ទេរកម្លាំងល្អ បណ្តេញខ្យល់អាក្រក់ចេញ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Khi người bệnh bị đau đầu hoặc sốt nhẹ, thầy tụng chú thường thổi hơi và đọc thần chú để truyền năng lượng tích cực, xua đuổi tà khí.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source: when the patient has a headache or mild fever, the ritual practitioner blows air/breath and chants spells in order to transfer beneficial force and expel harmful influence. "ក្តៅខ្លួនស្រាលៗ" accurately conveys mild fever, and "ផ្លុំខ្យល់ ហើយសូត្រមន្ត" matches blowing and chanting. Minor nuance loss occurs in "ផ្ទេរកម្លាំងល្អ" for "truyền năng lượng tích cực"; it means 'transfer good strength' rather than the more precise 'positive energy.' "បណ្តេញខ្យល់អាក្រក់" renders "tà khí" as 'bad/evil air,' which is semantically close, though slightly narrower than evil spiritual force.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns. "អ្នកជំងឺ" is appropriate for 'patient.' "គ្រូមន្ត" is an acceptable way to refer to a ritual/spell practitioner, though the reference's "គ្រូសូត្រមន្ត" is somewhat more explicit for someone who chants incantations. No social hierarchy or honorific mismatch is introduced.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary rather than false phonetic transliteration. Terms such as "ឈឺក្បាល," "ក្តៅខ្លួន," "ផ្លុំខ្យល់," "សូត្រមន្ត," "កម្លាំងល្អ," and "បណ្តេញ" are valid. The localized dictionary context includes related regional items such as meanings for 'hơi' and 'xua đuổi,' but the hypothesis relies on standard Khmer expressions and does not introduce suspicious fabricated forms.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The temporal clause "ពេលអ្នកជំងឺ..." is concise and acceptable. The sequence of actions with "តែងផ្លុំខ្យល់ ហើយសូត្រមន្ត" is clear, and the purposive phrase "ដើម្បី..." is correctly structured. Word order and clause linking are natural.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is strong and understandable, with accurate event structure and natural Khmer phrasing. The main limitations are minor semantic nuance differences: 'positive energy' becomes 'good strength,' and 'evil qi/tà khí' becomes 'bad air.' These do not seriously distort the meaning, but they are slightly less precise than the reference.

per_sample.text: Nhiều người ngoài cộng đồng có thể nghi ngờ cách này, vậy theo anh, giá trị tinh thần có quan trọng không?

per_sample.text: Ngoài ra, bùa hộ mệnh cũng thường thấy trong văn hóa Khmer, anh có thể kể thêm công dụng của nó?

label: មានតែ គ្រូសូត្រមន្ត ឬព្រះសង្ឃដែលមានបទពិសោធន៍ប៉ុណ្ណោះ ទើបអាចធ្វើបន្តោងបាន ពិធីនេះតែងតែរួមបញ្ចូលការសូត្រធម៌ ផ្លុំគាថា និងការបួងសួង។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មានតែលោកគ្រូមន្តអាគម ឬលោកសង្ឃដែលមានបទពិសោធន៍ទេ ទើបអាចធ្វើយ័ន្តបួបាន ពិធីធម្មតាមានសូត្រធម៌ ផ្លុំមន្ត និងបួងសួង។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chỉ những thầy tụng chú hoặc các vị sư có kinh nghiệm mới có thể làm bùa đeo; nghi lễ này thường bao gồm tụng kinh, thổi chú và cầu nguyện.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the core message reasonably: only experienced ritual specialists or monks can make a charm/amulet, and the ritual involves chanting, blowing incantations, and praying. However, “លោកគ្រូមន្តអាគម” is somewhat broader and less culturally specific than “thầy mo,” and “ធ្វើយ័ន្តបួ” is problematic because it mixes a valid Khmer term “យ័ន្ត” with an apparent Vietnamese-based form “បួ.” The phrase “ពិធីធម្មតាមាន...” conveys the idea of a usual ritual, but is less precise than “the ritual usually includes.” Overall meaning is mostly recoverable with some lexical inaccuracy.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “លោកគ្រូ” for a ritual/magic teacher is pragmatically acceptable, though not as precise as “គ្រូសូត្រមន្ត” or a more culturally marked equivalent. “លោកសង្ឃ” is understandable for monks but less respectful/formal than the more standard “ព្រះសង្ឃ.” The social hierarchy and honorific usage are not seriously wrong, but they are slightly less natural and less aligned with religious register.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most lexical items are legitimate Khmer: “មន្តអាគម,” “សង្ឃ,” “សូត្រធម៌,” “ផ្លុំមន្ត,” and “បួងសួង” are recognizable and semantically relevant. However, “បួ” in “យ័ន្តបួ” appears to be a false transliteration or direct carryover from Vietnamese “bùa,” and it is not supported by the provided localized dictionary context. “យ័ន្ត” itself can refer to a yantra/charm, but the compound “យ័ន្តបួ” is unnatural and raises a lexical legitimacy concern.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. The construction “មានតែ...ដែលមានបទពិសោធន៍ទេ ទើប...” is acceptable, though “ប៉ុណ្ណោះ” would be more polished. “ពិធីធម្មតាមាន...” is slightly awkward compared with a more natural phrasing such as “ពិធីនេះជាធម្មតារួមមាន...” or “តែងតែរួមបញ្ចូល...” Still, the clause order is coherent and the overall flow is readable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is mostly understandable and conveys the main proposition of the source, but it contains a notable lexical problem with “បួ,” likely a false Vietnamese transliteration, and some register/naturalness issues in the treatment of monks and ritual terminology. It is a fair-to-good translation, with the main weakness being lexical precision around “bùa.”

per_sample.text: Tôi cũng tò mò về khái niệm cân bằng năng lượng mà nhiều nền y học cổ truyền hay nhắc đến, trong Khmer thì thế nào?
label: ខ្ញុំក៏ចង់ដឹងអំពីគំនិតនៃលំនឹងថាមពលដែលឱសថបុរាណជាច្រើនតែងតែនិយាយដល់ដែរ តើចំពោះជនជាតិខ្មែរវិញយ៉ាងណា?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំក៏ឆ្ងល់អំពីគំនិត “សមតុល្យថាមពល” ដែលវេជ្ជសាស្ត្របុរាណជាច្រើនតែងនិយាយដល់ ក្នុងភាសាខ្មែរ គេថាម៉េចដែរ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi cũng muốn biết về khái niệm cân bằng năng lượng mà nhiều nền y học cổ truyền thường nhắc đến; đối với người Khmer thì như thế nào?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main meaning of the Vietnamese source. “ខ្ញុំក៏ឆ្ងល់” conveys “Tôi cũng tò mò,” “គំនិត ‘សមតុល្យថាមពល’” correctly renders “khái niệm cân bằng năng lượng,” and “វេជ្ជសាស្ត្របុរាណជាច្រើនតែងនិយាយដល់” faithfully expresses “nhiều nền y học cổ truyền hay nhắc đến.” The final clause “ក្នុងភាសាខ្មែរ គេថាម៉េចដែរ?” is a natural rendering of asking how the concept is expressed in Khmer. No substantive information is lost or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The first-person pronoun “ខ្ញុំ” is appropriate and neutral for the Vietnamese “Tôi.” The impersonal “គេ” in “គេថាម៉េចដែរ?” is pragmatically natural in Khmer for asking how something is said or called. There are no issues involving inappropriate honorifics, kinship terms, or social hierarchy.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The key lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. “គំនិត” is confirmed by the localized dictionary context as meaning idea/concept. “សមតុល្យថាមពល” is a valid Khmer calque for “energy balance,” and “វេជ្ជសាស្ត្របុរាណ” is standard for traditional medicine/medical science. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or hallucinated Khmer forms.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally. The word order is idiomatic: subject + stance verb + topic phrase + relative clause + final question. The phrasing “ក្នុងភាសាខ្មែរ គេថាម៉េចដែរ?” is colloquial but acceptable and natural. Punctuation and quotation marks around the term also help clarify the concept being asked about.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation hypothesis is highly accurate, fluent, and lexically legitimate. It preserves the semantic content of the source and uses appropriate Khmer phrasing. Minor stylistic differences from the human reference, such as using “សមតុល្យថាមពល” instead of “លំនឹងថាមពល,” are acceptable and do not affect meaning.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer tin cơ thể con người có luồng khí nội tại, nếu mất cân bằng sẽ sinh bệnh, nên cần hài hòa giữa thân, tâm, môi trường.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរជឿថា រាងកាយមនុស្សមានចរន្តខ្យល់ ខាងក្នុង បើបាត់បង់លំនឹងវានឹងបង្កជាជំងឺ ដូច្នេះត្រូវមានភាពចុះសម្រុងគ្នារវាង កាយ ចិត្ត និងបរិស្ថាន។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរជឿថា ខ្លួនមនុស្សមានខ្យល់នៅខាងក្នុង បើខ្យល់នោះមិនស្មើគ្នា នឹងកើតជំងឺ ហេតុនេះត្រូវធ្វើឲ្យសមស្របគ្នារវាងខ្លួន ចិត្ត និងបរិស្ថានជុំវិញ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer tin rằng trong cơ thể con người có các luồng khí bên trong; nếu mất cân bằng thì sẽ gây bệnh. Vì vậy, cần có sự hài hòa giữa cơ thể, tinh thần và môi trường.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the source: Khmer people believe the human body has internal air/energy, imbalance leads to illness, and harmony is needed among body, mind, and environment. The phrase “ខ្យល់នៅខាងក្នុង” captures “luồng khí nội tại” reasonably, though it omits the nuance of “luồng/ចរន្ត” as a flow or current. “មិនស្មើគ្នា” is an acceptable rendering of imbalance, though slightly less technical than “បាត់បង់លំនឹង.” Overall informational fidelity is strong with only minor nuance loss.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject “អ្នកខ្មែរ” is pragmatically acceptable for “Người Khmer,” though “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ” would be more formal and closer to the reference. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, honorifics, or hierarchy mismatches. “ខ្លួនមនុស្ស” is understandable as the human body, although “រាងកាយមនុស្ស” would be more precise.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary used is legitimate Khmer and does not show signs of false transliteration or hallucinated lexical forms. Terms such as “ខ្យល់,” “ខាងក្នុង,” “សមស្របគ្នា,” “ចិត្ត,” and “បរិស្ថានជុំវិញ” are valid and contextually appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional term requiring correction; no unusual Khmer Krom-specific item is misused.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally. The conditional structure “បើ... នឹង...” is clear, and the causal connector “ហេតុនេះ” is appropriate. “ត្រូវធ្វើឲ្យសមស្របគ្នារវាង...” is understandable, though slightly less idiomatic than “ត្រូវមានភាពចុះសម្រុងគ្នារវាង...” because harmony among body, mind, and environment is more naturally expressed as a state rather than something actively made. Overall syntax is fluent with minor stylistic issues.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is a good and mostly faithful rendering of the Vietnamese source. It preserves all core concepts: Khmer belief, internal bodily air/energy, imbalance causing illness, and the need for harmony among body, mind, and environment. Minor reductions in precision occur with “luồng khí nội tại” translated simply as internal air and with “mất cân bằng” rendered as “not equal.” Lexis is legitimate, grammar is smooth, and there are no major pragmatic issues.

per_sample.text: Vậy họ làm thế nào để duy trì sự cân bằng đó trong sinh hoạt hàng ngày?
label: តើពួកគេធ្វើដូចម្តេចដើម្បីរក្សាលំនឹងនោះក្នុងជីវភាពរស់នៅប្រចាំថ្ងៃ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ៊ីចឹង ពួកគាត់ធ្វើម៉េច ដើម្បីរក្សាសមតុល្យនោះក្នុងការរស់នៅប្រចាំង៉ៃ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Họ làm thế nào để duy trì sự cân bằng đó trong đời sống hằng ngày?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the main meaning accurately: “So/how do they maintain that balance in daily life?” “អ៊ីចឹង” corresponds well to Vietnamese “Vậy,” “ធ្វើម៉េច” conveys “làm thế nào,” and “ដើម្បីរក្សាសមតុល្យនោះ” correctly conveys “để duy trì sự cân bằng đó.” The phrase “ក្នុងការរស់នៅ” captures the general idea of “trong sinh hoạt,” though it is slightly less specific than “ជីវភាពរស់នៅ” or “សinh hoạt/life activities.” The final phrase “ប្រចាំង៉ៃ” is intended to mean “daily/every day,” but it is orthographically nonstandard compared with standard “ប្រចាំថ្ងៃ.” Meaning remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “ពួកគាត់” for Vietnamese “họ” is pragmatically acceptable. It is slightly more respectful/polite than neutral “ពួកគេ,” but this does not distort the social relation or subject reference. No inappropriate honorific or kinship mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most lexical choices are legitimate Khmer: “អ៊ីចឹង,” “ធ្វើម៉េច,” “រក្សា,” “សមតុល្យ,” and “ការរស់នៅ” are recognizable and semantically appropriate. “សមតុល្យ” is a valid Khmer term for balance/equilibrium, though the reference uses “លំនឹង.” The unusual form “ប្រចាំង៉ៃ” appears to be a colloquial/phonetic rendering intended for “ប្រចាំថ្ងៃ.” It is not supported by the provided localized dictionary context and is not standard orthography, but it is not a full hallucination because the intended meaning is recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure is natural and understandable: topic marker “អ៊ីចឹង,” subject “ពួកគាត់,” question phrase “ធ្វើម៉េច,” purpose clause “ដើម្បីរក្សា…,” and locative phrase “ក្នុងការរស់នៅ…” are arranged fluently. The register is somewhat colloquial due to “អ៊ីចឹង” and “ធ្វើម៉េច,” while the reference is slightly more formal. The main syntactic weakness is the nonstandard final spelling “ប្រចាំង៉ៃ,” which affects polish but not overall comprehensibility.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation with accurate meaning and acceptable pronoun use. It is slightly more colloquial than the reference and contains a nonstandard spelling/phonetic form for “daily,” but the sentence remains clear, grammatical, and lexically mostly legitimate.

per_sample.text: Họ thường dùng thảo mộc, xông lá, kết hợp thiền định, tụng kinh và giữ lối sống giản dị, tránh căng thẳng quá mức.
label: ពួកគេតែងតែប្រើឱសថរុក្ខជាតិ ការស្អំស្លឹកឈើ ផ្សំជាមួយការធ្វើសមាធិ ការសូត្រធម៌ និងរក្សាការរស់នៅសាមញ្ញ ជៀសវាងភាពតានតឹងខ្លាំងពេក។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពួកគាត់តែងប្រើស្មៅថ្នាំ អប់ស្លឹកថ្នាំ ផ្សំជាមួយអង្គុយសមាធិ សូត្រធម៌ ហើយរក្សារបៀបរស់នៅសាមញ្ញ ជៀសវាងការតានតឹងហួសកម្រិត។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Họ thường dùng thuốc thảo dược, chườm lá cây, kết hợp với thiền định, tụng kinh và duy trì lối sống giản dị, tránh căng thẳng quá mức.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the full meaning of the Vietnamese source. “ប្រើស្មៅថ្នាំ” conveys using medicinal herbs; “អប់ស្លឹកថ្នាំ” appropriately expresses steaming/fumigating with medicinal leaves; “អង្គុយសមាធិ” captures meditation; “សូត្រធម៌” correctly renders chanting scripture/religious texts; and the final clause about maintaining a simple lifestyle and avoiding excessive stress is faithfully translated as “រក្សារបៀបរស់នៅសាមញ្ញ ជៀសវាងការតានតឹងហួសកម្រិត.” No major informational loss or distortion is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject “ពួកគាត់” is pragmatically acceptable for Vietnamese “Họ.” It is slightly more respectful or human-centered than the neutral “ពួកគេ,” but this does not create a mismatch. There are no problematic honorifics or inappropriate kinship terms.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary rather than false phonetic copying. Terms such as “ស្មៅថ្នាំ,” “អប់,” “សមាធិ,” “សូត្រធម៌,” “របៀបរស់នៅ,” and “តានតឹង” are valid and contextually appropriate. The localized dictionary entries do not indicate any issue with these forms, and no hallucinated regional term appears.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and natural in Khmer. The coordination of activities is clear, and the sequence mirrors the source well. “ផ្សំជាមួយអង្គុយសមាធិ សូត្រធម៌” is understandable and natural enough, though slightly less nominalized than the reference’s “ការធ្វើសមាធិ ការសូត្រធម៌.” Overall grammar and word order are strong.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with accurate semantic transfer, appropriate pronoun use, legitimate vocabulary, and natural Khmer syntax. Minor stylistic differences from the reference do not affect meaning or acceptability.

per_sample.text: Trong xã hội hiện đại, nhiều người Khmer có còn tin vào những phương pháp này không?
label: ក្នុងសង្គមសម័យទំនើប តើជនជាតិខ្មែរជាច្រើននៅតែជឿលើវិធីសាស្រ្តទាំងនេះទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្នុងសង្គមសម័យថ្មីឥឡូវ មានខ្មែរច្រើននៅតែជឿលើវិធីទាំងនេះអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trong xã hội hiện đại, liệu nhiều người Khmer vẫn còn tin vào những phương pháp này không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: asking whether many Khmer people still believe in these methods in modern society. "ក្នុងសង្គមសម័យថ្មីឥឡូវ" corresponds to "trong xã hội hiện đại," though it is slightly redundant because both "សម័យថ្មី" and "ឥឡូវ" point to modern/current time. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns or hierarchical kinship terms in the source or hypothesis. per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Giới trẻ không thường xuyên sử dụng lắm, nhưng họ vẫn trân trọng và xem đó là biểu tượng của bản sắc văn hóa, gắn liền với ký ức của cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the meaning of the Vietnamese source. 'Người trẻ' is rendered as 'ក្មេងៗ', which is acceptable for 'young people' in this context. 'Ít sử dụng thường xuyên' is conveyed as 'មិនសូវប្រើវាជាប្រចាំទេ', meaning they do not use it regularly/often. The contrastive clause 'but they still value it and consider it part of cultural identity' is faithfully rendered as 'ប៉ុន្តែពួកគេនៅតែឲ្យតម្លៃ ចាត់ទុកវាជាផ្នែកមួយនៃអត្តសញ្ញាណវប្បធម៌'. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject 'ពួកគេ' appropriately corresponds to 'họ' in the source. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated forms. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic regional lexical conflict here.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure follows a clear contrastive pattern with 'ប៉ុន្តែ'. The relative clause 'ដែលភ្ជាប់ជាមួយការចងចាំរបស់សហគមន៍' is syntactically appropriate. A slightly more explicit object after 'ឲ្យតម្លៃ' could be possible, but the meaning is recoverable and natural in context because 'វា' appears in the following phrase.

It preserves the informational content of the source and uses appropriate pronouns and syntax. per_sample.text: Nó không chỉ chữa bệnh mà còn nuôi dưỡng tinh thần, kết nối con người với thiên nhiên, tổ tiên và sự khiêm nhường trong đời sống.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: it states that the subject not only treats disease but also nurtures the inner life, connects people with nature, ancestors, and humility in life. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation. It preserves the main informational content and reads naturally in Khmer. Minor semantic nuance exists in translating 'tinh thần' as 'ទឹកចិត្ត' rather than the more direct 'ស្មារតី', but the intended meaning remains understandable and culturally coherent. Pronoun use, lexical legitimacy, and grammar are excellent.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: asking whether the addressee can share about morning activities in Khmer community life. The rendering of “chia sẻ” as “ចែករំលែក” is semantically accurate. “hoạt động buổi sáng” is correctly translated as “សកម្មភាពពេលព្រឹក.” The main nuance shift is “đặc trưng” meaning characteristic/distinctive, rendered as “ដែលជាទម្លាប់,” meaning habitual/customary. This is close but slightly narrows the sense from culturally characteristic to routine or habitual. “đời sống cộng đồng Khmer” is rendered as “ជីវភាពសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ,” which is understandable, though “ជីវិតសហគមន៍” would align more closely with the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun “Anh” is appropriately rendered as “បង,” a natural Khmer second-person kinship term for an older male or respectful/familiar addressee. This matches the pragmatic tone of the source and the human reference. The question ending “បានអត់?” is colloquial but acceptable and natural in spoken Khmer/Khmer Krom communicative style.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: “បង,” “អាច,” “ចែករំលែក,” “សកម្មភាព,” “ពេលព្រឹក,” “ទម្លាប់,” “ជីវភាព,” “សហគមន៍,” and “ខ្មែរ” are all valid. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and mostly natural: “បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពី...បានអត់?” forms a valid question. The relative clause “ដែលជាទម្លាប់” is also structurally acceptable. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is good overall, with accurate core meaning, appropriate pronoun use, legitimate vocabulary, and fluent syntax. Minor semantic and stylistic issues arise from translating “đặc trưng” as “ទម្លាប់” and using “ជីវភាព” where “ជីវិត” may be closer to the source. These are not severe and do not obstruct understanding.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: morning time, monks and adults usually teach Khmer letters/script to children at the pagoda, while transmitting knowledge and preserving the national/ethnic Khmer language. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated forms. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting or necessary alternative for the words used here. Terms such as “លោកសង្ឃ,” “មនុស្សធំ,” “អក្សរខ្មែរ,” “ផ្ទេរចំណេះដឹង,” and “រក្សាភាសាជាតិខ្មែរ” are valid and semantically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent in Khmer. Word order is natural: temporal phrase, subject, habitual verb phrase, location, then paired purpose/result clauses with “ផង ... ផង.” The construction is clear and idiomatic. Minor stylistic differences from the reference, such as “ផ្ទេរ” instead of “ផ្ដល់,” do not reduce grammatical quality.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong, natural Khmer translation of the Vietnamese source. It preserves all core information, uses appropriate social and religious terminology, avoids fake lexical items, and maintains fluent Khmer syntax. per_sample.text: Ngoài việc học chữ, buổi sáng gia đình thường bận rộn với những công việc gì?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. per_sample.text: Tôi cũng nghe nói có nghi lễ tắm nước thơm, nó thường diễn ra vào buổi sáng phải không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main meaning: the speaker has also heard that there is a scented-water bathing ritual and asks whether it usually happens in the morning. “ខ្ញុំក៏ឮគេនិយាយថា” accurately conveys “Tôi cũng nghe nói,” and “វាច្រើនធ្វើនៅពេលព្រឹក” conveys the habitual morning timing. The main semantic weakness is that “ពិធីស្រង់ទឹកអប់” is less explicit than the reference “ពិធីស្រង់ព្រះដោយទឹកអប់,” which specifies bathing the sacred/Buddha image with scented water. The hypothesis may be read as ‘a ritual of bathing scented water/perfume,’ slightly less precise, but the overall intended meaning remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The first-person pronoun “ខ្ញុំ” is appropriate and neutral. The expression “ឮគេនិយាយថា” is a natural Khmer equivalent of Vietnamese “nghe nói.” The final tag question “មែនអត់?” is colloquial but pragmatically acceptable for “phải không?” in an informal conversational context. No inappropriate hierarchy or kinship term is introduced.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary used is legitimate Khmer, not false transliteration. “ទឹកអប់” is standard for perfume/scented water, and “ស្រង់” is an appropriate verb in ritual/religious bathing contexts, though the phrase would be more precise with an object such as “ព្រះ.” The localized dictionary notes “ក្រអូប” as ‘thơm,’ but the hypothesis’s “ទឹកអប់” is still a valid lexical choice for fragrant/perfumed water. No hallucinated or fake lexical items are detected.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and flows naturally overall. “វាច្រើនធ្វើនៅពេលព្រឹក” is slightly less formal and less elegant than “វាច្រើនតែប្រព្រឹត្តទៅនៅពេលព្រឹក,” but it remains clear. The phrase “ពិធីស្រង់ទឹកអប់” is somewhat compressed and could be syntactically/semantically clearer as “ពិធីស្រង់ព្រះដោយទឹកអប់” or similar. Still, the structure is coherent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation with the core meaning intact. It is natural and understandable, with legitimate vocabulary and appropriate pronoun use. Minor issues involve reduced precision in the ritual expression and a somewhat colloquial/informal rendering of the final question and event description.

per_sample.text: Đúng vậy, trong dịp lễ Chol Chnam Thmay, mọi người tắm nước thơm buổi sáng để gột rửa ô uế và cầu chúc điều tốt lành.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main meaning of the Vietnamese source: affirmation, the Chol Chnam Thmay/New Year festival context, everyone bathing with fragrant/perfumed water in the morning, cleansing impurity, and praying/wishing for good things. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or kinship/honorific choices. “មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា” appropriately corresponds to “mọi người.” The sentence does not require complex social hierarchy marking, and the hypothesis handles the general collective subject naturally.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary is present. “ទឹកអប់” is a legitimate Khmer expression for perfumed/fragrant water, even though the dictionary context also lists “ក្រអូប” for ‘thơm.’ The terms “បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំថ្មី,” “លាងជម្រះ,” “បួងសួង,” and “សេចក្ដីល្អ” are legitimate and contextually appropriate. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, this is a good translation. It conveys the core source meaning accurately and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor issues include a slightly less ritual/spiritual rendering of ‘ô uế’ and a small fluency issue in the time expression “នៅព្រឹក.” These do not seriously impede comprehension.

per_sample.text: Anh có thể cho biết những hoạt động tôn giáo thường xuyên nào gắn bó mật thiết với đời sống người Khmer hiện nay không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the meaning of the Vietnamese source. The structure 'បងអាចប្រាប់ឲ្យដឹងបានអត់ ថា...' is idiomatic, and the relative clause 'សកម្មភាពសាសនាណាខ្លះ ដែលធ្វើជាប្រចាំ...' is coherent. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly faithful to the Vietnamese source, preserving the key elements: ability/request, religious activities, regularity, close connection, Khmer people's current life. per_sample.text: Người Khmer chúng tôi xem việc đến chùa như hơi thở tinh thần, nơi gắn kết cộng đồng và nuôi dưỡng lòng từ bi.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun expression 'យើងខ្ញុំ' is appropriate for 'chúng tôi' and carries a polite collective sense. Combined with 'ខ្មែរ', it gives a natural meaning of 'we Khmer people', though the human reference's 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរយើង' is slightly more explicit. No honorific or social hierarchy mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All major lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'វត្ត', 'ដង្ហើម', 'ស្មារតី', 'សហគមន៍', 'មេត្តាករុណា'. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional reading relevant to this sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent. The structure closely follows Khmer syntax and is understandable. Minor stylistic awkwardness appears in 'ខ្មែរយើងខ្ញុំ' compared with the more formal 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរយើង', and the coordination 'ជាកន្លែងចងភ្ជាប់សហគមន៍ និងបណ្តុះ...' is slightly compressed, but it remains natural and clear.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a strong translation with full semantic fidelity, appropriate pronoun usage, legitimate vocabulary, and good Khmer grammatical flow. Minor stylistic differences from the reference do not materially affect comprehension or accuracy.

per_sample.text: Tôi được nghe nhiều về khái niệm tu báo hiếu, nó được thể hiện trong sinh hoạt tôn giáo ra sao?
label: ខ្ញុំបានលឺច្រើនអំពីគោលគំនិតនៃការបួសសងគុណមាតាបិតា។ តើវាត្រូវបានបង្ហាញនៅក្នុងសកម្មភាពសាសនាយ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំបានឮគេនិយាយច្រើនអំពីគំនិត «បដិបត្តិធម៌សងគុណម៉ែឪ» តើវាបង្ហាញក្នុងសកម្មភាពសាសនាយ៉ាងម៉េច?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi đã nghe nhiều về quan niệm xuất gia để báo hiếu cha mẹ. Điều đó được thể hiện như thế nào trong các hoạt động tôn giáo?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the overall communicative intent: the speaker has heard much about the concept of filial religious practice and asks how it is manifested in religious activities. However, compared with the human reference, the key term “tu báo hiếu” is rendered as «បដិបត្តិធម៌សងគុណម៉ែឪ» meaning roughly “practicing Dharma to repay parents’ gratitude,” whereas the reference specifies “ការបួសសងគុណមាតាបិតា,” i.e. ordination/monastic practice to repay parents. The hypothesis preserves the filial-religious meaning but is less specific about ordination. This is a minor-to-moderate semantic shift, not a breakdown.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun ខ្ញុំ is appropriate for Vietnamese “Tôi.” The expression ម៉ែឪ for parents is colloquial but legitimate and pragmatically acceptable, though slightly less formal than មាតាបិតា in the reference. There is no inappropriate honorific or social hierarchy mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The dictionary context confirms គំនិត as a legitimate Khmer word for idea/concept. Other lexical items such as សងគុណ, ម៉ែឪ, សកម្មភាពសាសនា, and យ៉ាងម៉េច are valid Khmer expressions. «បដិបត្តិធម៌» appears to be a Buddhist/religious lexical choice corresponding to Dharma practice; it is not a false phonetic transliteration, though the more standard spelling/term may often appear as ប្រតិបត្តិធម៌. Overall lexical legitimacy is strong.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure ខ្ញុំបានឮគេនិយាយច្រើនអំពី... is idiomatic for “I have heard people talk a lot about...” The question តើវាបង្ហាញក្នុងសកម្មភាពសាសនាយ៉ាងម៉េច? is natural, though slightly more colloquial and less formally passive than the reference’s តើវាត្រូវបានបង្ហាញ...យ៉ាងដូចម្តេច. Punctuation between the statement and question could be improved, but this does not impede comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation overall. It preserves the main meaning, uses appropriate pronouns, and has natural Khmer syntax. The main weakness is that the culturally specific concept “tu báo hiếu” is rendered more generally as Dharma practice repaying parents rather than explicitly as ordination/monastic practice, as in the human reference. Lexically, the translation is legitimate and not hallucinated.

per_sample.text: Con cháu thường lên chùa tụng kinh, cúng dường và làm phước để cầu an cho cha mẹ, xem đó là cách báo hiếu trọn vẹn.
label: កូនចៅតែងតែឡើងវត្តសូត្រមន្ត វេរភត្តាហារ និងធ្វើបុណ្យទានដើម្បីបួងសួងសុំសេចក្តីសុខសាន្តដល់ឪពុកម្តាយ ដោយចាត់ទុកនេះជាវិធីសងគុណដ៏ពេញលេញ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: កូនចៅតែងឡើងវត្តសូត្រធម៌ ប្រគេនទាន និងធ្វើបុណ្យ ដើម្បីសុំសេចក្តីសុខសាន្តឲ្យម៉ែឪ ហើយចាត់ទុកថា នោះជាវិធីសងគុណម៉ែឪបានពេញលេញ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Con cháu thường lên chùa tụng kinh, dâng cúng vật thực và làm phước bố thí để cầu bình an cho cha mẹ, xem đó là cách báo hiếu trọn vẹn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the full propositional meaning of the Vietnamese source: descendants/children habitually go to the pagoda, chant religious texts, make offerings, do merit, pray for peace for their parents, and regard this as a complete way of repaying filial debt. "សូត្រធម៌" accurately conveys "tụng kinh" in a Buddhist context, and "ប្រគេនទាន និងធ្វើបុណ្យ" adequately renders "cúng dường và làm phước." The phrase "សុំសេចក្តីសុខសាន្តឲ្យម៉ែឪ" correctly conveys praying for peace for parents. No major information is lost or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The kinship term "ម៉ែឪ" corresponds to Vietnamese "cha mẹ." It is somewhat more colloquial than "ឪពុកម្តាយ" but remains a legitimate and natural Khmer expression, including in regional/community usage. There is no inappropriate pronoun choice or social hierarchy violation. The Buddhist offering verb "ប្រគេន" is pragmatically appropriate for offerings in a religious context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All key lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: "កូនចៅ," "ឡើងវត្ត," "សូត្រធម៌," "ប្រគេនទាន," "ធ្វើបុណ្យ," "សេចក្តីសុខសាន្ត," and "សងគុណ." There is no evidence of false phonetic transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce conflicting interpretations for any term used in the hypothesis.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The sequence of actions is coherent, and the purpose clause with "ដើម្បី" is correctly formed. The final clause "ហើយចាត់ទុកថា នោះជាវិធីសងគុណម៉ែឪបានពេញលេញ" is understandable and natural, though slightly less formal and polished than the reference's "ដ៏ពេញលេញ." Overall morpho-syntactic quality is strong.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is accurate, fluent, and lexically legitimate. It captures the religious and filial-piety meaning of the source very well. Minor stylistic differences, such as using the more colloquial "ម៉ែឪ" and the slightly less formal final construction, do not materially harm meaning or appropriateness.

per_sample.text: Ngoài ra, hoạt động nào giúp người dân gắn bó chặt chẽ hơn với giáo lý Phật pháp?
label: ក្រៅពីនេះ តើសកម្មភាពអ្វីទៀតដែលជួយឲ្យប្រជាជនកាន់តែស្អិតរមួតជាមួយគតិព្រះពុទ្ធសាសនា?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្រៅពីហ្នឹង សកម្មភាពអីដែលជួយឲ្យបងប្អូនប្រជាជនចងភ្ជាប់ជិតស្និទ្ធជាងមុននឹងពុទ្ធធម៌?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài ra, còn những hoạt động nào giúp người dân gắn bó hơn với giáo lý Phật giáo?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. “ក្រៅពីហ្នឹង” correctly renders “Ngoài ra,” though in a more colloquial register than the reference. “សកម្មភាពអី” corresponds to “hoạt động nào,” and “ជួយឲ្យ...ចងភ្ជាប់ជិតស្និទ្ធជាងមុន” conveys the idea of helping people become more closely attached or connected. “ពុទ្ធធម៌” is an acceptable rendering of “giáo lý Phật pháp,” referring to Buddhist Dharma/teachings. Minor nuance difference: the source emphasizes adherence/close bonding with Buddhist doctrine, while “ចងភ្ជាប់ជិតស្និទ្ធ” is slightly more concrete/metaphorical, but still semantically faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “បងប្អូនប្រជាជន” for “người dân.” The addition of “បងប្អូន” is a common inclusive and respectful community-oriented address in Khmer usage and is pragmatically appropriate, especially in public or religious/community discourse. It does not distort the social relationship or introduce inappropriate hierarchy.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary, not false transliterations. The localized dictionary confirms “ចង” as ‘buộc/trói/cột/thắt,’ supporting the legitimacy of “ចងភ្ជាប់” as ‘bind/connect.’ Other terms such as “ក្រៅពីហ្នឹង,” “សកម្មភាព,” “បងប្អូន,” “ប្រជាជន,” “ជិតស្និទ្ធ,” and “ពុទ្ធធម៌” are authentic Khmer expressions. The hypothesis contains no apparent hallucinated or fake phonetic forms.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and flows naturally in a colloquial Khmer register. “ក្រៅពីហ្នឹង សកម្មភាពអីដែល...” is less formal than the reference but acceptable. The phrase “ចងភ្ជាប់ជិតស្និទ្ធជាងមុននឹងពុទ្ធធម៌” is intelligible, though slightly less idiomatic than “ស្អិតរមួតជាមួយគតិព្រះពុទ្ធសាសនា” or similar formal phrasing. The use of “នឹង” for ‘with’ is acceptable in context, though “ជាមួយ” might sound smoother.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a strong translation that preserves the source meaning, uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and maintains appropriate community-oriented pragmatics. Its main limitations are register and idiomatic precision: it is more colloquial than the reference and slightly less elegant in expressing close adherence to Buddhist doctrine. These are minor issues rather than serious errors.

per_sample.text: Chúng tôi thường xuyên nghe giảng pháp từ chư tăng, học cách giữ tâm thanh tịnh, tránh sân si và sống chan hòa trong cộng đồng.
label: យើងខ្ញុំតែងតែស្តាប់ការសម្តែងធម៌ពីព្រះសង្ឃ ស្រាវជ្រាវពីរបៀបរក្សាចិត្តឲ្យបរិសុទ្ធ ជៀសវាងពីសេចក្តីច្រណែនឈ្នានីស និងរស់នៅដោយសុខដុមរមនាជាមួយសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពួកខ្ញុំតែងតែស្ដាប់ធម៌ពីព្រះសង្ឃ រៀនរបៀបរក្សាចិត្តឲ្យបរិសុទ្ធ ជៀសវាងកំហឹងនិងមោហៈ ហើយរស់នៅចុះសម្រុងគ្នាក្នុងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chúng tôi thường xuyên nghe chư tăng thuyết pháp, tìm hiểu cách giữ tâm thanh tịnh, tránh ganh ghét đố kỵ và sống hòa thuận với cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source very well. 'ពួកខ្ញុំតែងតែ' accurately renders 'Chúng tôi thường xuyên'; 'ស្ដាប់ធម៌ពីព្រះសង្ឃ' conveys listening to Dharma from monks, though it slightly compresses 'nghe giảng pháp' by not explicitly stating 'lecture/preaching.' 'រៀនរបៀបរក្សាចិត្តឲ្យបរិសុទ្ធ' matches 'học cách giữ tâm thanh tịnh.' The phrase 'ជៀសវាងកំហឹងនិងមោហៈ' is a valid Buddhist rendering of 'tránh sân si,' especially interpreting 'sân' as anger and 'si' as delusion/ignorance. 'រស់នៅចុះសម្រុងគ្នាក្នុងសហគមន៍' accurately conveys living harmoniously within the community. Overall fidelity is high with only a minor compression of 'giảng pháp.'
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'ពួកខ្ញុំ' for 'Chúng tôi' is pragmatically acceptable as a first-person plural form, though slightly less formal than 'យើងខ្ញុំ' in the human reference. The religious honorific 'ព្រះសង្ឃ' is fully appropriate for 'chư tăng' and maintains the correct respect register. No problematic pronoun or hierarchy mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary and does not show evidence of false phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as 'ធម៌,' 'ព្រះសង្ឃ,' 'បរិសុទ្ធ,' 'កំហឹង,' 'មោហៈ,' and 'ចុះសម្រុងគ្នា' are authentic and semantically appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any conflict; the wording is standard and acceptable, including the harmony-related expression.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally in Khmer. The sequencing of clauses with 'ហើយ' is smooth, and the construction 'រៀនរបៀប...' is idiomatic. 'រស់នៅចុះសម្រុងគ្នាក្នុងសហគមន៍' is natural and clear. There are no serious syntactic or word-order problems.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation that accurately conveys the religious and ethical content of the source. It preserves the main ideas: regular Dharma listening, learning to purify the mind, avoiding negative mental states, and living harmoniously in the community. Minor semantic compression occurs in 'ស្ដាប់ធម៌' compared with 'nghe giảng pháp,' but this does not significantly reduce comprehension or fidelity. Pronoun usage, religious register, lexical legitimacy, and syntax are all strong.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer có duy trì những hoạt động đó thường ngày hay chỉ vào dịp đặc biệt?
label: តើជនជាតិខ្មែររក្សាសកម្មភាពទាំងនោះជារៀងរាល់ថ្ងៃ ឬគ្រាន់តែនៅឱកាសពិសេសប៉ុណ្ណោះ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: តើខ្មែរយើងនៅតែរក្សាធ្វើសកម្មភាពទាំងនោះរាល់ថ្ងៃ ឬធ្វើតែពេលមានឱកាសពិសេស?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer duy trì những hoạt động đó hằng ngày hay chỉ vào những dịp đặc biệt thôi?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning of the source: asking whether Khmer people maintain/do those activities every day or only on special occasions. The phrase “នៅតែរក្សាធ្វើសកម្មភាពទាំងនោះរាល់ថ្ងៃ” corresponds well to “duy trì những hoạt động đó thường ngày,” though it adds a slight sense of “still continue.” The second clause “ឬធ្វើតែពេលមានឱកាសពិសេស” is semantically close to “hoặc chỉ vào dịp đặc biệt,” though it literally means “only do them when there is a special occasion.” Overall fidelity is strong with only minor nuance shifts.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The source uses the neutral phrase “Người Khmer,” and the reference renders it as “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ.” The hypothesis uses “ខ្មែរយើង,” meaning “we Khmer/our Khmer people.” This is natural in Khmer discourse, especially in an in-group or Khmer Krom community context, but it introduces an inclusive first-person stance not explicitly present in the Vietnamese source. This is a minor pragmatic shift rather than an error.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated forms. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic regional term here. Words such as “រក្សា,” “សកម្មភាព,” “រាល់ថ្ងៃ,” and “ឱកាសពិសេស” are standard and appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and flows naturally overall. However, “រក្សាធ្វើសកម្មភាព” is slightly redundant or less elegant than “រក្សាសកម្មភាព” or “បន្តធ្វើសកម្មភាព.” The structure “ឬធ្វើតែពេលមានឱកាសពិសេស” is natural enough, though the reference’s “គ្រាន់តែនៅឱកាសពិសេសប៉ុណ្ណោះ” is more concise and formally aligned with the source.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation with accurate meaning and natural Khmer phrasing. per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - ជម្រាបសួរបង បងអាចចែករំលែកពីកន្លែងណាខ្លះដែលអ្នកខ្មែរយើងធម្មតារើសយកធ្វើពិធីរៀបការ បានទេអត់បង?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chào anh/chị! Anh/chị có thể chia sẻ về những địa điểm mà người Khmer thường chọn để tổ chức lễ cưới không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: greeting the addressee, asking whether he can share about the places commonly chosen by Khmer people for wedding ceremonies. 'កន្លែងណាខ្លះ' corresponds well to 'các địa điểm', 'អ្នកខ្មែរយើង' corresponds to 'người Khmer' with a slight inclusive nuance, and 'ធម្មតារើសយកធ្វើពិធីរៀបការ' correctly expresses 'thường được lựa chọn để tổ chức đám cưới'. No core information is omitted or mistranslated.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'បង' appropriately renders Vietnamese 'anh' and maintains respectful/familiar address. The opening 'ជម្រាបសួរបង' is polite and suitable. The final repetition 'បង' is natural in conversational Khmer and preserves the deferential tone of 'ạ'. Pronoun handling is pragmatically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated lexical forms. The localized dictionary entries do not introduce any conflicting interpretation, and none of the unusual dictionary items are relevant here. Terms such as 'ចែករំលែក', 'កន្លែង', 'អ្នកខ្មែរ', 'រើសយក', and 'ពិធីរៀបការ' are valid and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and understandable, with natural colloquial Khmer structure. 'បានទេអត់បង' is conversational and somewhat redundant compared with a more standard 'បានទេ?', but it remains acceptable and natural in spoken usage. 'ធម្មតារើសយក' is understandable, though 'ជាធម្មតា' or 'តែងតែ' would be more polished. Overall flow is good with only minor stylistic issues.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, and lexically legitimate. It is slightly more colloquial than the reference and contains minor redundancy in the question ending, but these do not affect comprehension or core meaning. Overall, it is a strong and natural rendering.

per_sample.text: - Dạ, đám cưới của người Khmer thường được tổ chức ngay tại nhà của cô dâu hoặc chú rể, tuỳ theo điều kiện hai bên.
label: បាទ! ពិធីមង្គលការខ្មែរ តែងតែធ្វើឡើងនៅផ្ទះកូនក្រមុំ ឬកូនកំលោះ អាស្រ័យលើលក្ខខណ្ឌរបស់ភាគីទាំងពីរ។
per_sample.topic: VỊ TRÍ TỔ CHỨC ĐÁM CƯỚI
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចាស ការរៀបការរបស់អ្នកខ្មែរ ធម្មតាគេធ្វើនៅផ្ទះខាងកូនក្រមុំ ឬខាងកូនកំលោះ តាមស្ថានភាពខាងទាំងពីរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vâng! Lễ cưới của người Khmer thường được tổ chức tại nhà cô dâu hoặc chú rể, tùy vào điều kiện của hai bên.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main meaning of the source: a Khmer wedding is normally held at the bride’s or groom’s house depending on the circumstances of both sides. “ការរៀបការរបស់អ្នកខ្មែរ” conveys 'the marriage/wedding of Khmer people,' though it is slightly less ceremonial than “ពិធីមង្គលការ.” “ធម្មតាគេធ្វើ” accurately renders 'usually is organized.' The phrase “តាមស្ថានភាពខាងទាំងពីរ” conveys 'depending on the situation of both sides,' which is close to “tuỳ theo điều kiện hai bên,” though slightly less precise than 'conditions/resources of both parties.' Minor loss of emphasis from “ngay tại nhà” is not serious.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic subject or pronoun choices. “អ្នកខ្មែរ” is appropriate for 'người Khmer.' The polite response marker “ចាស” corresponds to Vietnamese “Dạ”; although the reference uses “បាទ,” both are legitimate Khmer politeness particles depending on speaker identity and context, so this should not be penalized strongly.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or machine-hallucinated forms. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic regional term here. Words such as “កូនក្រមុំ,” “កូនកំលោះ,” “ស្ថានភាព,” and “ខាងទាំងពីរ” are valid and contextually understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically clear and mostly natural. “ធម្មតាគេធ្វើនៅផ្ទះខាងកូនក្រមុំ ឬខាងកូនកំលោះ” flows well in colloquial Khmer. However, “ការរៀបការរបស់អ្នកខ្មែរ” is slightly less idiomatic than “ពិធីមង្គលការខ្មែរ,” and “ស្ថានភាពខាងទាំងពីរ” is understandable but somewhat less polished than “លក្ខខណ្ឌរបស់ភាគីទាំងពីរ.” Overall, the syntax is good with minor stylistic awkwardness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is accurate, fluent, and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. It captures the core informational content of the Vietnamese source with only minor precision and register differences. The main weaknesses are slight loss of ceremonial nuance in 'wedding ceremony' and a somewhat less exact rendering of 'conditions of both sides.'

per_sample.text: - Nếu tổ chức tại nhà, gia đình sẽ dựng rạp lớn trước sân hoặc ven đường, có trang trí hoa văn truyền thống và nhiều màu sắc.
label: បើប្រារព្ធនៅផ្ទះ គ្រួសារនឹងរៀបចំរោងធំមួយនៅទីធ្លាខាងមុខ ឬតាមដងផ្លូវ ដោយតុបតែងលម្អដោយលំនាំប្រពៃណី និងចម្រុះពណ៌។
per_sample.topic: VỊ TRÍ TỔ CHỨC ĐÁM CƯỚI
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បើរៀបចំនៅផ្ទះ គ្រួសារនឹងសង់រោងធំមួយនៅមុខលានផ្ទះ ឬមាត់ថ្នល់ មានតុបតែងក្បាច់ប្រពៃណី និងពណ៌ចម្រុះជាច្រើន។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu tổ chức tại nhà, gia đình sẽ dựng một rạp lớn ở sân trước hoặc ven đường, trang trí bằng các hoa văn truyền thống nhiều màu sắc.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. 'Nếu tổ chức tại nhà' is rendered as 'បើរៀបចំនៅផ្ទះ', which is semantically appropriate. 'Gia đình sẽ dựng rạp lớn' is conveyed by 'គ្រួសារនឹងសង់រោងធំមួយ', correctly expressing that the family will erect/build a large tent or pavilion. The location 'trước sân hoặc ven đường' is rendered as 'នៅមុខលានផ្ទះ ឬមាត់ថ្នល់', which preserves the idea of being in the front yard or at the roadside. The decoration component 'có trang trí hoa văn truyền thống và nhiều màu sắc' is also conveyed well through 'មានតុបតែងក្បាច់ប្រពៃណី និងពណ៌ចម្រុះជាច្រើន'. Overall, the information is complete and faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns, honorifics, or kinship terms in this sentence. The subject 'gia đình' is correctly translated as 'គ្រួសារ'. No pragmatic or social-hierarchy mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary used in the hypothesis is legitimate Khmer. 'រៀបចំ', 'គ្រួសារ', 'សង់', 'រោង', 'មាត់ថ្នល់', 'ក្បាច់ប្រពៃណី', and 'ពណ៌ចម្រុះ' are all valid lexical choices. Although the localized dictionary lists 'របររាច' as a Khmer Krom equivalent for 'hoa văn', the hypothesis uses 'ក្បាច់', which is also a legitimate Khmer term for motif/pattern. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and flows naturally overall. Minor stylistic issues exist: 'នៅមុខលានផ្ទះ' is slightly less natural than alternatives such as 'នៅលានមុខផ្ទះ' or 'នៅទីធ្លាមុខផ្ទះ', and 'មានតុបតែង...' is somewhat less elegant than 'ដោយតុបតែង...' or 'ដែលតុបតែង...'. However, these issues do not obstruct comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation that preserves the meaning, uses appropriate vocabulary, and contains no pronoun or sociolinguistic errors. Minor morpho-syntactic awkwardness prevents a perfect score for flow, but the translation remains accurate and natural enough for native comprehension.

per_sample.text: - Ngoài ra, một số nghi thức quan trọng như cúng tổ tiên hoặc lễ buộc chỉ đỏ vào cổ tay được làm trong gian thờ hoặc phòng chính của nhà.
label: លើសពីនេះ ពិធីសំខាន់ៗមួយចំនួនដូចជា ការសែនដូនតា ឬពិធីចងខ្សែអំបោះពណ៌ក្រហមកដៃ ត្រូវបានអនុវត្តនៅក្នុងអាសនៈទីសក្ការបូជា ឬបន្ទប់សំខាន់នៃផ្ទះ។
per_sample.topic: VỊ TRÍ TỔ CHỨC ĐÁM CƯỚI
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្រៅពីនេះ ពិធីសំខាន់ៗមួយចំនួន ដូចជា ពិធីសែនដូនតា ឬពិធីចងអំបោះក្រហមនៅកដៃ គេធ្វើនៅកន្លែងសែនក្នុងផ្ទះ ឬនៅបន្ទប់ធំរបស់ផ្ទះ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài ra, một số nghi lễ quan trọng như cúng ông bà tổ tiên hoặc lễ buộc chỉ đỏ vào cổ tay được thực hiện tại bàn thờ hoặc gian chính trong nhà.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main meaning of the Vietnamese source: additional important rituals include ancestor worship/offering and tying a red thread around/on the wrist, and these are performed in a worship/ritual place inside the house or in the main room. Minor semantic shifts occur: “កន្លែងសែនក្នុងផ្ទះ” is less formal and less specific than “gian thờ”/altar worship space, and “បន្ទប់ធំ” means “large room” rather than precisely “main room.” However, the intended cultural setting remains understandable and largely faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “គេធ្វើ” as a generic impersonal construction is pragmatically acceptable in Khmer for expressing that rituals are performed. There are no problematic kinship terms, honorifics, or social hierarchy issues. The wording is neutral and appropriate for the topic.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer expressions, not false transliterations. “ក្រហម” correctly means red, aligning with the dictionary context. “សែនដូនតា” is a valid expression for ancestor offering/worship, and “ចងអំបោះក្រហមនៅកដៃ” is understandable for tying red thread at the wrist. “កន្លែងសែន” is colloquial but legitimate and semantically relevant.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure follows a clear sequence: introductory phrase, examples of rituals, and location of performance. Some phrasing is slightly less formal than the reference, especially “គេធ្វើ” and “កន្លែងសែន,” but it remains fluent and idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is good and communicatively effective. It preserves the core information and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary with natural syntax. The main weaknesses are minor precision losses in rendering “gian thờ” as “កន្លែងសែន” and “phòng chính” as “បន្ទប់ធំ,” but these do not seriously distort the meaning.

per_sample.text: - Những năm gần đây, một số gia đình khá giả chọn tổ chức tiệc cưới ở nhà hàng, nhưng phần nghi lễ vẫn làm tại nhà.
label: ប៉ុន្មានឆ្នាំចុងក្រោយនេះ គ្រួសារអ្នកមានមួយចំនួនជ្រើសរើសរៀបចំពិធីមង្គលការនៅភោជនីយដ្ឋាន ប៉ុន្តែពិធីនៅតែធ្វើឡើងនៅផ្ទះ។
per_sample.topic: VỊ TRÍ TỔ CHỨC ĐÁM CƯỚI
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ប៉ុន្មានឆ្នាំក្រោយៗមកនេះ មានគ្រួសារគ្រាន់បើខ្លះ ជ្រើសរៀបចំពិធីជប់លៀងការនៅហាងអាហារ តែផ្នែកពិធីការ នៅតែធ្វើនៅផ្ទះ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vài năm gần đây, một số gia đình khá giả chọn tổ chức tiệc cưới ở nhà hàng, nhưng các nghi lễ vẫn được tiến hành tại nhà.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main meaning of the source: in recent years, some relatively well-off families choose to organize the wedding banquet at a restaurant/food establishment, while the ritual/ceremonial part is still done at home. Minor semantic weakening occurs with “គ្រួសារគ្រាន់បើខ្លះ” for “gia đình khá giả,” since “គ្រាន់បើ” can mean fairly good/okay rather than clearly affluent, but it remains understandable as moderately well-off. “ហាងអាហារ” is slightly less formal than “ភោជនីយដ្ឋាន” for restaurant, but acceptable in context.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics requiring social hierarchy management. The subject “មានគ្រួសារគ្រាន់បើខ្លះ” is pragmatically appropriate and does not introduce inappropriate deixis or hierarchy.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary used is legitimate Khmer and not a false phonetic transliteration. Terms such as “គ្រួសារ,” “គ្រាន់បើ,” “ពិធីជប់លៀងការ,” “ហាងអាហារ,” and “ពិធីការ” are recognizable. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic hallucinated form; no suspicious Khmer Krom-specific false rendering appears.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. However, “ជ្រើសរៀបចំ” is less natural than “ជ្រើសរើសរៀបចំ,” and the spacing around “ផ្នែកពិធីការ” creates a slightly segmented flow. “ប៉ុន្មានឆ្នាំក្រោយៗមកនេះ” is acceptable but somewhat less idiomatic than the reference’s “ប៉ុន្មានឆ្នាំចុងក្រោយនេះ.” Overall fluency is good with minor awkwardness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is largely faithful, natural enough, and lexically legitimate. It conveys all core information from the Vietnamese source, with only minor reductions in precision and idiomaticity. No pronoun or sociolinguistic errors are present.

per_sample.text: - Việc tổ chức tại nhà giúp bà con, hàng xóm dễ dàng đến chung vui, tạo không khí gần gũi và gắn bó trong cộng đồng.
label: ការរៀបចំនៅផ្ទះនាំឱ្យសាច់ញាតិ និងអ្នកជិតខាងងាយស្រួលមកចូលរួមសប្បាយ បង្កើតបរិយាកាសស្និទ្ធស្នាល និងស្អិតរមួតនៅក្នុងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.topic: VỊ TRÍ TỔ CHỨC ĐÁM CƯỚI
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - ការរៀបចំនៅផ្ទះ ជួយឲ្យបងប្អូន និងអ្នកជិតខាង ងាយស្រួលមកចូលរួមសប្បាយ បង្កើតបរិយាកាសជិតស្និទ្ធ និងចងភ្ជាប់គ្នាក្នុងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Việc tổ chức tại nhà giúp người thân và hàng xóm dễ dàng đến tham gia chung vui, tạo nên bầu không khí thân tình và gắn bó trong cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or honorifics. The rendering of 'bà con' as 'បងប្អូន' is pragmatically appropriate in Khmer and can naturally refer to relatives or community members in a warm, communal sense. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliterations or hallucinated lexical items are present. The vocabulary used is legitimate Khmer. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and flows naturally overall. Word order follows standard Khmer structure. The coordination 'បរិយាកាសជិតស្និទ្ធ និងចងភ្ជាប់គ្នា' is understandable, though slightly less idiomatic than the reference's more natural 'ស្និទ្ធស្នាល និងស្អិតរមួត'. This is a minor fluency issue rather than a serious grammatical problem.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation with full preservation of meaning, appropriate communal terminology, legitimate lexical choices, and generally natural Khmer syntax. Minor stylistic awkwardness appears in the rendering of 'gắn bó' as 'ចងភ្ជាប់គ្នា', but it does not impede comprehension or distort the source meaning.

The phrase 'ចូលរួម' slightly shifts 'sự hiện diện' from mere presence to active participation, but this is pragmatically acceptable in this context. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns or socially sensitive address terms in the sentence. The rendering 'សាច់ញាតិទាំងសងខាង' is appropriate for 'cả hai bên họ hàng' and correctly reflects kin groups from both sides. No honorific or hierarchy error is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'កន្លែង', 'រៀបចំពិធី', 'ម៉ត់ចត់', 'ភ្លេងប្រពៃណី', and 'សាច់ញាតិទាំងសងខាង' are natural and semantically appropriate. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent. The structure follows natural Khmer sequencing. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation with high semantic fidelity, appropriate kinship wording, legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and natural grammar. Minor issues include slight generalization compared with the reference's explicit wedding framing and a small stylistic repetition, but these do not seriously impair meaning.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cảm ơn anh/chị rất nhiều. Tôi rất quan tâm đến cách người Khmer gìn giữ bản sắc văn hóa trong ngày cưới.

'ថែរក្សា' accurately conveys 'gìn giữ'. 'បរិយាកាសវប្បធម៌' means 'cultural atmosphere/environment', which is close to but slightly less exact than 'không gian văn hoá'/'cultural space'. 'បងប្អូនខ្មែរ' renders 'người Khmer' in a communal and natural way, though it adds a familial/community nuance. Overall semantic fidelity is good with minor shifts.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'បង' for Vietnamese 'anh' is pragmatically appropriate. The speaker's 'em' is rendered as 'ខ្ញុំ', matching the human reference and acceptable in Khmer where explicit younger-sibling self-reference is not always required. 'បងប្អូនខ្មែរ' is socially warm and acceptable for referring to Khmer people/community. No major pronoun or hierarchy errors are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The key lexical items are legitimate Khmer: 'របៀប', 'ថែរក្សា', 'បរិយាកាសវប្បធម៌', and 'ថ្ងៃការ'. There is no evidence of false phonetic copying or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary entries provided do not indicate any problematic or suspicious usage in the hypothesis.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. 'ខ្ញុំចាប់អារម្មណ៍ខ្លាំងណាស់នឹង...' is understandable, though 'ចំពោះ' or 'លើ' would be more idiomatic after 'ចាប់អារម្មណ៍'. 'ក្នុងថ្ងៃការរបស់ខ្លួន' is acceptable but slightly less polished than 'នៅថ្ងៃរៀបការ'. Overall flow is natural enough with minor awkwardness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is accurate and fluent overall. It conveys the source meaning well, uses appropriate pronouns and legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and only has minor semantic and stylistic deviations such as 'cultural atmosphere' instead of 'cultural space' and slightly less idiomatic prepositional usage.

per_sample.text: - Chào chị, chị có thể chia sẻ về những món ăn đặc trưng trong đám cưới truyền thống của người Khmer không ạ?

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: - ជំរាបសួរបងស្រី បងស្រីអាចចែករំលែកអំពីម្ហូបពិសេសៗក្នុងពិធីមង្គលការប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរបានទេ ចាស?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chào chị, chị có thể chia sẻ về những món ăn thường có trong lễ cưới truyền thống của người Khmer được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: greeting the addressee as an older sister and asking whether she can share about dishes associated with traditional Khmer weddings. The phrase 'ម្ហូបពិសេសៗ' means 'special dishes,' which is very close to Vietnamese 'món ăn đặc trưng' though slightly more evaluative than 'characteristic/typical dishes.' 'ពិធីមង្គលការប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ' correctly renders 'đám cưới truyền thống của người Khmer.' Overall informational fidelity is very high.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The Vietnamese 'chị' is appropriately rendered as 'បងស្រី,' a correct kinship/pragmatic term for addressing an older woman or respected older sister. Repetition of 'បងស្រី' as subject is natural and clear in Khmer. The final 'ចាស' reflects politeness corresponding to Vietnamese 'ạ,' though it implies a female speaker and is somewhat context-dependent; since the source does not specify speaker gender, this is not a major error.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'ជំរាបសួរ,' 'បងស្រី,' 'ចែករំលែក,' 'ម្ហូបពិសេសៗ,' 'ពិធីមង្គលការ,' 'ប្រពៃណី,' and 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ.' There is no evidence of false phonetic transliteration or hallucinated forms. The provided localized dictionary entries do not introduce any conflicting regional issue relevant to this sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent. Word order is natural for Khmer, and the structure 'អាច...បានទេ' correctly forms a polite ability question. The only minor stylistic issue is the placement of final 'ចាស?' after 'បានទេ,' which is understandable as a politeness marker but slightly less smooth than a more standard formulation.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, fluent, and pragmatically appropriate. It preserves the core request, the respectful address to 'chị,' and the traditional Khmer wedding context. Minor nuances include 'special dishes' rather than strictly 'characteristic dishes' and the somewhat context-dependent final politeness marker 'ចាស.' These do not significantly affect comprehension or communicative function.

per_sample.text: - Dạ, ẩm thực trong đám cưới Khmer rất phong phú, thể hiện sự hiếu khách và lòng biết ơn với bà con đến dự.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dạ! Các món ăn trong lễ cưới của người Khmer rất phong phú, thể hiện sự hiếu khách với khách mời và lòng biết ơn đối với bà con, bạn bè đã đến tham dự.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the source: an affirmative opening, food/cuisine in a Khmer wedding, its richness/diversity, and its expression of hospitality and gratitude toward people who attend. 'ម្ហូបអាហារ' corresponds well to 'ẩm thực', 'សម្បូរបែបណាស់' captures 'rất phong phú', and 'ចិត្តដឹងគុណចំពោះបងប្អូនដែលមកចូលរួម' conveys gratitude to relatives/community members who come to participate. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses no problematic pronouns. 'បងប្អូន' is an appropriate rendering for Vietnamese 'bà con' in this context, referring broadly to relatives/community members. The polite response marker 'ចា៎' appropriately reflects 'Dạ'. No issues with honorifics or social hierarchy are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items appear legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated forms. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting issue. Terms such as 'រោងការ', 'សម្បូរបែប', 'ទទួលភ្ញៀវ', and 'បងប្អូន' are valid and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and natural overall. The structure follows Khmer syntax well. The phrase 'ចិត្តទទួលភ្ញៀវរាក់ទាក់' is understandable but slightly less elegant than the reference's 'ការរាក់ទាក់នឹងភ្ញៀវ'; it is somewhat redundant or heavy in phrasing. 'ក្នុងរោងការខ្មែរ' is acceptable for 'in a Khmer wedding', though 'ពិធីមង្គលការខ្មែរ' would be more formal and precise. These are minor fluency/style issues rather than serious grammatical problems.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, and lexically legitimate. It preserves all key information from the Vietnamese source. Minor stylistic awkwardness in the hospitality phrase and the slightly colloquial/formal mismatch of 'រោងការ' compared with 'ពិធីមង្គលការ' prevent a perfect morpho-syntactic/naturalness score, but the translation remains strong and fully understandable.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Một món ăn không thể thiếu là bún nước lèo, được nấu từ cá lóc, sả, nghệ và mắm bò hóc.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main proposition: one indispensable dish is named, and it is cooked from snakehead fish, lemongrass, turmeric, and prahok/fermented fish paste. However, the key dish name 'bún nước lèo' is rendered as 'ប៊ុនទឹកលេវ', a direct Vietnamese-like transliteration rather than the established Khmer rendering 'នំបញ្ចុកទឹកសម្លរ' found in the reference. This weakens semantic clarity for Khmer readers. The phrase 'ប្រហុកមានរសជាតិពិសេស' conveys 'prahok with a special taste', which partially captures 'đặc trưng' but is less precise than the reference's 'មាំប្រហុក'. Overall meaning is mostly recoverable, but with a notable issue in the culturally central dish term.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns, kinship terms, honorifics, or social hierarchy markers in this sentence. The hypothesis does not introduce any inappropriate subject or pragmatic reference. This dimension is fully adequate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The major lexical issue is 'ប៊ុនទឹកលេវ', which appears to be a phonetic borrowing from Vietnamese 'bún nước lèo' rather than a natural Khmer equivalent. The reference uses 'នំបញ្ចុកទឹកសម្លរ', which is semantically transparent and idiomatic. The localized dictionary context does not provide support for 'លេវ' as a legitimate Khmer Krom culinary term here. Other lexical items such as 'ត្រីរ៉ស់', 'ស្លឹកគ្រៃ', 'រមៀត', and 'ប្រហុក' are legitimate and appropriate. Thus, the hypothesis contains one significant false-transliteration-like rendering but is otherwise lexically valid.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure is generally grammatical and understandable: 'មួយក្នុងចំណោមមុខម្ហូបដែលខានមិនបាន គឺ...' is acceptable, and 'ដែលស្លពី...' is comprehensible as 'cooked from'. However, the flow is less natural than the reference, especially due to the inserted transliterated dish name and the slightly awkward phrase 'ប្រហុកមានរសជាតិពិសេស'. The syntax is not broken, but it lacks native-level idiomaticity.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis conveys the core informational content and remains understandable, but the culturally important dish name is not rendered idiomatically and appears as an unsupported transliteration. Ingredient translation is mostly accurate, and there are no pronoun/pragmatic problems. Grammar is serviceable but somewhat unnatural. Overall, this is a fair-to-good translation with a notable lexical/cultural terminology issue.

label: បាយដំណើបប្រាំពណ៌ក៏ត្រូវបានយកមកបម្រើនៅក្នុងពិធីមង្គលការផងដែរ មិនត្រឹមតែស្រស់ស្អាតប៉ុណ្ណោះទេ ថែមទាំងជានិមិត្តរូបនៃធាតុទាំងប្រាំ បួងសួងសុំសេចក្តីសុខពេញលេញ។

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: five-colored sticky rice is often served, is visually attractive, symbolizes the five elements, and expresses a wish/prayer for complete happiness. “បាយដំណើបប្រាំពណ៌” correctly renders “xôi ngũ sắc,” “ឧស្សាហ៍ដាក់ជូន” conveys “thường được phục vụ,” and “តំណាងឲ្យធាតុទាំងប្រាំ” is a valid rendering of “tượng trưng cho ngũ hành.” The final phrase “បួងសួងឲ្យមានសុភមង្គលពេញបរិបូណ៌” preserves the sense of wishing for fulfilled happiness. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics in this sentence. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer and do not appear to be false transliterations from Vietnamese. Terms such as “បាយដំណើប,” “ប្រាំពណ៌,” “ធាតុទាំងប្រាំ,” “បួងសួង,” and “សុភមង្គល” are semantically appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional issue. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally overall. The structure mirrors the source well: topic + frequency/serving clause + contrastive “not only... but also...” construction + symbolic/prayer clause. “ស្អាតភ្នែក” is understandable and acceptable, though slightly more colloquial than the reference’s “ស្រស់ស្អាត.” Overall morpho-syntax is strong.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with faithful semantic transfer, appropriate register, and legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor stylistic and orthographic/naturalness issues are present, especially around “ពេញបរិបូណ៌,” but they do not substantially affect comprehension or fidelity.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main propositional content: the feast tray includes banana-blossom salad, sour fish soup, and fried dishes such as spring rolls or crispy fried fish. “យាំត្រយ៉ូងចេក” is semantically suitable for “gỏi bắp chuối,” and “ត្រីចៀនស្រួយ” accurately conveys “cá chiên giòn.” “សម្លម្ជូរត្រីលិញ” conveys sour soup with cá linh, though it appears to use a Vietnamese-based fish name rather than the reference’s localized term “ត្រីក្បក.” “ចាយ៉” for “chả giò” is understandable but differs from the human reference “សាយ៉,” creating a minor lexical accuracy concern. Other terms such as “យាំ,” “ត្រយ៉ូងចេក,” “សម្លម្ជូរ,” “ម្ហូបចៀន,” and “ស្រួយ” are legitimate Khmer or regionally plausible lexical choices.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and understandable. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation overall: it transfers almost all core information and remains fluent enough for comprehension. per_sample.text: - Món tráng miệng truyền thống là chè thốt nốt, được nấu từ nước cốt dừa và đường thốt nốt, ngọt thanh và dễ ăn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: it identifies the item as a traditional dessert, includes coconut milk and palm sugar as ingredients, and conveys that it is mildly/moderately sweet and easy to eat. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns, kinship terms, honorifics, or social hierarchy markers in this sentence. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most lexical items are legitimate Khmer: 'មុខបង្អែម', 'ប្រពៃណី', 'ខ្ទិះដូង', 'ស្ករត្នោត', 'ផ្អែមល្មម', and 'ហូបងាយ' are understandable and natural enough.
