linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The structure "ការជូនដំណឹងនេះ មានរបៀបណាពិសេសអត់ ចែ?" is grammatical and natural in colloquial Khmer. The word order is fluent, and the use of "អត់" at the end of the predicate phrase is pragmatically natural for a yes/no question. The phrasing is slightly informal but clear and idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically accurate, pragmatically appropriate, lexically valid, and syntactically fluent. Minor differences include the added demonstrative "នេះ" and the more colloquial address term "ចែ," but these do not significantly reduce quality, especially given Khmer Krom/Southern Vietnamese regional usage.

per_sample.text: Dạ, thường thì thành viên trong gia đình hay họ hàng sẽ truyền tai nhau có người mất để mọi người được biết và nhín thời gian đến chia buồn.
label: ចាស ជាធម្មតា សមាជិកគ្រួសារ ឬញាតិមិត្តនឹងប្រាប់តគ្នាថា មានម្នាក់បានទទួលមរណៈភាព ដើម្បីឲ្យគ្រប់គ្នាបានដឹង និងឆ្លៀតពេលមកចូលរួមរំលែកទុក្ខ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចាស ធម្មតាទៅ អ្នកក្នុងផ្ទះ ឬបងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ គេប្រាប់តៗគ្នាថាមានអ្នកស្លាប់ ដើម្បីឲ្យមនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នាបានដឹង ហើយលៃពេលមកចែករំលែកទុក្ខ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vâng, thông thường các thành viên trong gia đình hoặc bà con, bạn bè sẽ báo tin cho nhau rằng có người đã qua đời, để mọi người biết và sắp xếp thời gian đến chia buồn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main informational content of the Vietnamese source: a polite opening, the usual practice, family/relatives informing one another, the fact that someone has died, and the purpose of letting everyone know so they can make time to come offer condolences. The phrase "អ្នកក្នុងផ្ទះ ឬបងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ" is slightly more colloquial and narrower than "សមាជិកគ្រួសារ ឬញាតិមិត្ត" but still conveys family and kin relations adequately. "មានអ្នកស្លាប់" is semantically correct but less euphemistic/formal than the source "có người mất" and the reference "ទទួលមរណៈភាព". "លៃពេល" appropriately conveys arranging or finding time.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The polite Vietnamese discourse marker "Dạ" is appropriately rendered as "ចាស". The use of "គេ" as an impersonal/general subject in "គេប្រាប់តៗគ្នា" is natural and pragmatically acceptable in Khmer. Kinship wording such as "បងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ" is appropriate for relatives. No serious honorific or social hierarchy problem is present, though the wording is somewhat more colloquial than the human reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary and does not show false transliteration from Vietnamese. "ប្រាប់តៗគ្នា" is a valid Khmer expression for passing information along to one another and should not be confused with unrelated dictionary entries such as "តគ". "អ្នកក្នុងផ្ទះ", "បងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ", "លៃពេល", and "ចែករំលែកទុក្ខ" are recognizable Khmer expressions. No hallucinated or illegitimate lexical items are detected.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally in Khmer. The sequence of clauses is logical: normal situation, actors, action of informing, content of the information, and purpose clause. "ធម្មតាទៅ" and "ហើយលៃពេលមក..." are natural colloquial constructions. The phrase "ចែករំលែកទុក្ខ" is understandable, though the more conventional condolence formula is "ចូលរួមរំលែកទុក្ខ" as in the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is clear, natural, and semantically faithful. Minor issues are mainly stylistic and pragmatic: "អ្នកស្លាប់" is blunter than the more respectful/euphemistic expression for death, and "ចែករំលែកទុក្ខ" is less idiomatic than the standard condolence phrase. These do not seriously impede meaning.

per_sample.text: Nếu ở xa, thì sẽ gọi điện hoặc nhờ người thân nhắn lại, vì người Khmer rất coi trọng việc xum họp đầy đủ trong tang lễ.
label: បើរស់នៅទីឆ្ងាយ គេនឹងទូរស័ព្ទ ឬពឹងសាច់ញាតិជូនដំណឹង ព្រោះខ្មែរយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ខ្ពស់ក្នុងការជួបជុំគ្នាក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យសព។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បើនៅឆ្ងាយ គេនឹងទូរស័ព្ទមក ឬពឹងសាច់ញាតិឲ្យផ្ដាំដំណឹងវិញ ព្រោះខ្មែរយើងឲ្យតម្លៃខ្លាំងណាស់ចំពោះការជួបជុំគ្នាឲ្យបានគ្រប់មុខ ក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យសព។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu ở xa, họ sẽ gọi điện hoặc nhờ bà con thông báo, vì người Khmer rất coi trọng việc sum họp trong lễ tang.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the full propositional meaning of the Vietnamese source. “Nếu ở xa” is rendered as “បើនៅឆ្ងាយ”; “sẽ gọi điện” as “គេនឹងទូរស័ព្ទមក”; “nhờ người thân nhắn lại” as “ពឹងសាច់ញាតិឲ្យផ្ដាំដំណឹងវិញ”; and the reason clause about Khmer people valuing complete gathering at funerals is accurately rendered. The phrase “ឲ្យបានគ្រប់មុខ” is a natural way to express everyone being present/fully gathered, matching “xum họp đầy đủ.” Minor additions such as “យើង” and “ខ្លាំងណាស់” intensify or localize the statement but do not alter the core meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “គេ” for an indefinite subject is appropriate and matches the generic Vietnamese construction. “សាច់ញាតិ” correctly conveys relatives. The phrase “ខ្មែរយើង” adds an inclusive/community-oriented nuance, but this is pragmatically natural in Khmer discourse and does not create a hierarchy or politeness error. No inappropriate kinship terms or honorifics are used.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration from Vietnamese. “គ្រប់មុខ” is a standard idiomatic expression meaning everyone/all faces present, aligning with the source idea of full attendance. The localized dictionary includes a related form for ‘đủ/đầy đủ’ as “ក្គប់/ក្គប់សពវ”; the hypothesis uses the standard Khmer spelling “គ្រប់,” which is fully legitimate and not a hallucination.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent. Clause sequencing mirrors natural Khmer syntax: conditional clause, action alternatives, and causal explanation. The use of “ចំពោះការជួបជុំគ្នាឲ្យបានគ្រប់មុខ” is idiomatic and clear. “ទូរស័ព្ទមក” and “ផ្ដាំដំណឹងវិញ” add directional/return nuances, but they remain natural and contextually acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, fluent, and lexically legitimate. It conveys the informational content of the source very well, including the importance of complete communal presence at a funeral. Additions such as “ខ្មែរយើង” and “ខ្លាំងណាស់” slightly enrich the expression but do not introduce semantic error. Overall, this is a native-like Khmer rendering.

per_sample.text: Còn về việc xum họp thì diễn ra như thế nào ạ?
label: តើការជួបជុំនេះប្រព្រឹត្តទៅយ៉ាងណា?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចុះរឿងជួបជុំគ្នានោះ ធ្វើឡើងយ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cuộc họp mặt này diễn ra như thế nào?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. "Còn về việc" is rendered naturally as "ចុះរឿង...នោះ" meaning 'as for/regarding that matter,' and "xum họp" is correctly translated as "ជួបជុំគ្នា". The phrase "diễn ra như thế nào" is rendered as "ធ្វើឡើងយ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ", meaning 'how is it held/done,' which is semantically close to 'how does it take place.' The wording is slightly more colloquial than the reference but preserves the informational content.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit pronouns or kinship terms in the source or hypothesis. The Vietnamese polite particle "ạ" is not directly represented by a Khmer honorific or formal politeness marker, but the Khmer sentence remains pragmatically acceptable as a conversational question. The register is somewhat informal due to "យ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ", but not inappropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer expressions. "រឿង" for 'matter/issue,' "ជួបជុំគ្នា" for 'gather/reunite,' "ធ្វើឡើង" for 'be held/take place,' and "យ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ" for 'how' are natural Khmer. No false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary is present. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any conflicting issue.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure "ចុះរឿង...នោះ ធ្វើឡើងយ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ?" is idiomatic and understandable. It is more colloquial than the human reference "ប្រព្រឹត្តទៅយ៉ាងណា", but the syntax and word order are smooth.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is faithful, fluent, and lexically valid. Its only minor weakness is register: it is more colloquial and does not explicitly reflect the Vietnamese polite particle "ạ". However, there is no semantic distortion, no pronoun misuse, and no lexical illegitimacy.

per_sample.text: Dạ, họ hàng nội ngoại đều tụ họp về nhà người mất, không chỉ để viếng mà còn phụ giúp lo tang lễ, thể hiện tinh thần cộng đồng.
label: ចាស ញាតិមិត្តទាំងសងខាងមកជួបជុំគ្នានៅផ្ទះអ្នកស្លាប់ មិនត្រឹមតែរំលែកទុក្ខទេ ថែមទាំងជួយបម្រើបុណ្យសព បង្ហាញពីស្មារតីសហគមន៍ទៀតផង។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចា៎ ញាតិខាងឪខាងម៉ែ គេមកជុំគ្នាឯផ្ទះអ្នកស្លាប់ មិនមែនតែទៅគោរពសពទេ តែថែមទាំងជួយចាត់ចែងបុណ្យសព បង្ហាញពីស្មារតីសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vâng, bà con họ hàng, bạn bè hai bên đến tụ họp tại nhà người mất; không chỉ để chia buồn mà còn phụ giúp lo liệu đám tang, thể hiện tinh thần cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the Vietnamese source: relatives from both paternal and maternal sides gather at the deceased person's house, not only to pay respects but also to help arrange the funeral, showing community spirit. The rendering 'ញាតិខាងឪខាងម៉ែ' correctly captures 'họ hàng nội ngoại'. 'គោរពសព' is acceptable for 'viếng' in a funeral context, and 'ជួយចាត់ចែងបុណ្យសព' matches 'phụ giúp lo tang lễ'. A minor issue is that the source's 'đều' meaning 'all/everyone' is not explicitly expressed, though the collective sense remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The polite opening 'ចា៎' appropriately corresponds to Vietnamese 'Dạ'. The use of 'គេ' after the kinship subject is pragmatically acceptable in Khmer as a resumptive/general third-person marker, especially in colloquial or community narrative style. There are no inappropriate honorific or social hierarchy errors.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The phrase 'ខាងឪខាងម៉ែ' is a natural way to refer to relatives on the father's and mother's sides. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting evidence for the vocabulary used here.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally overall. The topicalized structure 'ញាតិខាងឪខាងម៉ែ គេមកជុំគ្នា...' is acceptable Khmer. The construction 'មិនមែនតែ...ទេ តែថែមទាំង...' is understandable, though slightly less polished than the reference's 'មិនត្រឹមតែ...ទេ ថែមទាំង...'. Overall fluency is good with only minor stylistic roughness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, and lexically legitimate. Minor deductions are warranted for not explicitly rendering 'đều' and for slightly less elegant morpho-syntactic phrasing compared with the human reference, but the hypothesis remains fully understandable and contextually appropriate.

per_sample.text: Mọi người sẽ thay nhau túc trực bên linh cữu, đọc kinh cầu siêu và hỗ trợ gia đình trong suốt những ngày diễn ra tang lễ.
label: គ្រប់គ្នានឹងនឹងប្តូរវេនគ្នាស្នាក់នៅក្បែរមឈូស សូត្រធម៌ បង្សុគូលនិងជួយគ្រួសារអស់រយៈថ្ងៃបុណ្យសព។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បងប្អូនគ្រប់គ្នានឹងផ្លាស់វេនគ្នាចាំយាមក្បែរមឈូសសព សូត្រធម៌ឧទ្ទិសកុសលជូនសព ហើយជួយគ្រួសារពេញមួយរយៈថ្ងៃធ្វើបុណ្យសព។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Mọi người sẽ thay phiên nhau túc trực bên quan tài, tụng kinh, làm lễ cầu siêu và giúp đỡ gia đình trong suốt những ngày tang lễ.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the full meaning of the Vietnamese source. 'Mọi người' is rendered as 'បងប្អូនគ្រប់គ្នា', a natural community-oriented expression meaning everyone/all relatives or community members. 'Thay nhau túc trực bên linh cữu' is correctly expressed as 'ផ្លាស់វេនគ្នាចាំយាមក្បែរមឈូសសព', meaning taking turns keeping vigil near the coffin. 'Đọc kinh cầu siêu' is rendered as 'សូត្រធម៌ឧទ្ទិសកុសលជូនសព', which appropriately conveys chanting/reciting religious texts and dedicating merit to the deceased. 'Hỗ trợ gia đình trong suốt những ngày diễn ra tang lễ' is accurately translated as helping the family throughout the funeral period. No core information is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'បងប្អូនគ្រប់គ្នា' is pragmatically appropriate in Khmer funeral and community contexts, especially where kinship/community terms are commonly used inclusively. There is no inappropriate pronoun choice or social hierarchy violation. The phrase maintains a respectful tone suitable for a funeral setting.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and not a false phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as 'ផ្លាស់វេន', 'ចាំយាម', 'មឈូសសព', 'សូត្រធម៌', 'ឧទ្ទិសកុសល', 'គ្រួសារ', and 'បុណ្យសព' are authentic and contextually suitable. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic or hallucinated term here; the hypothesis uses standard and regionally acceptable Khmer religious/funeral vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The sequence of actions is clear: taking turns keeping vigil, chanting/dedicating merit, and helping the family. Word order and clause linkage with 'ហើយ' are natural. 'ពេញមួយរយៈថ្ងៃធ្វើបុណ្យសព' is understandable and acceptable for 'throughout the funeral days'.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is an excellent translation. It preserves the source meaning, uses culturally and religiously appropriate Khmer expressions, maintains respectful funeral-register language, and contains no serious grammatical or lexical problems. Minor redundancy in 'មឈូសសព' is not problematic in context.

per_sample.text: Vậy người thân có được khóc lớn không hay phải kiêng kỵ điều gì?
label: តើសាច់ញាតិបានយំស្រែកខ្លាំងឬក៏ គួរតែតមពីអ្វីមួយទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ៊ីចឹង បងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ​យំឮៗបានអត់ ឬត្រូវតមអីខ្លះ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người thân có khóc la nhiều không, hay cần phải kiêng cữ điều gì không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning. Vietnamese 'Vậy' is rendered as 'អ៊ីចឹង' meaning 'so/therefore'. 'người thân' is translated as 'បងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ', a natural Khmer expression for relatives/kin. 'có được khóc lớn không' is rendered as 'យំឮៗបានអត់', meaning 'is it allowed to cry loudly/audibly?', which preserves the intended question. 'hay phải kiêng kỵ điều gì' is translated as 'ឬត្រូវតមអីខ្លះ', meaning 'or must one abstain from/avoid anything?', which is semantically faithful though slightly more colloquial.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns. The kinship/social term 'បងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ' is appropriate for 'người thân' and fits Khmer pragmatic usage. The informal question marker 'បានអត់' is acceptable in conversational Khmer and does not distort the social relationship or hierarchy.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'អ៊ីចឹង', 'បងប្អូនសាច់ញាតិ', 'យំ', 'ឮៗ', 'បានអត់', 'ត្រូវ', 'តម', and 'អីខ្លះ' are all authentic and natural. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any issue with the terms used.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure mirrors a natural Khmer yes/no-or alternative question: '...បានអត់ ឬត្រូវ...?' Word order and particle use are idiomatic. The style is colloquial but fluent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly faithful, fluent, and pragmatically appropriate. It captures the source question completely, with only a minor stylistic shift toward colloquial Khmer, which does not affect meaning or quality.

per_sample.text: Dạ, được khóc, nhưng không nên khóc quá thảm thiết, vì người ta tin rằng linh hồn người mất sẽ luyến tiếc và khó siêu thoát.
label: ចាសអាចយំបាន ប៉ុន្តែមិនគួរយំខ្លាំងពេកទេ ព្រោះគេជឿថាព្រលឹងនៃអ្នកស្លាប់នឹងសោកស្ដាយ ហើយពិបាកនឹងចាប់កំណើត។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចាស យំបាន តែមិនគួរយំសោកសង្រេងពេកទេ ព្រោះគេជឿថា ព្រលឹងអ្នកស្លាប់នឹងអាឡោះអាល័យ ហើយពិបាកទៅសុគតិ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dạ, có thể khóc, nhưng không nên khóc quá nhiều, vì người ta tin rằng linh hồn người đã khuất sẽ buồn thương, lưu luyến và khó đầu thai.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. 'ចាស យំបាន' correctly renders 'Dạ, được khóc'; 'តែមិនគួរយំសោកសង្រេងពេកទេ' captures 'nhưng không nên khóc quá thảm thiết'; and the causal clause 'ព្រោះគេជឿថា...' correctly reflects 'vì người ta tin rằng...'. The rendering of 'luyến tiếc' as 'អាឡោះអាល័យ' is semantically appropriate, conveying attachment/longing. 'khó siêu thoát' is rendered as 'ពិបាកទៅសុគតិ', which is a legitimate Buddhist/religious expression meaning difficulty reaching a good spiritual destination; it is slightly interpretive but contextually very suitable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'ចាស' appropriately for polite affirmative response corresponding to Vietnamese 'Dạ'. The generic subject 'គេ' for 'người ta' is natural and pragmatically correct. No problematic kinship terms, honorifics, or social hierarchy mismatches are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items appear legitimate Khmer vocabulary. 'គួរ' is supported by the localized dictionary context as meaning 'nên'. Terms such as 'សោកសង្រេង', 'អាឡោះអាល័យ', and 'សុគតិ' are authentic Khmer expressions, with 'សុគតិ' being especially appropriate in a Buddhist funerary/spiritual context. There is no evidence of false phonetic copying or hallucinated vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure follows a coherent sequence: permission to cry, prohibition against excessive mourning, then explanation of belief about the deceased soul. Word order and clause linkage are idiomatic, with only a minor stylistic difference from the reference in the final religious phrase.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, fluent, and culturally appropriate. It preserves the informational content and pragmatic tone of the source. The use of 'ទៅសុគតិ' for 'siêu thoát' is a reasonable and legitimate religious rendering, not an error. Overall, the hypothesis is near native-level and fully understandable.

per_sample.text: Thay vào đó, người thân tập trung đọc kinh, làm lễ bái Tam bảo, dưới sự hướng dẫn của Achar lễ và Achar duki để người khuất được nhẹ nhàng ra đi một cách thanh thản.
label: ផ្ទុយទៅវិញ ញាតិសន្ដាន ផ្ដំគ្នាសូត្រធម៌ នមស្ការព្រះរតនត្រ័យ ក្រោមការដឹកនាំរបស់លោកអាចារ្យនិង លោកអាចារ្យយុគីដើម្បីឱ្យអ្នកស្លាប់បានលាចាកលោកដោយស្ងប់ស្ងាត់។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ជំនួសវិញ សាច់ញាតិបានផ្តោតចិត្តសូត្រធម៌ ធ្វើពិធីថ្វាយបង្គំព្រះរតនត្រ័យ ក្រោមការណែនាំរបស់អាចារ្យពិធី និងអាចារ្យទុកី ដើម្បីអោយអ្នកស្លាប់បានចាកចេញទៅដោយស្រាលស្រួល ស្ងប់សុខ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngược lại, bà con thân quyến cùng nhau tụng kinh, đảnh lễ Tam Bảo dưới sự hướng dẫn của các vị Achar và Achar Yuki, để người mất được từ giã cõi đời trong thanh thản.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main informational content of the Vietnamese source: instead of other practices, relatives gather/focus on chanting, perform worship to the Three Jewels, and do so under the guidance of ritual Achar figures so that the deceased may depart gently and peacefully. “ជំនួសវិញ” conveys 'thay vào đó' adequately, though slightly less contrastive than the reference’s “ផ្ទុយទៅវិញ.” “សាច់ញាតិបានផ្តោតចិត្តសូត្រធម៌” captures the idea of relatives concentrating on chanting, though it slightly emphasizes mental focus rather than collective gathering. The final phrase “ចាកចេញទៅដោយស្រាលស្រួល ស្ងប់សុខ” successfully conveys a peaceful, light departure.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no major pronoun issues. “សាច់ញាតិ” is an appropriate rendering of 'người thân.' The religious specialists are rendered as “អាចារ្យពិធី” and “អាចារ្យទុកី,” preserving their ritual role. The hypothesis omits the honorific “លោក” before “អាចារ្យ,” which the human reference includes, so the level of respect is slightly less formal, but the title “អាចារ្យ” itself still carries religious authority and remains pragmatically acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most lexical choices are legitimate Khmer: “សូត្រធម៌,” “ថ្វាយបង្គំ,” “ព្រះរតនត្រ័យ,” “ការណែនាំ,” and “អ្នកស្លាប់” are valid and contextually appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not provide entries for “អាចារ្យទុកី,” but since the Vietnamese source itself contains the specialized term 'Achar duki,' the transliterated form “ទុកី” is plausible and should not be treated as hallucinated. No clear false transliteration or fake lexical item is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally overall. Khmer word order is acceptable, and the structure mirrors the source without becoming broken. Minor stylistic issues include “ជំនួសវិញ,” which is understandable but less idiomatic than “ផ្ទុយទៅវិញ,” and “ដើម្បីអោយ,” where standard spelling would be “ដើម្បីឱ្យ.” The phrase “ស្រាលស្រួល ស្ងប់សុខ” is understandable and natural enough, though somewhat redundant.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation with faithful semantic transfer, appropriate religious terminology, and generally natural Khmer syntax. Minor issues concern formality, slight nuance differences, and small orthographic/stylistic choices, but none significantly impair meaning.

per_sample.text: Cảm ơn chị rất nhiều, qua lời kể của chị, em cảm nhận được sự gắn bó và lòng tôn kính trong tang lễ của người Khmer.
label: អរគុណបងស្រីច្រើន តាមរយៈសាច់រឿងរបស់បង ខ្ញុំមានអារម្មណ៍ថាមានការទំនាក់ទំនង និងចិត្តគោរពក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យសពរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អរគុណបងស្រីច្រើនណាស់ តាមពាក្យបងស្រីនិយាយប្រាប់ ខ្ញុំមានអារម្មណ៍ឃើញបាននូវចំណងស្និទ្ធស្នាល និងចិត្តគោរពបូជា ក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យសពរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cảm ơn chị rất nhiều. Qua câu chuyện của chị, em cảm nhận được sự gắn kết và lòng tôn kính trong lễ tang của người Khmer.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the main meaning of the Vietnamese source: thanking the older female addressee, referring to what she narrated, and expressing that the speaker perceives the bond/attachment and reverence present in Khmer funeral rites. “ចំណងស្និទ្ធស្នាល” is a good rendering of “sự gắn bó,” and “ចិត្តគោរពបូជា” conveys “lòng tôn kính,” though it is slightly stronger and more devotional than the source. Overall informational fidelity is very high.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “បងស្រី” appropriately reflects Vietnamese “chị” as an older female interlocutor. The speaker’s “em” is rendered as “ខ្ញុំ,” which is polite and acceptable in Khmer, and also matches the human reference. There is no pragmatic mismatch in hierarchy or politeness.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No suspicious false transliterations or hallucinated lexical items are present. The terms used are standard Khmer and appropriate to the context. The localized dictionary entries provided do not introduce any relevant alternative that would affect this evaluation.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and fluent. “តាមពាក្យបងស្រីនិយាយប្រាប់” is understandable and natural enough for “through your telling,” though slightly more colloquial than the reference. “ខ្ញុំមានអារម្មណ៍ឃើញបាននូវ...” is somewhat redundant/awkward because it combines feeling and seeing/perceiving, but it remains clear and acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, and lexically legitimate. Minor stylistic and morpho-syntactic awkwardness prevents it from being fully native-level in flow, but it remains a strong translation overall.

per_sample.text: Anh có thể chia sẻ về những hoạt động buổi tối đặc trưng trong đời sống người Khmer truyền thống không?
label: តើបងអាចចែករំលែកអំពីសកម្មភាពពេលល្ងាចដ៏លេចធ្លោនៅក្នុងជីវិតប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពីកិច្ចការពេលយប់ដែលជាទំនៀម ក្នុងជីវភាពប្រពៃណីរបស់អ្នកខ្មែរបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Anh/chị có thể chia sẻ về những sinh hoạt buổi tối nổi bật trong đời sống truyền thống của người Khmer được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main communicative intent: asking whether the addressee can share about evening/night activities in traditional Khmer life. However, there are some semantic shifts. Vietnamese 'hoạt động buổi tối đặc trưng' means 'characteristic/typical evening activities,' while the hypothesis uses 'កិច្ចការពេលយប់ដែលជាទំនៀម' meaning 'night tasks/affairs that are customary.' This shifts 'activities' toward 'tasks/affairs' and 'evening' toward 'night,' and renders 'đặc trưng' as 'customary/traditional.' The overall meaning remains understandable and close, but it is not fully precise.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'បង' for Vietnamese 'Anh' is pragmatically appropriate and matches the human reference. It conveys a respectful/familiar second-person address suitable for Khmer discourse. No pronoun or social hierarchy error is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'ចែករំលែក' for 'share,' 'កិច្ចការ' for tasks/affairs, 'ពេលយប់' for nighttime, 'ទំនៀម' for custom, 'ជីវភាព' for livelihood/living condition, and 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' for Khmer people. No false transliteration or hallucinated lexical item is detected. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting issue; the wording is authentic Khmer, though some lexical choices are less exact than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and understandable. The question structure with 'បានទេ' is natural even without initial 'តើ.' The phrase 'កិច្ចការពេលយប់ដែលជាទំនៀម ក្នុងជីវភាពប្រពៃណី...' is acceptable but slightly less elegant and less idiomatic than the reference, especially because 'កិច្ចការ' and 'ជីវភាព' narrow or shift the intended sense. Overall flow is good with minor stylistic/semantic awkwardness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation that conveys the overall question accurately. Its main weaknesses are lexical-semantic nuance: 'evening' becomes 'night,' 'activities' becomes 'tasks/affairs,' and 'characteristic' becomes 'customary.' These are not severe enough to make the sentence misleading, but they reduce fidelity compared with the reference. Pronoun usage and lexical legitimacy are strong.

per_sample.text: Buổi tối thường có sinh hoạt văn nghệ, bà con tụ tập tại sân chùa hay sân nhà, hát dân ca, múa trống, tạo không khí gắn kết cộng đồng.
label: ពេលល្ងាចតែងតែមានសកម្មភាពសិល្បៈបងប្អូនប្រមូលផ្តុំគ្នានៅទីធ្លាវត្ត ឬទីធ្លាផ្ទះ ច្រៀងចម្រៀងប្រជាប្រិយ របាំស្គរ បង្កើតបរិយាកាសនៃការភ្ជាប់ទំនាក់ទំនងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពេលយប់ ជាញឹកញាប់មានការលេងសិល្បៈ បងប្អូនអ្នកស្រុកប្រមូលផ្តុំគ្នានៅលានវត្ត ឬលានផ្ទះ ច្រៀងចម្រៀងប្រជាប្រិយ រាំស្គរ បង្កើតបរិយាកាសស្និទ្ធស្នាលសាមគ្គីក្នុងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Buổi tối thường có các hoạt động văn nghệ, bà con tụ họp ở sân chùa hoặc sân nhà, hát dân ca, múa trống, tạo nên bầu không khí gắn kết cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the core meaning of the source accurately: evening/night communal cultural activities, villagers/relatives gathering at temple or house yards, singing folk/popular songs, dancing with drums, and creating a cohesive community atmosphere. Minor semantic shifts include “ពេលយប់” for “buổi tối,” which is slightly more ‘night’ than ‘evening,’ and “ការលេងសិល្បៈ,” which sounds somewhat like ‘playing art’ rather than organized cultural/artistic activities. However, the intended meaning remains clear and faithful overall.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The phrase “បងប្អូនអ្នកស្រុក” is pragmatically appropriate for Vietnamese “bà con,” conveying community members/local people in a warm kinship-based way. No problematic pronouns, honorifics, or social hierarchy issues appear.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and does not show false phonetic transliteration. Terms such as “លានវត្ត,” “លានផ្ទះ,” “ច្រៀងចម្រៀងប្រជាប្រិយ,” “រាំស្គរ,” and “សហគមន៍” are acceptable. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any conflict; no suspicious hallucinated Khmer Krom forms are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. Word order is coherent, and the coordination of activities is clear. “ការលេងសិល្បៈ” is slightly less formal/natural than “សកម្មភាពសិល្បៈ” or “កម្មវិធីសិល្បៈ,” but it does not seriously disrupt readability.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation with strong semantic fidelity, appropriate community-oriented kinship wording, legitimate vocabulary, and natural Khmer syntax. Minor issues are limited to slight register/word-choice differences and the ‘night’ vs. ‘evening’ nuance.

per_sample.text: Tôi nghe nói đến lễ cúng trăng, nghi thức này thường diễn ra vào buổi tối phải không?
label: ខ្ញុំលឺថាមានពិធីបុណ្យសំពះព្រះខែ តើពិធីនេះតែងតែប្រព្រឹត្តទៅនៅពេលល្ងាចមែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយពីពិធីសំពះព្រះខែ ពិធីនេះធម្មតាធ្វើនៅពេលយប់ មែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi nghe nói có lễ cúng trăng, lễ này có phải thường diễn ra vào buổi tối không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the Vietnamese source: the speaker has heard about the moon-worship ceremony/festival and asks whether it is normally held at a certain time. “ពិធីសំពះព្រះខែ” is an appropriate rendering of “lễ cúng trăng.” “ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយពី...” correctly expresses “Tôi nghe nói đến...”. The main semantic weakness is that “buổi tối” in the source corresponds more closely to “ពេលល្ងាច” or evening, while the hypothesis uses “ពេលយប់,” meaning night. This is understandable but slightly shifts the time reference. “ធម្មតា” captures “thường” reasonably well, though less formally than “តែងតែ.”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun “ខ្ញុំ” is appropriate for “Tôi” in this neutral informational question. There are no complex kinship, honorific, or social hierarchy issues in the sentence. The impersonal “គេនិយាយ” is pragmatically natural for “nghe nói.”
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer words or established expressions. “ពិធីសំពះព្រះខែ” is a valid expression for the moon-worship ceremony/festival and is not a false transliteration. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional term relevant to this sentence, and there is no evidence of hallucinated vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent in Khmer. “ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយពី...” is natural. “ពិធីនេះធម្មតាធ្វើនៅពេលយប់” is understandable and acceptable, though “ជាធម្មតា” or “តែងតែប្រព្រឹត្តទៅ” would be somewhat more polished and closer to the reference. Minor issues concern stylistic naturalness and interrogative flow, especially the slightly awkward 'ឬ ឬក៏' sequence and the colloquial 'ប៉ុណ្ណឹង' compared with the more standard 'ប៉ុណ្ណោះ'.

per_sample.text: Gói bánh là dịp để nhiều thế hệ ngồi lại, người lớn truyền dạy cho con cháu cách làm và kể chuyện về tổ tiên.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: wrapping cakes is presented as an occasion for multiple generations to sit together, elders teach descendants how to make them, and they tell/speak about ancestral stories. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “មនុស្សចាស់” for elders/adults and “កូនចៅ” for children/descendants, both of which are pragmatically appropriate and socially natural in Khmer. There are no problematic pronouns or honorific mismatches.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer words. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting issue; words such as “ចាស់” and “គឺ/ជា” are used normally in standard and regional Khmer contexts.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically sound and flows naturally. The structure “ការវេចនំជាឱកាសឲ្យ...” is acceptable, though the reference’s “គឺជាឱកាសដែល...” is slightly more explicit. The overall word order and clause linkage are fluent and understandable.

per_sample.text: Tôi thấy không khí sum họp dường như rất quan trọng trong giai đoạn này, anh có thể nói rõ hơn không?
label: ខ្ញុំគិតថា បរិយាកាសជួបជុំគ្នាហាក់ដូចជាមានសារៈសំខាន់ខ្លាំងណាស់នៅក្នុងអំឡុងពេលនេះ តើអ្នកអាចពន្យល់ឲ្យកាន់តែច្បាស់បានទេ?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. 'Tôi thấy' is rendered as 'ខ្ញុំឃើញថា', which can function naturally as 'I see/find that' in Khmer, though the reference uses 'ខ្ញុំគិតថា'. 'Không khí sum họp' is correctly conveyed as 'បរិយាកាសជួបជុំគ្នា'. 'Dường như rất quan trọng' is rendered as 'ដូចជាសំខាន់ណាស់', preserving the sense of seeming/appearing very important. 'Trong giai đoạn này' is accurately translated as 'ក្នុងដំណាក់កាលនេះ'. The final request 'anh có thể nói rõ hơn không?' is rendered as 'បងអាចនិយាយឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះបានអត់?', which faithfully means 'can you speak/say it more clearly?' Overall, informational fidelity is very strong.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The source uses 'anh', which in Vietnamese can address an older male, peer, or socially familiar interlocutor. The hypothesis uses 'បង', a Khmer kinship/pronominal term meaning older sibling and commonly used for respectful or familiar address toward an older person. This is pragmatically appropriate and arguably more socially nuanced than the neutral 'អ្នក' in the reference. The phrase 'បានអត់' is conversational and fits an interactive spoken question.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. 'ឃើញ' corresponds to 'thấy', supported by the localized dictionary entry related to 'ដឃើញ'. 'បរិយាកាស' is a standard Khmer term for atmosphere/environment, while the localized dictionary lists another form for 'không khí'; the hypothesis form is not a hallucination and is fully acceptable. 'ជួបជុំគ្នា', 'សំខាន់', 'ដំណាក់កាល', and 'និយាយឲ្យច្បាស់' are all valid and semantically appropriate. There is no evidence of false transliteration or fabricated lexical material.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and natural in Khmer. Word order follows standard Khmer structure: subject + perception verb + complement clause, followed by the main evaluative statement and a final question. 'បរិយាកាសជួបជុំគ្នាដូចជាសំខាន់ណាស់ក្នុងដំណាក់កាលនេះ' is fluent and understandable. The final clause 'បងអាចនិយាយឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះបានអត់?' is idiomatic spoken Khmer. Minor stylistic difference from the reference, such as using 'និយាយ' rather than 'ពន្យល់', does not harm grammaticality or meaning.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality Khmer translation of the Vietnamese source. It preserves the intended meaning, uses appropriate pragmatic address through 'បង', maintains fluent Khmer syntax, and contains legitimate lexical choices. Differences from the reference are stylistic rather than substantive.

per_sample.text: Đúng vậy, gia đình và bà con trong phum sóc tụ họp, cùng nhau chuẩn bị, tạo cảm giác gắn bó bền chặt và vui tươi.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the meaning of the Vietnamese source. “Đúng vậy” is rendered as “ត្រូវហើយ”; “gia đình và bà con trong phum sóc tụ họp” is rendered naturally as “គ្រួសារ និងបងប្អូនក្នុងភូមិស្រុកមកជុំគ្នា”; “cùng nhau chuẩn bị” becomes “ជួយគ្នាត្រៀមរៀបចំ,” which slightly adds the nuance of mutual help but remains semantically compatible with preparing together. “Tạo cảm giác gắn bó bền chặt và vui tươi” is well conveyed by “ធ្វើឲ្យមានអារម្មណ៍ស្និទ្ធស្នាលមាំមួន និងសប្បាយរីករាយ.” No important information is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns requiring delicate hierarchy handling. The use of “បងប្អូន” for “bà con” is socially and culturally appropriate, conveying relatives/community members in a warm collective sense. No honorific or kinship mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and not a false transliteration. “គ្រួសារ,” “បងប្អូន,” “ភូមិស្រុក,” “មកជុំគ្នា,” “ត្រៀមរៀបចំ,” “ស្និទ្ធស្នាល,” “មាំមួន,” and “សប្បាយរីករាយ” are all valid and contextually appropriate. The clause sequencing is coherent: affirmation, subject group, gathering action, preparation action, and resulting emotional state. Word order and phrase linkage are idiomatic. “ស្និទ្ធស្នាលមាំមួន” is compact but natural enough, conveying close and firm bonding.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, fluent, and culturally appropriate. It preserves the informational content and pragmatic warmth of the original. The minor addition of “ជួយគ្នា” does not harm fidelity because it aligns with the collective preparation implied in the source. Overall, this is a native-level rendering.

The structure follows a clear interrogative pattern: adjunct phrase + subject phrase + temporal phrase + habitual marker + question phrase. 'យ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ' is colloquial but natural and appropriate for the source question.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is faithful, fluent, and pragmatically appropriate. per_sample.text: Mọi người đều rất háo hức, trẻ con mong chờ mặc áo mới, còn người lớn háo hức được tham gia nghi lễ trang nghiêm.
label: អ្នករាល់គ្នាពិតជាអន្ទះសារណាស់ ក្មេងៗទន្ទឹងរង់ចាំស្លៀកពាក់ថ្មី ចំណែកមនុស្សធំវិញមានចិត្តអន្ទះសា ចង់ចូលរួមក្នុងពិធីសាសនាដ៏ឱឡារិក។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នាសប្បាយរំភើបណាស់ កូនក្មេងទន្ទឹងរង់ចាំស្លៀកពាក់ខោអាវថ្មី ឯមនុស្សធំក៏រំភើបនឹងបានចូលរួមពិធីដ៏គោរពឱឡារិក។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Mọi người thật sự rất háo hức; trẻ con mong chờ được mặc quần áo mới, còn người lớn thì nôn nao muốn tham dự nghi lễ tôn giáo trang nghiêm.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the main propositional content accurately: everyone is excited, children are waiting to wear new clothes, and adults are excited to join a solemn ceremony. The rendering សប្បាយរំភើបណាស់ captures the emotional excitement of háo hức, though it is slightly more general than the anticipatory sense of អន្ទះសា/ទន្ទឹង. ស្លៀកពាក់ខោអាវថ្មី is faithful to mặc áo mới, with ខោអាវថ្មី naturally broadening to 'new clothes.' The final phrase ចូលរួមពិធីដ៏គោរពឱឡារិក conveys participation in a solemn/grand ceremony, but គោរព is a little semantically awkward as a direct adjective for ពិធី; it suggests 'respectful' rather than strictly 'solemn.' Overall meaning is preserved with minor nuance issues.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា for 'mọi người,' កូនក្មេង for 'trẻ con,' and មនុស្សធំ for 'người lớn,' all of which are socially and pragmatically appropriate. There are no problematic pronouns, honorific mismatches, or hierarchy errors. The contrastive marker ឯ before មនុស្សធំ is also appropriate for 'còn người lớn.'
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items appear legitimate Khmer vocabulary rather than false transliteration. The phrase ទន្ទឹងរង់ចាំ is a standard expression meaning 'to look forward to/wait eagerly.' Although the localized dictionary lists រង់ separately with other meanings, this does not invalidate the compound usage here. No hallucinated or suspicious machine-copied Vietnamese forms are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and fluent. Word order follows natural Khmer structure: subject plus emotional predicate, then subordinate/coordinate clauses. កូនក្មេងទន្ទឹងរង់ចាំស្លៀកពាក់ខោអាវថ្មី is smooth. The phrase មនុស្សធំក៏រំភើបនឹងបានចូលរួម is understandable but slightly less idiomatic; Khmer would more naturally use រំភើបដែលបានចូលរួម, រំភើបនឹងការបានចូលរួម, or ចង់ចូលរួម depending on intended nuance. ពិធីដ៏គោរពឱឡារិក is also somewhat awkward because គោរព does not fit as naturally as ឱឡារិក/គួរឱ្យគោរព/ដ៏មហោឡារិក.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation with the full core meaning intact. It handles participants and social categories well and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. The main weaknesses are minor semantic-pragmatic nuance loss around háo hức as anticipatory eagerness and some awkward phrasing in the final ceremony clause. These issues do not seriously obstruct comprehension.

per_sample.text: Sự háo hức đó có tạo động lực cho bà con trong việc chuẩn bị không?

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Sự háo hức này có tạo động lực cho bà con địa phương trong việc chuẩn bị không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the Vietnamese source: the excitement/joy may motivate people in their preparation. 'ការរំភើបរីករាយនោះ' corresponds well to 'Sự háo hức đó', and 'ជំរុញទឹកចិត្ត' conveys the idea of creating motivation or encouragement. The question structure is preserved. There is a slight semantic/stylistic shift from 'tạo động lực' to 'ជំរុញទឹកចិត្ត', but it remains faithful and understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The Vietnamese 'bà con' is rendered as 'បងប្អូន', which is a natural and socially appropriate Khmer way to refer to fellow community members or local people. This is pragmatically acceptable and fits the communal tone of the source. No inappropriate honorific or pronoun mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. 'រំភើបរីករាយ', 'ជំរុញ', 'ទឹកចិត្ត', 'បងប្អូន', and 'ត្រៀមរៀបចំ' are valid expressions. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional interpretation here, and there is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is understandable, but the phrase 'មានជំរុញទឹកចិត្ត' is somewhat unnatural in Khmer. A more fluent form would be 'បានជំរុញទឹកចិត្ត' or 'បានបង្កើតជាកម្លាំងចិត្ត'. The overall word order is acceptable, and the question-final 'ទេ?' is colloquially valid, though the sentence lacks the more formal framing 'តើ...ដែរឬទេ'.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is semantically faithful and pragmatically appropriate, with fully legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Its main weakness lies in morpho-syntactic naturalness, especially the awkward construction 'មានជំរុញទឹកចិត្ត'. Despite this, the translation is clear and communicatively effective.

per_sample.text: Có, nó khiến mọi người làm việc hăng say, dù vất vả nhưng ai cũng vui vì sắp được hưởng lễ hội.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Có! Điều đó khiến mọi người làm việc đầy hăng hái; dù có hơi vất vả, ai nấy cũng đều vui vì sắp đến lúc tham gia lễ hội rồi.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the overall propositional structure: 'Yes/there is,' it makes everyone work, although tired/hard, everyone is happy because the festival is near. However, the key Vietnamese phrase 'làm việc hăng say' is not properly translated into Khmer; it is rendered as a mixed-script phonetic borrowing 'ហăngសាយ', which weakens semantic fidelity for a Khmer reader. 'ហត់ហេវ' conveys fatigue/exhaustion and is acceptable for 'vất vả' though slightly narrower. 'ជិតបានលេងបុណ្យ' reasonably captures the idea of soon enjoying/participating in a festival, though more colloquial than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'វា' for 'nó' and 'គ្រប់គ្នា/អ្នកណាក៏' for 'mọi người/ai cũng', which are pragmatically appropriate in this neutral context. There are no problematic honorifics, kinship terms, or social hierarchy mismatches.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The major issue is 'ហăngសាយ', a direct Vietnamese phonetic/orthographic carryover from 'hăng say' with Latin-script Vietnamese character 'ă' embedded inside Khmer text. This is not supported by the localized dictionary context and is not legitimate Khmer lexical usage. Other items such as 'ហត់ហេវ' and 'លេងបុណ្យ' are understandable/colloquial and not clearly hallucinated.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence structure is mostly grammatical and understandable: 'វាធ្វើឲ្យគ្រប់គ្នាធ្វើការ...', 'ទោះបី...ក៏ដោយ', and 'ព្រោះជិតបាន...ហើយ' are acceptable Khmer constructions. However, the mixed-script transliteration disrupts native fluency, and 'អ្នកណាក៏សប្បាយ' is slightly less complete/natural than 'អ្នកណាក៏សប្បាយចិត្តដែរ'. Overall flow is fair to good but not fully natural.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis conveys most of the intended meaning and uses appropriate pronoun/reference choices, but it contains a serious lexical legitimacy problem due to the untranslated Vietnamese phrase 'hăng say' appearing as a mixed-script false transliteration. This affects both semantic fidelity and fluency, though the rest of the sentence remains largely understandable.

per_sample.text: Như vậy có thể nói trước lễ, không khí trong cộng đồng Khmer vừa bận rộn vừa đầy sự gắn kết?
label: ដូច្នេះ អាចនិយាយបានថា មុនពេលពិធីបុណ្យ បរិយាកាសនៅក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរគឺទាំងមមាញឹក ហើយទាំងពោរពេញដោយភាពស្និទ្ធស្នាលមែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ៊ីចឹង អាចនិយាយបានថា មុនថ្ងៃបុណ្យ បរិយាកាសក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ ទាំងមមាញឹក ទាំងពេញទៅដោយការរួបរួមគ្នា មែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Như vậy, có thể nói rằng trước lễ hội, không khí trong cộng đồng người Khmer vừa tất bật, vừa chan chứa tình thân, đúng không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main meaning of the Vietnamese source. “Như vậy” is rendered as “អ៊ីចឹង,” a natural Khmer equivalent meaning “so/thus.” “Có thể nói” is correctly translated as “អាចនិយាយបានថា.” “Trước lễ” becomes “មុនថ្ងៃបុណ្យ,” which is slightly more specific as “before the festival day,” but still semantically appropriate in context. “Không khí trong cộng đồng Khmer” is correctly rendered as “បរិយាកាសក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ.” The dual quality “vừa bận rộn vừa đầy sự gắn kết” is well expressed as “ទាំងមមាញឹក ទាំងពេញទៅដោយការរួបរួមគ្នា,” meaning both busy and full of unity/solidarity. The question nuance is preserved by “មែនទេ?”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns or kinship/honorific terms requiring special social calibration. The wording is neutral and appropriate for a question about the Khmer community. No pragmatic mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer forms. “បរិយាកាស,” “សហគមន៍,” “ខ្មែរ,” “មមាញឹក,” and “ការរួបរួមគ្នា” are valid and semantically appropriate. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting regional issue; the hypothesis uses standard, acceptable Khmer vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically fluent and natural. The structure “ទាំង...ទាំង...” correctly expresses the Vietnamese “vừa...vừa...” construction. The absence of an explicit copula such as “គឺ” before the predicate does not harm grammaticality, as Khmer allows this structure naturally. Overall word order and flow are smooth.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a faithful, fluent, and lexically legitimate Khmer translation of the Vietnamese source. Minor nuance differences exist, such as “មុនថ្ងៃបុណ្យ” being slightly more specific than “trước lễ,” and “ការរួបរួមគ្នា” emphasizing unity rather than intimate connectedness, but these do not materially affect comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Chính xác, những ngày này là khoảng thời gian đặc biệt khi mọi người cùng nhau gìn giữ truyền thống, chia sẻ niềm vui và hy vọng.
label: ពិតណាស់! ថ្ងៃទាំងនេះគឺជាពេលវេលាដ៏ពិសេស ដែលមនុស្សគ្រប់រូបបានរួមគ្នាថែរក្សាប្រពៃណី ចែករំលែកភាពរីករាយ និងក្តីសង្ឃឹម។

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đúng vậy! Những ngày này là khoảng thời gian rất đặc biệt, khi mọi người cùng nhau gìn giữ truyền thống, chia sẻ niềm vui và hy vọng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: affirmation, these days as a special period, people coming together to preserve tradition, share joy, and hope. The rendering of 'truyền thống' as 'ទំនៀមទម្លាប់ប្រពៃណី' is slightly expanded but semantically compatible. 'អំណរសប្បាយ' and 'ក្តីសង្ឃឹម' correctly express joy and hope. The main issue is 'ថ្ងៃទាំងនី', which appears to be an erroneous form for 'ថ្ងៃទាំងនេះ' meaning 'these days'. This creates a small semantic/orthographic disturbance but does not make the sentence incomprehensible.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The source uses the general expression 'mọi người' meaning everyone/people. The hypothesis uses 'បងប្អូនទាំងអស់គ្នា', literally 'all brothers and sisters/everyone together', which is a natural inclusive Khmer expression and pragmatically appropriate, especially in community-oriented or Khmer Krom contexts. There is no inappropriate honorific or social hierarchy mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer: 'ច្បាស់ណាស់', 'ពេលវេលាពិសេស', 'ថែរក្សា', 'ទំនៀមទម្លាប់ប្រពៃណី', 'ចែករំលែក', 'អំណរសប្បាយ', and 'ក្តីសង្ឃឹម' are all valid. The localized dictionary does not indicate any issue with these terms. The form 'នី' is not supported by the provided dictionary context as a demonstrative equivalent of 'នេះ'; it is best interpreted as a typo or malformed spelling rather than a false transliteration or hallucinated lexical item.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is mostly fluent and grammatically natural in Khmer. The structure 'ដែលបងប្អូនទាំងអស់គ្នារួមគ្នា...' flows well and preserves the intended relation. However, 'ថ្ងៃទាំងនីជា' is morpho-syntactically flawed due to the likely typo 'នី' instead of 'នេះ', and the lack of 'គឺជា' or a clearer copular construction makes the opening slightly less polished than the reference. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is generally accurate, natural, and communicatively successful. It preserves the message and uses appropriate inclusive phrasing. The only notable defect is the malformed demonstrative 'ថ្ងៃទាំងនី', which affects orthographic correctness and slightly weakens grammatical flow. There are no serious semantic omissions, no inappropriate pronoun usage, and no evidence of false transliteration.

per_sample.text: Chào anh, anh có thể chia sẻ về mối quan hệ trong gia đình và cách xưng hô của người Khmer không ạ?

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ជំរាបសួរបង បងអាចចែករំលែកពីទំនាក់ទំនងក្នុងគ្រួសារ និងរបៀបហៅគ្នារបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរបានទេបង?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chào anh/chị, anh/chị có thể chia sẻ về các mối quan hệ trong gia đình và cách xưng hô của người Khmer được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: a polite greeting followed by a request to share information about relationships within the family and forms of address among Khmer people. The final “បង” also helps preserve the polite interpersonal tone of Vietnamese “ạ.” The pronoun choice is socially and pragmatically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary used in the hypothesis is legitimate Khmer: “ជំរាបសួរ,” “ចែករំលែក,” “ទំនាក់ទំនង,” “គ្រួសារ,” “របៀបហៅគ្នា,” and “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ” are all valid and contextually suitable. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated lexical material. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting issue; the relevant family term is correctly expressed with standard “គ្រួសារ.”
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and natural in Khmer. The omission of the explicit question marker “តើ” does not reduce grammaticality, since the final “បានទេ” clearly marks the request question. Word order and phrase structure are fluent and idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is an excellent translation. It preserves the semantic content, uses appropriate Khmer pronoun and politeness conventions, avoids illegitimate lexical forms, and reads naturally. Differences from the reference are minor stylistic alternatives rather than errors.

per_sample.text: Dạ, trong văn hóa Khmer, gia đình nhiều thế hệ sống chung nên việc xưng hô đúng vai vế rất quan trọng và thể hiện sự kính trọng.
label: បាទ ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ គ្រួសារដែលមានអ្នកច្រើនជំនាន់រស់នៅជាមួយគ្នា ដូច្នេះការហៅត្រូវខ្សែញាតិមានសារៈសំខាន់ណាស់ និងបង្ហាញពីការគោរព។
per_sample.topic: MỐI QUAN HỆ TRONG GIA ĐÌNH CHÍNH
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចាស៎ ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ គ្រួសារច្រើនជំនាន់នៅរួមគ្នា ដូច្នេះការហៅគ្នាឲ្យត្រូវតាមវ័យ តាមឋានៈ សំខាន់ណាស់ ហើយបង្ហាញពីការគោរព។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vâng, trong văn hóa Khmer, gia đình thường có nhiều thế hệ sống chung với nhau, vì vậy cách xưng hô đúng theo quan hệ họ hàng rất quan trọng và thể hiện sự tôn trọng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the source: in Khmer culture, multi-generational families live together, so correct forms of address are very important and show respect. The rendering of “gia đình nhiều thế hệ sống chung” as “គ្រួសារច្រើនជំនាន់នៅរួមគ្នា” is faithful. “việc xưng hô đúng vai vế” is translated as “ការហៅគ្នាឲ្យត្រូវតាមវ័យ តាមឋានៈ,” which captures the idea of addressing people according to age and social status, though it is slightly less kinship-specific than “vai vế” / “ខ្សែញាតិ.” Overall semantic fidelity is high.

linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary in the hypothesis is legitimate Khmer and does not show false transliteration or hallucinated forms. No suspicious Khmer Krom-specific or fake lexical items appear.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and natural overall. The structure follows Khmer discourse flow well: main principle first, then elder sibling's duties, then younger sibling's obligations. The phrase "មានទំនួលខុសត្រូវនាំផ្លូវ ការពារប្អូន" is understandable, though slightly compressed; a more polished form would include a connector such as "ក្នុងការ" or "និង". linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is generally accurate, fluent, and lexically valid. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well formed and flows naturally in Khmer. per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cháu chỉ có thể được nhận thừa kế khi cha mẹ chết trước; khi đó cháu sẽ được hưởng phần thay cho cha mẹ mình.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main legal condition: the grandchild can inherit only if the grandchild's parents died earlier, and then receives the share in place of the father or mother. Minor nuance: "ម៉ែឪរបស់ចៅ" may sound like both parents collectively, but this is also present in the source wording "cha mẹ của cháu" and does not distort the core meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject/pronoun handling is appropriate. Colloquial kinship terms "ម៉ែឪ/ឪ/ម៉ែ" are legitimate Khmer usage, not machine artifacts.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically clear and mostly natural. The structure follows Khmer conditional syntax well: subject + inheritance possibility + condition + consequence. "ចៅបានតែទទួលមរតក" is understandable, though slightly less polished than a more formal phrasing such as "ចៅអាចទទួលមរតកបាន លុះត្រាតែ..." linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliteration or hallucinated lexical items are present. The terms "កូនប្រសាស្រី," "កូនប្រសាប្រុស," "សិទ្ធិ," and "មរតក" are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting evidence, and the hypothesis uses authentic Khmer rather than phonetic copying from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and natural overall. "សិទ្ធិអីក្នុងរឿងទទួលមរតក" is colloquial but acceptable, matching the Vietnamese structure "quyền gì trong chuyện thừa kế." The word order is clear, and the interrogative ending "ទេ" is suitable for the yes/no nuance of the question. Minor stylistic roughness exists compared with the more polished reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation with full informational fidelity and legitimate vocabulary. Minor pragmatic shortcomings arise from using the less respectful pronoun "គេ" and the less formal address "អ៊ំ" instead of "លោកអ៊ំ," especially because the source contains the polite marker "thưa." Morphologically and syntactically, the sentence is fluent though somewhat colloquial.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis is semantically faithful to the Vietnamese source text. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary, not false transliterations. The localized dictionary includes a regional form for 'gia đình' as 'ក្គួសារ', but the hypothesis uses the standard Khmer spelling 'គ្រួសារ', which is legitimate and should not be penalized. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure mirrors the Vietnamese source while remaining idiomatic: setting phrase, subject phrase, habitual/passive-like predicate, comparison phrase, and purpose clause. per_sample.text: Chào chị, trong văn hóa Khmer, mối quan hệ giữa cha mẹ và con cái khi trưởng thành thường như thế nào ạ?
label: ជំរាបសួរបងស្រី ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ តើឪពុកម្តាយ និងកូននៅពេលធំឡើង មានទំនាក់ទំនងយ៉ាងណា?
per_sample.topic: Parents and children interactions as adult
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ជម្រាបសួរបងស្រី នៅក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ ទំនាក់ទំនងរវាងម៉ែឪនឹងកូនៗ ពេលកូនៗធំពេញវ័យហើយ ជាធម្មតាម៉េចដែរ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Xin chào chị, trong văn hóa Khmer, khi con cái lớn lên thì mối quan hệ giữa cha mẹ và con cái như thế nào?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning. It includes the greeting to an older sister, the cultural frame 'in Khmer culture', the relationship between parents and children, and the temporal condition of children being grown/adult. The phrase 'ពេលកូនៗធំពេញវ័យហើយ' appropriately renders 'khi trưởng thành', with a slight explicitation that the children are fully grown, but this does not distort the meaning. 'ជាធម្មតាម៉េចដែរ?' correctly captures 'thường như thế nào ạ?' in a natural interrogative form.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The address term 'បងស្រី' is pragmatically appropriate for Vietnamese 'chị'. The opening 'ជម្រាបសួរ' preserves politeness and respect. The hypothesis does not introduce inappropriate pronouns or social-role mismatches. The parental term 'ម៉ែឪ' is more colloquial than 'ឪពុកម្តាយ' but remains appropriate and understandable in Khmer usage.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliteration or hallucinated lexical items are present. Words such as 'វប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ', 'ទំនាក់ទំនង', 'ម៉ែឪ', 'កូនៗ', and 'ធំពេញវ័យ' are legitimate Khmer expressions. Although the localized dictionary context does not specifically list 'ម៉ែឪ', it is a real and common Khmer lexical item meaning parents. Nothing in the hypothesis appears to be an artificial phonetic copy from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure 'ទំនាក់ទំនងរវាងម៉ែឪនឹងកូនៗ...' is understandable and idiomatic enough, though 'និង' might be the more standard written conjunction than 'នឹង' in this context. The ending 'ម៉េចដែរ?' is conversational and slightly less formal than the source's polite Vietnamese 'ạ', but the overall sentence remains fluent and natural.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate and natural. It preserves the full informational content, uses appropriate address and politeness, and contains legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor stylistic colloquiality and the use of 'នឹង' where standard written Khmer may prefer 'និង' are not serious enough to affect comprehension or overall quality.

per_sample.text: Dạ, dù con cái đã lớn và lập gia đình, người Khmer vẫn giữ truyền thống yêu thương, tôn trọng và gắn bó chặt chẽ với cha mẹ.
label: ចាស ទោះបីកូនធំពេញវ័យ និងមានគ្រួសារក៏ដោយ ក៏ខ្មែរនៅតែរក្សាទំនៀមទំលាប់នៃការស្រលាញ់ គោរព និងរាប់អានយ៉ាងជិតស្និទ្ធជាមួយឪពុកម្តាយ។
per_sample.topic: Parents and children interactions as adult
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចា៎ ទោះបីកូនចៅធំដឹងក្តី ហើយមានគ្រួសាររៀងខ្លួនហើយ ក៏អ្នកខ្មែរនៅតែរក្សាទំនៀមទម្លាប់ស្រឡាញ់ គោរព និងស្និទ្ធស្នាលជាប់ចិត្តជាមួយម៉ែឪ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vâng, dù con cái đã trưởng thành và có gia đình riêng, người Khmer vẫn giữ gìn truyền thống yêu thương, kính trọng và gắn bó thân thiết với cha mẹ.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the Vietnamese source. “Dạ” is rendered politely as “ចា៎”; “dù con cái đã lớn và lập gia đình” is conveyed as “ទោះបីកូនចៅធំដឹងក្តី ហើយមានគ្រួសាររៀងខ្លួនហើយ,” which means children/offspring have matured and have their own families. “Người Khmer vẫn giữ truyền thống...” is correctly rendered as “ក៏អ្នកខ្មែរនៅតែរក្សាទំនៀមទម្លាប់...”. The ideas of love, respect, and close attachment to parents are preserved. Minor nuance differences include “កូនចៅ,” which can extend to descendants rather than only children, and “ជាប់ចិត្ត,” which is somewhat more emotional/idiomatic than the source’s neutral “gắn bó chặt chẽ,” but the core information remains faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “អ្នកខ្មែរ” appropriately for “người Khmer.” There are no problematic pronouns or inappropriate shifts in social hierarchy. “ម៉ែឪ” is a legitimate Khmer term for parents, somewhat more colloquial than “ឪពុកម្តាយ,” but acceptable in this context and not pragmatically inappropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliterations or hallucinated lexical items are present. Terms such as “កូនចៅ,” “ធំដឹងក្តី,” “ទំនៀមទម្លាប់,” “ស្រឡាញ់,” “គោរព,” “ស្និទ្ធស្នាល,” and “ម៉ែឪ” are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any issue requiring penalization.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and generally natural. The structure “ទោះបី... ក៏...” is correctly used. There is slight redundancy with “ហើយ...ហើយ,” and the phrase “ស្និទ្ធស្នាលជាប់ចិត្តជាមួយម៉ែឪ” is understandable but a little less smooth than the reference’s “រាប់អានយ៉ាងជិតស្និទ្ធជាមួយឪពុកម្តាយ.” Overall, the morpho-syntactic flow is good and fluent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is faithful, fluent, and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. It preserves the source meaning with only minor stylistic and nuance differences, especially the slightly colloquial “ម៉ែឪ” and the emotionally colored “ជាប់ចិត្ត.” These do not seriously affect comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Chị có thể nói rõ hơn về cách thể hiện sự tôn trọng trong mối quan hệ này không?
label: តើបងស្រីអាចពន្យល់ពីរបៀបបង្ហាញការគោរពក្នុងទំនាក់ទំនងនេះបានទេ?
per_sample.topic: Parents and children interactions as adult
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បងអាចនិយាយឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះ អំពីរបៀបបង្ហាញការគោរពក្នុងទំនាក់ទំនងនេះបានអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chị có thể giải thích cách thể hiện sự tôn trọng trong mối quan hệ này được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: asking whether the addressed woman can speak/explain more clearly about how respect is expressed in this relationship. The phrase "និយាយឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះ" accurately renders "nói rõ hơn" as 'speak more clearly / say more clearly.' The content about "របៀបបង្ហាញការគោរព" and "ក្នុងទំនាក់ទំនងនេះ" is semantically faithful. There is no major omission or distortion.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The Vietnamese pronoun "Chị" is best rendered as "បងស្រី" when the female gender and older-sister politeness are explicit, as in the human reference. The hypothesis uses "បង," which is a natural Khmer address term for an older person/sibling and can function pragmatically for Vietnamese "chị," but it is less gender-specific. This is a minor pragmatic loss, not a serious error.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: "បង," "អាច," "និយាយ," "ច្បាស់," "របៀប," "បង្ហាញ," "ការគោរព," and "ទំនាក់ទំនង" are all valid and contextually appropriate. No false transliteration or hallucinated lexical item is present. The localized dictionary entries do not indicate any problematic or suspicious form in the hypothesis.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically acceptable and flows naturally in Khmer, especially in a conversational register. The structure "បងអាច...បានអត់?" is colloquial but understandable and common. Compared with the more formal reference ending "បានទេ," "បានអត់" is slightly more informal, but it does not harm comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is accurate, fluent, and lexically legitimate. Its main minor issue is the use of gender-neutral "បង" instead of the more exact "បងស្រី" for Vietnamese "Chị," and the slightly informal question marker "បានអត់." These are non-critical and do not substantially affect meaning.

per_sample.text: Dạ, con cái Khmer luôn khoanh tay hay chắp tay đặt trên trán chào mỗi khi gặp cha mẹ, không ngồi cao hơn cha mẹ và tránh cãi lại lời khuyên của người lớn.
label: ចាស កូនខ្មែរតែងតែស្វាគមន៍ឪពុកម្តាយដោយឱបដៃឬលើកដែប្រណមដាក់លើថ្ងាសពេលជួបជុំឪពុកម្តាយ ហាមអង្គុយខ្ពស់ជាងឪពុកម្តាយនិងជៀសវាងការឈ្លោះប្រកែកវិញនៃការណែនាំរបស់អ្នកធំ។
per_sample.topic: Parents and children interactions as adult
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចាស កូនចៅខ្មែរតែងតែឱបដៃ ឬសំពះដាក់លើថ្ងាសគោរព ពេលណាជួបម៉ែឪ មិនអង្គុយខ្ពស់ជាងម៉ែឪ ហើយចៀសវាងជជែកតបពាក្យប្រដៅរបស់ចាស់ទុំ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vâng, con cái người Khmer luôn chào hỏi cha mẹ bằng cách khoanh tay hoặc chắp tay đưa lên trán khi gặp cha mẹ; không được ngồi cao hơn cha mẹ và tránh cãi lại những lời khuyên dạy của người lớn.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the main informational content accurately: Khmer children/descendants habitually fold their arms or perform a respectful sampeah with hands placed at the forehead when meeting parents, do not sit higher than parents, and avoid responding argumentatively to elders' instruction/advice. 'ពាក្យប្រដៅ' is slightly stronger than 'lời khuyên' but remains semantically close in this cultural context.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The rendering uses appropriate kinship and social terms. 'កូនចៅខ្មែរ' is suitable for 'con cái Khmer'; 'ម៉ែឪ' is a natural colloquial/regional equivalent of parents; and 'ចាស់ទុំ' appropriately conveys elders/adults with social authority. The polite Vietnamese opening 'Dạ' is rendered as 'ចាស', which is pragmatically appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary is present. Terms such as 'ឱបដៃ', 'សំពះ', 'ថ្ងាស', 'ម៉ែឪ', 'ខ្ពស់', 'ចៀសវាង', and 'ចាស់ទុំ' are legitimate Khmer lexical items. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any conflict; the hypothesis uses valid Khmer expressions rather than phonetic copying from Vietnamese.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and natural. The sequence 'សំពះដាក់លើថ្ងាសគោរព' is understandable though slightly less smooth than a more idiomatic ordering such as explicitly saying 'សំពះគោរពដោយដាក់ដៃលើថ្ងាស'. 'ពេលណាជួប' is acceptable for 'whenever meeting', and the rest of the clause structure flows well.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a strong translation with accurate meaning, culturally appropriate kinship terms, and legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor stylistic awkwardness appears in the phrasing of the sampeah gesture and the slightly stronger nuance of 'ពាក្យប្រដៅ', but these do not significantly harm comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Khi có điều gì không đồng ý, con cái thường tranh cãi rõ ràng và mạnh mẽ để cha mẹ hiểu quan điểm của mình, nhất là trong chuyện làm ăn.
label: នៅពេលដែលមិនយល់ស្របលើអ្វីមួយ កូនតែងតែជជែកគ្នាយ៉ាងច្បាស់ និងក្លាហានមានយោបល់ ដើម្បីឲ្យឪពុកម្តាយយល់ពីទស្សនៈរបស់ខ្លួន ជាពិសេសក្នុងវិស័យជំនួញ។
per_sample.topic: Parents and children interactions as adult
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ពេលមានរឿងអីដែលមិនយល់ស្រប កូនចៅតែងតែប្រកែកតវ៉ាច្បាស់ៗ ហើយមាំៗ ដើម្បីឲ្យម៉ែឪយល់ពីយោបល់របស់ខ្លួន ជាពិសេសក្នុងរឿងធ្វើរកស៊ី។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Khi không đồng ý về điều gì đó, con luôn trao đổi thẳng thắn và mạnh dạn nêu ý kiến để cha mẹ hiểu quan điểm của mình, nhất là trong lĩnh vực kinh doanh.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: when there is something disagreed with, children argue clearly and strongly so that parents understand their viewpoint, especially in matters of business or livelihood. "ប្រកែកតវ៉ា" accurately conveys arguing/contesting, though it has a slightly stronger protestive nuance than neutral "tranh cãi." "យោបល់" is a close rendering of "quan điểm," and "ធ្វើរកស៊ី" is an appropriate equivalent for "làm ăn." No major information is omitted or added.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The rendering "កូនចៅ" for "con cái" is acceptable, though somewhat broader than simply children, as it can include descendants. "ម៉ែឪ" for "cha mẹ" is colloquial and regionally natural, especially in Khmer Krom or Southern Khmer usage, and should not be penalized. The reflexive phrase "របស់ខ្លួន" correctly refers to the children's own viewpoint/opinion.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary and does not show signs of false phonetic transliteration. Terms such as "កូនចៅ," "ប្រកែកតវ៉ា," "ម៉ែឪ," and "ធ្វើរកស៊ី" are authentic and contextually appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic hallucinated forms; the wording aligns with real Khmer/Khm​​er Krom usage.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally in a colloquial Khmer style. "ពេលមានរឿងអីដែលមិនយល់ស្រប" is understandable, though slightly informal and less polished than the reference's "នៅពេលដែលមិនយល់ស្របលើអ្វីមួយ." The pair "ច្បាស់ៗ ហើយមាំៗ" is also colloquial but conveys the intended adverbial force. Overall morpho-syntactic quality is strong.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a faithful, natural, and lexically legitimate Khmer translation with only minor stylistic differences from the human reference. The use of colloquial/regional forms such as "ម៉ែឪ" and "ធ្វើរកស៊ី" is appropriate and should be accepted. Minor nuance differences, such as the slightly stronger tone of "ប្រកែកតវ៉ា" and the broader "កូនចៅ," do not significantly affect comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Còn tình cảm yêu thương giữa cha mẹ và con cái thì được thể hiện ra sao ạ?
label: តើទឹកចិត្តស្រឡាញ់រវាងឪពុកម្តាយនិងកូនបានបង្ហាញយ៉ាងណា?
per_sample.topic: Parents and children interactions as adult
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ចុះ​មនោសញ្ចេតនា​ស្រឡាញ់​រវាង​ម៉ែឪ​នឹង​កូនៗ ត្រូវ​បាន​បង្ហាញ​ចេញ​យ៉ាង​ម៉េច​ដែរ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tình yêu thương giữa cha mẹ và con cái được thể hiện như thế nào?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: it asks how the loving/emotional affection between parents and children is expressed. "មនោសញ្ចេតនា​ស្រឡាញ់" corresponds well to "tình cảm yêu thương," and "ត្រូវ​បាន​បង្ហាញ​ចេញ​យ៉ាង​ម៉េច" faithfully renders "được thể hiện ra sao." The opening "ចុះ" appropriately reflects the discourse function of Vietnamese "Còn" in this interrogative context.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns requiring social-hierarchy handling. The kinship expression "ម៉ែឪ" is a legitimate and natural Khmer expression for parents, somewhat more colloquial than "ឪពុកម្តាយ" but pragmatically appropriate. "កូនៗ" is also suitable for "con cái." The Vietnamese polite particle "ạ" is not explicitly rendered, but the human reference also omits a direct politeness marker, so this is not a significant issue.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, natural, and pragmatically appropriate. Minor potential ambiguity in 'រាល់អាទិត្យ' and slight redundancy in 'សួរសុខទុក្ខពីសុខភាព' do not materially affect comprehension or fidelity.

linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer. “ចុះបើ,” “រឿងទាស់ទែងគ្នា,” “អ្នកខ្មែរ,” “ធម្មតា,” “ដោះស្រាយ,” and “យ៉ាងម៉េច” are authentic and contextually appropriate. linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the main meaning of the Vietnamese source. “Dạ” is rendered as “ចាស,” “người lớn dạy con” as “មនុស្សធំៗប្រដៅកូន,” and the quoted moral instruction is transferred clearly. “ស្អប់ក៏ស្អប់ទៅ តែមិនត្រូវខុសគួរសម” captures the idea of ‘hate if you hate, but do not be discourteous.’ The latter part, “ទោះខឹងប៉ុណ្ណាក៏ដោយ ក៏ត្រូវរក្សាកិរិយាគួរសម,” faithfully expresses ‘no matter how angry, one must maintain proper manners.’ The only notable semantic shift is “មិនត្រូវបោះបង់ម៉ែឪទេ,” which means ‘must not abandon parents,’ somewhat stronger than Vietnamese “không bỏ bê cha mẹ” meaning ‘not neglect parents.’ However, the intended filial responsibility remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis handles social and pragmatic relationships appropriately. “ចាស” correctly reflects the respectful Vietnamese particle “Dạ.” “កូន” is suitable for ‘children/offspring’ in the instructional context. “ម៉ែឪ” is a legitimate Khmer expression for parents, somewhat more colloquial than “ឪពុកម្តាយ,” but not inappropriate. There is no problematic pronoun or honorific mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary rather than false transliterations. “ខឹង” is confirmed in the localized dictionary context as meaning ‘giận,’ matching the source. “គួរសម” corresponds to politeness/propriety, and “ប្រដៅ,” “រក្សា,” “កិរិយា,” and “បោះបង់” are all valid Khmer terms. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure with “ដូច្នេះ,” “ទោះ...ក៏ដោយ,” and “ក៏ត្រូវ...” is well formed. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation that preserves the source’s moral and pragmatic message. Minor issues include a slightly stronger rendering of ‘bỏ bê’ as ‘abandon’ and a somewhat less idiomatic phrase for ‘thất lễ.’ These do not seriously impair comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មនុស្សច្រើនគ្នាក៏និមន្តលោកសង្ឃមកផ្ទះសូត្រធម៌ ឬសុំដំបូន្មានពីចាស់ទុំក្នុងភូមិ ដើម្បីផ្សះផ្សារឿងមិនត្រូវគ្នា។
