per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: នោះជាវិធីសម្តែងការដឹងគុណចំពោះព្រះសង្ឃ ព្រមទាំងបួងសួងសុំឲ្យគ្រួសារ និងសហគមន៍បានសុខសាន្ត ហើយស្រែចម្ការបានផលបរិបូណ៌។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đây là cách bày tỏ lòng biết ơn đối với chư Tăng, đồng thời cầu nguyện cho gia đình và cộng đồng được bình an, mùa màng bội thu.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the full meaning of the Vietnamese source. “នោះជាវិធីសម្តែងការដឹងគុណ” correctly renders “Đó là cách bày tỏ sự tri ân”; “ចំពោះព្រះសង្ឃ” accurately captures “chư tăng”; “ព្រមទាំងបួងសួងសុំឲ្យ” correctly conveys “đồng thời cầu nguyện cho.” The final phrase “ស្រែចម្ការបានផលបរិបូណ៌” is a natural semantic rendering of “mùa màng bội thu,” expressing abundant agricultural yield. No core information is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns in the hypothesis. The religious referent “chư tăng” is appropriately rendered as “ព្រះសង្ឃ,” which is respectful and pragmatically suitable in Khmer Buddhist context. The tone is socially and religiously appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: “វិធី,” “សម្តែង,” “ការដឹងគុណ,” “ព្រះសង្ឃ,” “បួងសួង,” “គ្រួសារ,” “សហគមន៍,” “សុខសាន្ត,” and “ផលបរិបូណ៌” are all valid and contextually appropriate. There is no evidence of false phonetic transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting interpretation; the standard form “គ្រួសារ” is acceptable for ‘family.’
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and fluent in Khmer. The structure follows a natural Khmer sequence: demonstrative subject + copular construction + expression of gratitude + coordinated prayer clause. “ព្រមទាំង” and “ហើយ” are used naturally to coordinate the clauses. Word order and clause linkage are smooth.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation hypothesis is highly faithful to the source, pragmatically appropriate, lexically legitimate, and morpho-syntactically fluent. Minor wording differences from the human reference, such as “វិធី” instead of “របៀប” and “ស្រែចម្ការ” instead of “ប្រមូលផល,” are acceptable and semantically equivalent.

per_sample.text: Ngoài chuẩn bị lễ vật, không khí trong phum sóc những ngày trước lễ có gì đặc biệt?
label: ក្រៅពីរៀបចំចង្ហាន់បច្ច័យ តើបរិយាកាសក្នុងភូមិមុនថ្ងៃបុណ្យមានអ្វីប្លែកទេ?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្រៅពីរៀបចំគ្រឿងសក្ការៈបូជា បរិយាកាសក្នុងភូមិស្រុកប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃមុនបុណ្យ មានអីពិសេសខ្លះ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài việc chuẩn bị đồ cúng dường, bầu không khí trong làng trước ngày lễ có gì khác lạ không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: besides preparing ceremonial offerings, it asks what is special about the atmosphere in the phum sóc/village community in the days before the festival. "គ្រឿងសក្ការៈបូជា" is a valid rendering of "lễ vật," though it leans slightly toward worship/ritual offerings. "ប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃមុនបុណ្យ" correctly captures "những ngày trước lễ," and "មានអីពិសេសខ្លះ" matches "có gì đặc biệt." Overall informational fidelity is very strong.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns or kinship/honorific forms in the source or hypothesis. The hypothesis uses a neutral question style appropriate for the context. No pragmatic or social-hierarchy errors are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary in the hypothesis is legitimate Khmer: "ក្រៅពី," "រៀបចំ," "គ្រឿងសក្ការៈបូជា," "បរិយាកាស," "ភូមិស្រុក," "បុណ្យ," and "ពិសេស" are all authentic. "ភូមិស្រុក" is acceptable for referring broadly to village/local community space and is not a false transliteration. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any contradiction requiring penalty.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and natural overall. The lack of an explicit interrogative marker such as "តើ" is acceptable in colloquial Khmer question formation. The phrase "បរិយាកាសក្នុងភូមិស្រុកប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃមុនបុណ្យ" is slightly compressed and could be smoother with an added temporal linker, but it remains fluent and clear.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, lexically legitimate, and mostly natural. Minor stylistic compression and the slightly more religious nuance of "គ្រឿងសក្ការៈបូជា" do not materially affect comprehension.

per_sample.text: Mọi người dọn dẹp nhà cửa, dựng cờ phướn, treo đèn lồng, tạo bầu không khí linh thiêng và tràn ngập niềm hân hoan.
label: មនុស្សម្នាសម្អាតផ្ទះ ដោតទង់ព្រលឹង ឬទង់ជ័យ ព្យួរគោម បង្កើតបរិយាកាសស័ក្តិសិទ្ធិ និងពោរពេញដោយក្តីរីករាយ។
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: គ្រប់គ្នានាំគ្នាបោសសម្អាតផ្ទះសម្បែង ដោតទង់បដា ព្យួរគោម ធ្វើឲ្យបរិយាកាសសក្តិសិទ្ធិ ហើយពេញដោយសេចក្តីអររីករាយ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Mọi người dọn dẹp nhà cửa, cắm cờ hồn hoặc cờ chiến thắng, treo đèn lồng, tạo nên bầu không khí linh thiêng và tràn ngập niềm vui.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main informational content of the Vietnamese source: everyone cleans the house, raises/puts up banners or flags, hangs lanterns, and creates a sacred, joyful atmosphere. “គ្រប់គ្នានាំគ្នាបោសសម្អាតផ្ទះសម្បែង” is a faithful rendering of “Mọi người dọn dẹp nhà cửa.” “ព្យួរគោម” correctly renders “treo đèn lồng.” The phrase “ដោតទង់បដា” is semantically acceptable for erecting flags/banners, though it is less culturally specific than the reference’s “ទង់ព្រលឹង ឬទង់ជ័យ” for religious/festival pennants. “ធ្វើឲ្យបរិយាកាសសក្តិសិទ្ធិ ហើយពេញដោយសេចក្តីអររីករាយ” conveys the sacred and joyful atmosphere, though it slightly weakens the nuance of “tạo bầu không khí” as ‘create an atmosphere’ and “tràn ngập” as ‘overflowing/filled abundantly.’ Overall meaning is preserved with minor nuance loss.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or honorifics in this sentence. “គ្រប់គ្នា” is an appropriate and natural equivalent of “Mọi người.” No kinship, status, religious honorific, or social hierarchy issue arises here. The collective subject is handled well.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary used in the hypothesis is legitimate Khmer and does not show false transliteration. “បោសសម្អាត,” “ផ្ទះសម្បែង,” “ទង់បដា,” “ព្យួរគោម,” “បរិយាកាស,” “សក្តិសិទ្ធិ,” and “សេចក្តីអររីករាយ” are recognizable Khmer expressions. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any need to reinterpret unusual terms here; no suspicious regional or hallucinated lexical item appears. “ទង់បដា” is general but valid, although less specific than the reference’s Khmer religious/festival flag terminology.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and flows naturally. The sequence of actions is clear and follows Khmer syntax well. “គ្រប់គ្នានាំគ្នា...” is idiomatic for collective action. A minor stylistic issue appears in “ធ្វើឲ្យបរិយាកាសសក្តិសិទ្ធិ,” which would be more polished as “បង្កើតបរិយាកាសស័ក្តិសិទ្ធិ” or “ធ្វើឲ្យបរិយាកាសមានភាពស័ក្តិសិទ្ធិ.” The spelling/form “សក្តិសិទ្ធិ” is understandable but less standard than “ស័ក្តិសិទ្ធិ.” “សេចក្តីអររីករាយ” is comprehensible though somewhat redundant/stylistically less smooth than “ក្តីរីករាយ” or “អំណរសប្បាយ.”
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is good overall: it preserves the core meaning, uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and is mostly fluent. The main limitations are minor cultural specificity loss in translating “cờ phướn,” slight weakening of the ‘overflowing with joy’ nuance, and a few stylistic/morpho-syntactic rough spots. No serious mistranslation or lexical hallucination is present.

per_sample.text: Tôi nghe nói đêm giao thừa trong văn hóa Khmer rất quan trọng, anh có thể nói rõ hơn không?
label: ខ្ញុំឮថារាត្រីឆ្លងឆ្នាំក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរមានសារៈសំខាន់ណាស់ លោកអាចបញ្ជាក់បន្ថែមបានទេ?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា យប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ សំខាន់ណាស់ បងអាចប្រាប់ឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះបានអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi nghe nói đêm giao thừa trong văn hóa Khmer rất quan trọng, ông có thể giải thích thêm được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: 'Tôi nghe nói' is rendered naturally as 'ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា'; 'đêm giao thừa' is rendered as 'យប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ', which is semantically equivalent to 'New Year's Eve/crossing-year night'; 'trong văn hóa Khmer rất quan trọng' is correctly conveyed as 'ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ សំខាន់ណាស់'. The request 'anh có thể nói rõ hơn không?' is translated as 'បងអាចប្រាប់ឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះបានអត់?', which preserves the communicative intent of asking for further clarification. No significant information is omitted or added.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The source uses 'anh', a Vietnamese second-person kinship/pronoun form. The hypothesis uses 'បង', which is an appropriate Khmer kinship-based address term corresponding well to Vietnamese 'anh' in many conversational contexts. Although the human reference uses the more formal 'លោក', the hypothesis's 'បង' is pragmatically acceptable and natural for a less formal interpersonal register. The sentence-final 'បានអត់?' is colloquial but fits the conversational tone of the source.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated forms. Terms such as 'ឮគេនិយាយថា', 'យប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ', 'វប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ', 'សំខាន់ណាស់', and 'ប្រាប់ឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះ' are valid and contextually appropriate. The localized dictionary entries provided do not indicate any problematic or suspicious lexical usage in the hypothesis.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The hypothesis is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The clause structure is coherent: 'ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា...' followed by the embedded proposition, then the clarification request. Word order is natural, and the construction 'អាចប្រាប់ឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះបានអត់?' is idiomatic colloquial Khmer. Minor punctuation spacing differences do not affect readability or grammar.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation hypothesis is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, lexically legitimate, and syntactically natural. Its register is slightly more colloquial than the human reference, but this aligns well with the Vietnamese source's use of 'anh' and question-final 'không'. Overall, it is a high-quality Khmer rendering of the Vietnamese sentence.

per_sample.text: Đêm giao thừa là khoảnh khắc thiêng liêng, khi mọi người tụ tập ở chùa, đốt nhang, dâng lễ, cùng chờ đón năm mới.
label: រាត្រីឆ្លងឆ្នាំគឺជាពេលវេលាដ៏ពិសិដ្ឋបំផុត ដែលអ្នកភូមិជួបជុំគ្នានៅវត្ត ដុតធូប វេរចង្ហាន់ ហើយរង់ចាំទទួលឆ្នាំថ្មីជាមួយគ្នា។
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: យប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំជាវេលាដ៏សក្ការៈ ដែលមនុស្សម្នាជួបជុំគ្នានៅវត្ត ដុតធូប ថ្វាយគ្រឿងសក្ការៈ ហើយរួមគ្នារង់ចាំទទួលឆ្នាំថ្មី។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đêm giao thừa là thời khắc thiêng liêng nhất, khi dân làng tụ họp tại chùa, thắp hương, dâng cơm cúng dường và cùng nhau chờ đón năm mới.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. “Đêm giao thừa” is rendered as “យប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ,” which is appropriate for New Year’s Eve. “Khoảnh khắc thiêng liêng” becomes “វេលាដ៏សក្ការៈ,” conveying a sacred/solemn time, though slightly less emphatic than the reference’s “ដ៏ពិសិដ្ឋបំផុត.” The actions of gathering at the temple, burning incense, offering ritual items, and waiting together to welcome the new year are all preserved. “ថ្វាយគ្រឿងសក្ការៈ” is a suitable rendering of “dâng lễ.”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or inappropriate honorifics. “មនុស្សម្នា” appropriately conveys the general sense of “mọi người.” The religious verb “ថ្វាយ” is pragmatically suitable for offerings in a temple context. The hypothesis maintains appropriate social and ritual register.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer expressions, not false transliterations. “យប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ,” “វត្ត,” “ដុតធូប,” “ថ្វាយគ្រឿងសក្ការៈ,” and “រង់ចាំទទួលឆ្នាំថ្មី” are all valid and contextually appropriate. Although the localized dictionary lists separate entries for “រង់,” the compound “រង់ចាំ” is standard Khmer for ‘wait,’ so this is not a hallucination or misuse.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The sequencing of clauses mirrors the source logically: New Year’s Eve as a sacred time, people gathering at the temple, performing ritual acts, and waiting together for the new year. Word order and coordination are smooth.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, natural, and pragmatically appropriate. Minor nuance differences exist, such as “វេលា” being broader than ‘moment’ and “ដ៏សក្ការៈ” being slightly less precise than “ដ៏ពិសិដ្ឋ,” but these do not meaningfully affect comprehension or fidelity. Overall, it is a native-level rendering.

per_sample.text: Trong đêm giao thừa, có hoạt động nào khác ngoài nghi lễ dâng hương không?
label: តើនៅយប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំថ្មី មានសកម្មភាពអ្វីផ្សេងទៀត ក្រៅពីពិធីបួងសួងទេ?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្នុងយប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ មានសកម្មភាពអីផ្សេងទៀត ក្រៅពីពិធីថ្វាយធូបដែរអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vào đêm giao thừa, ngoài lễ cầu nguyện ra còn có hoạt động nào khác không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the source meaning: it asks whether there are any other activities during New Year's Eve besides the incense-offering ritual. 'ក្នុងយប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ' corresponds well to 'Trong đêm giao thừa', though it omits 'ថ្មី' found in the reference; this does not materially affect the meaning. 'ពិធីថ្វាយធូប' is a very direct and accurate rendering of 'nghi lễ dâng hương'. Overall informational fidelity is excellent.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns, kinship terms, or honorific relations in the source. The hypothesis does not introduce inappropriate social deixis or hierarchy. The use of the colloquial question ending 'ដែរអត់' is pragmatically acceptable, though slightly more conversational than the source/reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All key lexical items are legitimate Khmer: 'សកម្មភាព', 'អី', 'ផ្សេងទៀត', 'ក្រៅពី', 'ពិធី', 'ថ្វាយធូប'. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any conflict; the hypothesis uses standard, valid Khmer lexical choices.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and natural overall. 'ក្នុងយប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំ' is understandable, though 'នៅយប់ឆ្លងឆ្នាំថ្មី' may sound slightly more idiomatic and closer to the reference. The structure 'មានសកម្មភាពអីផ្សេងទៀត ក្រៅពី...' is fluent, and the final interrogative 'ដែរអត់' works naturally in colloquial Khmer.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, lexically valid, and pragmatically appropriate. Minor stylistic differences include a more colloquial interrogative form and a slightly less formal phrasing than the reference, but these do not significantly reduce comprehension or accuracy.

per_sample.text: Có, chư tăng tụng kinh cầu an, người dân cùng chắp tay thành kính, cảm nhận sự an lạc lan tỏa khắp phum sóc.
label: មាន ព្រះសង្ឃសូត្រមន្តបួងសួងសុំសេចក្តីសុខ ប្រជាពលរដ្ឋព្រមគ្នាលើកដៃប្រណម្យ ដោយគោរពជ្រះថ្លា ទទួលយកភាពស្ងប់សុខដែលសាយភាយពាសពេញភូមិស្រុក។
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មាន, លោកសង្ឃសូត្រធម៌បួងសួងសុំសុខសាន្ត អ្នកស្រុកក៏ផ្គុំដៃសំពះដោយចិត្តគោរព មានអារម្មណ៍ថាសេចក្តីសុខសាន្តរាលដាលពេញទាំងភូមិស្រុក។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Các vị sư tụng kinh cầu an, bà con đồng loạt chắp tay thành kính, đón nhận sự bình yên lan tỏa khắp phum sóc.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: the presence of monks chanting/praying for peace, the local people clasping their hands reverently, and the feeling of peace spreading throughout the community. 'សូត្រធម៌បួងសួងសុំសុខសាន្ត' is semantically close to 'tụng kinh cầu an', and 'សេចក្តីសុខសាន្តរាលដាលពេញទាំងភូមិស្រុក' corresponds well to 'sự an lạc lan tỏa khắp phum sóc'. Minor nuance loss exists because 'an lạc' has a slightly Buddhist/inner-peace resonance, while 'សុខសាន្ត' is more general peace/tranquility, but this is not a serious error.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The rendering uses 'លោកសង្ឃ' for 'chư tăng'. This is respectful and understandable, though 'ព្រះសង្ឃ' or 'ព្រះសង្ឃទាំងឡាយ' would be more canonical and closer to the human reference in a religious context. 'អ្នកស្រុក' appropriately captures 'người dân' in a community setting. No problematic pronouns or social hierarchy violations occur.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and not a false transliteration. 'រាលដាល' is a standard Khmer expression meaning to spread or diffuse, despite the localized dictionary listing separate entries such as 'រាល' and 'រាលដ'. Here the compound is contextually correct. 'ផ្គុំដៃសំពះ', 'សូត្រធម៌', 'បួងសួង', and 'ភូមិស្រុក' are all valid and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The sequence of clauses mirrors the source while remaining idiomatic. The comma after 'មាន' is slightly awkward typographically, but it does not affect comprehension. Overall word order and clause linkage are smooth.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation with accurate semantic transfer, natural Khmer phrasing, and appropriate religious/community vocabulary. The main minor issue is the use of 'លោកសង្ឃ' instead of the more formal or conventional 'ព្រះសង្ឃ' for 'chư tăng', and a slight generalization of the Buddhist nuance of 'an lạc'. These are minor and do not undermine the translation.

per_sample.text: Anh có thể giải thích thêm về vai trò của việc tụng kinh trước lễ chính?
label: បងអាចពន្យល់បន្ថែមអំពីតួនាទីនៃការសូត្រមន្តមុនបុណ្យធំបានទេ?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បងអាចពន្យល់បន្ថែមអំពីតួនាទីនៃការសូត្រធម៌មុនពិធីធំបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Anh/chị có thể giải thích thêm về vai trò của việc tụng kinh trước các lễ lớn được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the Vietnamese source meaning. “បងអាចពន្យល់បន្ថែម” corresponds well to “Anh có thể giải thích thêm,” and “អំពីតួនាទីនៃការ...” correctly renders “về vai trò của việc...”. The phrase “ការសូត្រធម៌” is an appropriate Khmer rendering of “tụng kinh,” especially in a Buddhist/religious context. “មុនពិធីធំ” conveys the idea of before the major/main ceremony, aligning acceptably with “trước lễ chính.”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “បង” for Vietnamese “Anh” is pragmatically appropriate in Khmer, especially for addressing an older male or respectful familiar interlocutor. The sentence maintains a polite question structure with “បានទេ,” matching the source’s request form.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. “តួនាទី” is confirmed by the localized dictionary context as meaning “vai trò.” “សូត្រធម៌” is a valid religious expression meaning reciting/chanting Dharma or scripture, not a false transliteration. No hallucinated or spurious lexical forms are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The hypothesis is grammatically well-formed and natural in Khmer. Word order is coherent: subject/request marker + explanation verb phrase + topic phrase + nominalized action + temporal phrase + question ending. The construction flows naturally and is readily understandable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, lexically legitimate, and morpho-syntactically fluent. Differences from the reference, such as “សូត្រធម៌” instead of “សូត្រមន្ត” and “ពិធីធំ” instead of “បុណ្យធំ,” are acceptable contextual variants and do not materially affect meaning.

per_sample.text: Tụng kinh là để gột rửa tâm hồn, gieo niềm tin thiện lành, giúp bà con bước vào lễ với tâm thế thanh tịnh.
label: ការសូត្រមន្តគឺដើម្បីលាងជម្រះចិត្តគំនិត បណ្តុះជំនឿល្អបរិសុទ្ធ ជួយឲ្យបងប្អូនចូលបុណ្យដោយចិត្តស្ងប់បរិសុទ្ធ ។
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ការសូត្រធម៌ គឺដើម្បីជម្រះចិត្តគំនិត បណ្តុះជំនឿល្អបរិសុទ្ធ ជួយឲ្យបងប្អូនចូលពិធីបុណ្យដោយចិត្តស្ងប់ស្អាត។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Việc tụng kinh là để gột rửa tâm trí, nuôi dưỡng niềm tin tốt đẹp, trong sáng, giúp bà con dự lễ với tâm thanh tịnh, an yên.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source very well. “ការសូត្រធម៌” is an acceptable rendering of “tụng kinh,” though slightly broader than “សូត្រមន្ត/សូត្រគម្ពីរ.” “ជម្រះចិត្តគំនិត” adequately conveys cleansing the mind/soul, though it is a little less explicit than “លាងជម្រះ.” “បណ្តុះជំនឿល្អបរិសុទ្ធ” accurately captures “gieo niềm tin thiện lành.” “ជួយឲ្យបងប្អូនចូលពិធីបុណ្យ” corresponds well to helping people enter the ceremony/festival. The phrase “ដោយចិត្តស្ងប់ស្អាត” conveys calm and clean-heartedness, but “ស្អាត” is slightly less religiously precise than “បរិសុទ្ធ/ thanh tịnh.” Overall meaning is faithful with only minor nuance loss.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The phrase “បងប្អូន” is pragmatically appropriate for Vietnamese “bà con,” reflecting a communal, respectful address suitable for religious and community contexts. There are no problematic pronouns, honorifics, or hierarchy mismatches.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. The localized dictionary confirms forms such as “គឺ” and “គំនិត.” There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated Khmer-like forms. Religious vocabulary such as “សូត្រធម៌” and “ពិធីបុណ្យ” is natural and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure mirrors the source logically: purpose of chanting, cultivating belief, and preparing the community for the ceremony. Word order and clause linkage are smooth. The final phrase “ចិត្តស្ងប់ស្អាត” is understandable, though slightly less idiomatic than “ចិត្តស្ងប់បរិសុទ្ធ.”
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation with accurate semantic transfer, appropriate communal address, legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and natural syntax. Minor issues are limited to nuanced religious register: “សូត្រធម៌” is a little broader than chanting sutras, and “ស្អាត” is less precise than “បរិសុទ្ធ” for spiritual purity. These do not significantly impair comprehension.

per_sample.text: Trẻ em và người trẻ trong cộng đồng có tham gia những hoạt động này không?
label: តើកុមារ និងយុវជនក្នុងសហគមន៍ចូលរួមក្នុងសកម្មភាពទាំងនេះដែរឬទេ?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: កូនក្មេង និងអ្នកវ័យក្មេងក្នុងសហគមន៍ មានចូលរួមសកម្មភាពទាំងនេះអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Trẻ em và thanh thiếu niên trong cộng đồng có tham gia các hoạt động này không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: it asks whether children and young people in the community participate in these activities. 'កូនក្មេង' corresponds well to 'trẻ em', 'អ្នកវ័យក្មេង' to 'người trẻ', 'ក្នុងសហគមន៍' to 'trong cộng đồng', and 'សកម្មភាពទាំងនេះ' to 'những hoạt động này'. The yes/no question meaning is preserved through 'អត់'. No significant informational loss or distortion is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns or honorific relations in the sentence. The subject terms are socially appropriate and understandable. 'កូនក្មេង' is somewhat more colloquial than 'កុមារ', but it is pragmatically acceptable for 'children'. 'អ្នកវ័យក្មេង' is also appropriate for 'young people'.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary, not false transliterations. The dictionary context confirms relevant elements such as 'ចូល' meaning 'vào/vô', which appears in 'ចូលរួម'. Other words such as 'កូនក្មេង', 'អ្នកវ័យក្មេង', 'សហគមន៍', and 'សកម្មភាព' are standard and valid. No hallucinated or fake lexical forms are detected.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and natural in a colloquial Khmer register. The structure 'មានចូលរួម...អត់?' is a common spoken yes/no question pattern. A more formal version would include 'ក្នុង' before 'សកម្មភាពទាំងនេះ', as in the reference, but the omission does not seriously affect comprehension. Overall flow is good, though slightly less formal and polished than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is semantically faithful, lexically legitimate, and pragmatically appropriate. Its main difference from the reference is register: it uses more colloquial forms such as 'កូនក្មេង' and 'អត់', and slightly less formal syntax. These are minor issues and do not undermine the meaning.

per_sample.text: Có chứ, các em được cha mẹ dẫn đi chùa, học cách dâng lễ, chắp tay cầu nguyện và lắng nghe tiếng tụng kinh.
label: មានតើ ពួកគាត់ត្រូវបានឪពុកម្តាយនាំទៅវត្ត រៀនពីរបៀបប្រគេនចង្ហាន់ លើកដៃបួងសួង និងស្តាប់ព្រះសង្ឃសូត្រមន្ត។
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បានតើ កូនក្មេងត្រូវឪម៉ែនាំទៅវត្ត រៀនរបៀបថ្វាយបូជា ផ្គុំដៃបន់ស្រន់ ហើយស្ដាប់សំឡេងសូត្រធម៌។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Có chứ, các em được cha mẹ dẫn đến chùa, học cách dâng cơm cúng dường chư tăng, chắp tay cầu nguyện và nghe các sư tụng kinh.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the core meaning accurately: children are taken by parents to the pagoda, learn how to make offerings, join hands to pray, and listen to chanting. "បានតើ" conveys an affirmative response similar to "Có chứ," though slightly more like "yes/can indeed" than the reference's "មានតើ." "ថ្វាយបូជា" is semantically acceptable for "dâng lễ," though somewhat more general than the reference's Buddhist-specific "ប្រគេនចង្ហាន់." "ស្ដាប់សំឡេងសូត្រធម៌" captures listening to chanting, but loses a small nuance of attentive listening in "lắng nghe." Overall fidelity is strong with minor specificity differences.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: "កូនក្មេង" is a reasonable rendering of "các em" in the sense of children/young ones, though it is less relational or socially nuanced than a kinship-based form. "ឪម៉ែ" for parents is colloquial and acceptable in Khmer usage, including regional Khmer Krom contexts, and does not create a hierarchy problem. No inappropriate honorific misuse is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: "ឪម៉ែ," "វត្ត," "ថ្វាយបូជា," "ផ្គុំដៃ," "បន់ស្រន់," and "សូត្រធម៌" are authentic expressions, not false transliterations. The localized dictionary lists a variant related to "chắp" as "ខាឹប," but the hypothesis's "ផ្គុំដៃ" is also a standard and legitimate way to express joining the hands. No hallucinated or phonetic-copy forms are detected.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and flows naturally. The structure "កូនក្មេងត្រូវឪម៉ែនាំទៅវត្ត" is understandable, though "ត្រូវបាន...នាំ" would be more formal and syntactically complete for the passive sense "được...dẫn." The coordination of actions with "រៀន..., ផ្គុំដៃ..., ហើយស្ដាប់..." is clear and natural. Minor stylistic roughness remains but does not impede comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a good translation with high intelligibility and accurate semantic transfer. Minor issues include reduced specificity for Buddhist offering practice, slight loss of the nuance of "lắng nghe," and a somewhat less formal passive construction. Lexically, the translation is legitimate and regionally acceptable.

per_sample.text: Vậy người cao tuổi giữ vai trò như thế nào trong giai đoạn chuẩn bị trước lễ?
label: ចុះអ្នកវ័យចំណាស់រក្សាតួនាទីបែបណាក្នុងដំណាក់កាលត្រៀមខ្លួនមុនបុណ្យ?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ៊ីចឹង ចាស់ទុំមានតួនាទីយ៉ាងណា ក្នុងដំណាក់កាលរៀបចំមុនពិធីបុណ្យ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Vậy người cao tuổi giữ vai trò như thế nào trong giai đoạn chuẩn bị trước lễ hội?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source question. Vietnamese 'Vậy' is rendered as 'អ៊ីចឹង' meaning 'so/therefore'; 'người cao tuổi' is rendered as 'ចាស់ទុំ' meaning elders or senior respected people; 'giữ vai trò như thế nào' is expressed as 'មានតួនាទីយ៉ាងណា' meaning 'what role do they have'; and 'trong giai đoạn chuẩn bị trước lễ' is rendered as 'ក្នុងដំណាក់កាលរៀបចំមុនពិធីបុណ្យ'. The shift from 'giữ vai trò' to 'មានតួនាទី' is semantically natural and does not lose information. 'ពិធីបុណ្យ' is slightly more explicit than 'lễ' but remains faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject expression 'ចាស់ទុំ' is pragmatically appropriate for 'người cao tuổi'. It carries a respectful and culturally natural sense of elders/senior community members. There are no inappropriate pronouns or honorific mismatches. The wording is suitable for a question about ceremonial or festival preparation.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliteration or hallucinated lexical items are present. label: ដូចនេះ យើងអាចនិយាយបានថា ការត្រៀមលក្ខណៈទាំងនេះ មិនត្រឹមតែមានអត្ថន័យខាងផ្លូវចិត្តប៉ុណ្ណោះទេ ថែមទាំងភ្ជាប់ទំនាក់ទំនងសហគមន៍ទៀតផង?
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ៊ីចឹង អាចនិយាយបានថា ការត្រៀមរៀបចំទាំងនេះ មានទាំងអត្ថន័យខាងជំនឿផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ ហើយក៏ជួយចងភ្ជាប់សហគមន៍ឲ្យសាមគ្គីគ្នាដែរ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Như vậy, chúng ta có thể nói rằng những sự chuẩn bị này không chỉ có ý nghĩa về mặt tinh thần, mà còn góp phần gắn kết các mối quan hệ cộng đồng nữa phải không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the Vietnamese source meaning. “Như vậy” is rendered naturally as “អ៊ីចឹង,” and “có thể nói” as “អាចនិយាយបានថា.” “Những chuẩn bị này” is correctly translated as “ការត្រៀមរៀបចំទាំងនេះ.” The paired structure “vừa mang ý nghĩa tâm linh vừa gắn kết cộng đồng” is well represented by “មានទាំងអត្ថន័យខាងជំនឿផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ ហើយក៏ជួយចងភ្ជាប់សហគមន៍ឲ្យសាមគ្គីគ្នាដែរ.” The addition of “ឲ្យសាមគ្គីគ្នា” slightly explicates the idea of community cohesion but does not distort the meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: No problematic pronouns or kinship terms appear. The omission of an explicit subject equivalent to Vietnamese impersonal “có thể nói” is natural in Khmer. The wording is pragmatically appropriate for a neutral question about cultural or spiritual community practices.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer vocabulary. “អ៊ីចឹង,” “ការត្រៀមរៀបចំ,” “ជំនឿ,” “ផ្លូវវិញ្ញាណ,” “ចងភ្ជាប់,” “សហគមន៍,” and “សាមគ្គី” are valid and contextually appropriate. No suspicious false transliteration or hallucinated Khmer forms are present. The localized dictionary entries do not introduce any conflicting interpretation.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well formed and fluent. The structure “មានទាំង... ហើយក៏...ដែរ” naturally expresses the Vietnamese correlative pattern “vừa...vừa.” Word order is idiomatic, and the final question marker is preserved through the interrogative punctuation and sentence form.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation that preserves the source’s semantic content, pragmatic neutrality, and rhetorical question form. It is slightly more elaborative than the source by adding the notion of unity, but this remains consistent with “gắn kết cộng đồng.” Overall, it is natural, accurate, and lexically legitimate.

per_sample.text: Đúng vậy, đó là khoảng thời gian quan trọng để mỗi người Khmer hướng về cội nguồn, cùng nhau giữ gìn và truyền lại cho thế hệ sau.
label: ត្រូវហើយ នេះគឺជាពេលវេលាដ៏សំខាន់មួយដែលជនជាតិខ្មែរម្នាក់ៗនឹកដល់ឫសគល់ រួមគ្នាថែរក្សា និងបន្តទៅដល់មនុស្សជំនាន់ក្រោយ។
per_sample.topic: Traditions leading up to religious holidays
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: មែនហើយ នោះជាពេលវេលាសំខាន់សម្រាប់ឲ្យកូនខ្មែរគ្រប់រូបងាកមករកឫសគល់ រួមគ្នាថែរក្សា ហើយបន្តផ្ទេរឲ្យកូនចៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đúng vậy, đây là một thời khắc quan trọng để mỗi người Khmer nhớ về cội nguồn, cùng nhau gìn giữ và truyền lại cho các thế hệ mai sau.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the source meaning: “Đúng vậy” is rendered as “មែនហើយ,” “khoảng thời gian quan trọng” as “ពេលវេលាសំខាន់,” and the purpose clause about every Khmer person turning toward their roots, preserving, and passing on to later generations is faithfully transferred. “កូនខ្មែរគ្រប់រូប” is slightly more affective/communal than the neutral “mỗi người Khmer,” but it remains semantically appropriate. “បន្តផ្ទេរឲ្យកូនចៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ” adequately expresses “truyền lại cho thế hệ sau.”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns. The phrase “កូនខ្មែរគ្រប់រូប” is pragmatically acceptable as an idiomatic/affective way to refer to members of the Khmer community, though somewhat more emotive than the source. “កូនចៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ” is also appropriate for later generations/descendants.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and not a false transliteration. The term “ឫសគល់” is appropriate for “cội nguồn,” and the dictionary context confirms “គល់” as meaning “gốc/root.” Other words such as “ថែរក្សា,” “បន្ត,” and “ផ្ទេរ” are valid lexical choices.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and flows naturally overall. The construction “សម្រាប់ឲ្យ...” is acceptable, though slightly less polished than the reference’s relative-clause structure. “បន្តផ្ទេរ” is understandable and grammatically valid, but a more idiomatic rendering might use a verb closer to “បន្ត/ផ្ទេរបន្ត/បន្សល់ទុក” depending on style.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation with full preservation of the core meaning and no serious lexical or grammatical issues. Minor stylistic differences exist, especially the more affective “កូនខ្មែរ” and the slightly mechanical “បន្តផ្ទេរ,” but these do not significantly affect comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Phỏng vấn viên: Chào anh, anh có thể chia sẻ về cách người Khmer gọi và giữ quan hệ với các thành viên trong đại gia đình không ạ?
label: ជំរាបសួរ​បង តើ​បង​អាច​ជួយ​ចែករំលែក​អំពី​របៀប​ដែល​ជនជាតិ​ខ្មែរ​ហៅ​និង​រក្សា​ទំនាក់ទំនង​ជាមួយ​សមាជិក​ក្នុង​គ្រួសារ​ធំ​បាន​ទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ជម្រាបសួរបង បងអាចចែករំលែកពីរបៀបដែលអ្នកខ្មែរហៅគ្នា និងរក្សាទំនាក់ទំនងជាមួយសមាជិកក្នុងគ្រួសារធំបានអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Chào anh/chị, anh/chị có thể chia sẻ về cách người Khmer xưng hô và duy trì mối quan hệ với các thành viên trong đại gia đình được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the core meaning of the Vietnamese source. It preserves the interviewer label, greeting, address to an older male/older sibling figure, the request to share, and the topic: how Khmer people address each other and maintain relationships with members of the extended family. The phrase 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is semantically equivalent to 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ' in this context, and 'ហៅគ្នា' reasonably conveys 'gọi' as reciprocal forms of address. No major information is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of 'បង' appropriately renders Vietnamese 'anh' in an interview context and maintains respectful familiarity. 'ជម្រាបសួរ' is also a polite greeting. However, the final question particle 'បានអត់?' is more colloquial and less deferential than the Vietnamese polite ending 'không ạ' and the reference's 'បានទេ'. This slightly weakens the politeness/register alignment, though it remains understandable and socially acceptable in many spoken contexts.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and not a false transliteration. Terms such as 'អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍', 'ចែករំលែក', 'ទំនាក់ទំនង', 'សមាជិក', and 'គ្រួសារធំ' are standard and appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any issue requiring penalty; the hypothesis uses the standard form 'គ្រួសារ', which is valid for 'family'. No hallucinated or fake lexical items are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The structure 'បងអាចចែករំលែកពីរបៀបដែល...' is idiomatic and clear. Word order is appropriate, and coordination between 'ហៅគ្នា' and 'រក្សាទំនាក់ទំនង' is smooth. Minor spacing differences such as 'ជម្រាបសួរបង' do not significantly affect readability or grammaticality.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is strong and faithful to the Vietnamese source. It preserves the interviewer role, respectful address, topic, and communicative intent. The only notable issue is the slightly informal question ending 'បានអត់?' compared with the polite Vietnamese 'không ạ', which affects pragmatic register more than semantic accuracy. Lexically and syntactically, the hypothesis is natural and legitimate.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Dạ, trong văn hóa Khmer, dù là họ hàng xa hay người có ơn nghĩa, chúng tôi đều có cách xưng hô riêng để thể hiện sự kính trọng.
label: បាទ ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ មិនថាជាសាច់ញាតិឆ្ងាយ ឬអ្នកដែលមានគុណ យើងខ្ញុំក៏តែងមានរបៀបហៅ ដើម្បីបង្ហាញពីការគោរព។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ ចា៎ ក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ ទោះជាសាច់ញាតិឆ្ងាយ ឬអ្នកមានគុណក៏ដោយ យើងខ្ញុំសុទ្ធតែមានរបៀបហៅគ្នាដោយឡែក ដើម្បីបង្ហាញការគោរព។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dạ, trong văn hóa Khmer, dù là bà con xa hay những người có ơn, chúng tôi cũng luôn có cách xưng hô để thể hiện sự kính trọng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the source meaning. It preserves the key ideas: in Khmer culture, whether the person is a distant relative or someone to whom one owes gratitude, there are distinct forms of address used to show respect. The phrase “របៀបហៅគ្នាដោយឡែក” effectively conveys 'cách xưng hô riêng', and “ដើម្បីបង្ហាញការគោរព” correctly renders 'to show respect'.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun “យើងខ្ញុំ” is appropriate for 'chúng tôi' and conveys respectful collective self-reference. The polite response “ចា៎” corresponds to Vietnamese “Dạ”; while the reference uses “បាទ”, “ចា៎” is still a legitimate polite acknowledgment form, especially depending on speaker identity or regional usage. No serious pragmatic mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: “វប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ”, “សាច់ញាតិឆ្ងាយ”, “អ្នកមានគុណ”, “របៀបហៅគ្នាដោយឡែក”, and “ការគោរព” are all valid and semantically suitable. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic regional misuse.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and natural in Khmer. The concessive structure “ទោះជា ... ក៏ដោយ” is correctly used, and the overall word order flows smoothly. The addition of “សុទ្ធតែ” is natural for emphasizing 'đều'.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is highly faithful to the source and very close to the human reference. It preserves meaning, respectful tone, and cultural-pragmatic intent. Minor variation such as “ចា៎” instead of “បាទ” is acceptable and does not materially reduce quality.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Anh chị em họ – tức con của cô, dì, chú, bác – nếu lớn tuổi hơn thì gọi là “bong”, nhỏ hơn gọi “oun”, giống như ruột thịt.
label: បងប្អូនជីដូនមួយ (កូនរបស់មីង មា ពូ អ៊ុំ) បើពួកគេចាស់ជាង គេហៅថា "បង" ហើយបើពួកគេក្មេងជាង គេហៅថា "អូន" ដូចបងប្អូនបង្កើតដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្មែរ៖ បងប្អូនជីដូនមួយ — គឺកូនរបស់មីង ពូ អ៊ំ — បើអាយុច្រើនជាងហៅថា “បង” បើអាយុតិចជាងហៅថា “អូន” ដូចជាបងប្អូនបង្កើតដែរ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Anh chị em họ (con của cô, dì, chú, bác, cậu), nếu lớn tuổi hơn thì gọi là “anh/chị”, còn nếu nhỏ tuổi hơn thì gọi là “em”, giống như anh chị em ruột vậy.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main meaning: Khmer cousins are treated like siblings, with older ones called “បង” and younger ones called “អូន.” It also correctly renders “anh chị em họ” as “បងប្អូនជីដូនមួយ.” However, the explanatory kinship list is slightly incomplete: the source lists cô, dì, chú, bác, while the hypothesis gives only “មីង ពូ អ៊ំ,” omitting “មា” as found in the reference. This loses some specificity in the aunt/uncle categories, though the overall intended meaning remains clear.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The kinship terms “បង” and “អូន” are correctly used and match the social hierarchy based on relative age. The use of “បងប្អូនបង្កើត” for close blood siblings is appropriate. No problematic pronoun or honorific misuse is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer, not false transliteration. “គឺ” aligns with the dictionary context as 'là/thì.' Terms such as “បងប្អូនជីដូនមួយ,” “មីង,” “ពូ,” “អ៊ំ,” “បង,” and “អូន” are valid Khmer kinship vocabulary. The form “អ៊ំ” is acceptable as a variant of “អ៊ុំ” and should not be penalized as hallucinated.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and natural overall. The clauses “បើអាយុច្រើនជាងហៅថា...” and “បើអាយុតិចជាងហៅថា...” omit an explicit subject such as “ពួកគេ” or “គេ,” but this is still understandable and acceptable in context. Word order and structure are generally smooth.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is strong and largely faithful, with correct kinship pragmatics and natural Khmer expression. The main issue is the partial omission of the full aunt/uncle kinship list from the source/reference. This is a minor-to-moderate informational loss but does not distort the central message.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Nếu muốn rõ hơn, người Khmer sẽ thêm tên hoặc mô tả quan hệ, như “bong Sitha cháu chú” hay “oun Dara con bác”.
label: បើចង់ឲ្យកាន់តែជាក់លាក់ ខ្មែរនឹងបន្ថែមឈ្មោះ ឬពណ៌នាអំពីទំនាក់ទំនង ដូចជា "បងស៊ីថាក្មួយពូ" ឬ "អូនតារាកូនធំ" ជាដើម។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្មែរ៖ បើចង់ឲ្យច្បាស់ជាងនេះ ខ្មែរគេនឹងថែមឈ្មោះ ឬប្រាប់ទំនាក់ទំនងសាច់ញាតិ ដូចជា “បង ស៊ីថា ក្មួយពូ” ឬ “អូន ដារ៉ា កូនអ៊ំ”។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nếu muốn nói cụ thể hơn, người Khmer sẽ thêm tên hoặc mô tả mối quan hệ, chẳng hạn như “anh Sitha, cháu của chú” hoặc “em Tara, con lớn”, v.v.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the main informational content of the Vietnamese source: if greater clarity is desired, Khmer speakers add a name or state/describe the kinship relationship, with examples involving 'bong Sitha' and 'oun Dara'. The rendering of 'mô tả quan hệ' as 'ប្រាប់ទំនាក់ទំនងសាច់ញាតិ' is slightly more specific, focusing on kinship relationships, but this is fully consistent with the examples. The phrase 'កូនអ៊ំ' for Vietnamese 'con bác' is semantically appropriate, since 'bác' refers to an older parental sibling and Khmer 'អ៊ំ' is a suitable equivalent.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The kinship and social-pragmatic terms are handled well. 'bong' is rendered as 'បង' and 'oun' as 'អូន', both appropriate Khmer kinship/pronominal terms. 'cháu chú' is rendered as 'ក្មួយពូ', which correctly reflects the relationship to a paternal uncle. The construction "ចេះចាំគុណ" is understandable and natural enough, though slightly less standard than "ចេះដឹងគុណ" or "ដឹងគុណ." Overall fluency is strong.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with faithful meaning, appropriate pronoun use, legitimate Khmer vocabulary, and natural syntax. Minor shifts such as rendering "con" as "កូនចៅ" and "lễ vật" as "គ្រឿងសក្ការៈ" do not significantly affect the meaning.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Ngoài ra còn có người kết nghĩa – không có quan hệ máu mủ nhưng thân thiết như ruột thịt, thường gọi nhau bằng “bong” hay “oun” tùy vai vế.
label: ក្រៅពីនោះក៏មានអ្នកចងសម្ពន្ធមិត្ត មិនទាក់ទងនឹងសាច់ញាតិទេ តែស្និទ្ធស្នាលដូចសាច់ញាតិ ដែលច្រើនតែហៅគ្នាថា «បង» ឬ «អូន» អាស្រ័យលើខ្សែញាតិ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ ក្រៅពីនេះ ក៏មានអ្នករាប់អានគ្នាជាបងប្អូនធម៌ — អត់ជាប់សាច់ឈាមគ្នាទេ តែស្និទ្ធស្នាលដូចបងប្អូនបង្កើត ហើយធម្មតាហៅគ្នាថា “បង” ឬ “អូន” ទៅតាមវ័យវឌ្ឍនៈ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài ra, còn có những người kết nghĩa, không có quan hệ họ hàng nhưng thân thiết như ruột thịt, thường gọi nhau là “anh/chị” hoặc “em” tùy theo vai vế.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the main meaning accurately: it identifies Khmer people, adds that there are non-blood-related fictive/sworn kin, describes them as close like biological family, and preserves the terms “បង” and “អូន”. The phrase “អ្នករាប់អានគ្នាជាបងប្អូនធម៌” is an appropriate rendering of “người kết nghĩa”. “អត់ជាប់សាច់ឈាមគ្នាទេ” corresponds well to “không có quan hệ máu mủ”. A minor semantic issue is “ទៅតាមវ័យវឌ្ឍនៈ” for “tùy vai vế”: it captures age/seniority to some extent, but does not fully express social/kinship role or relative status.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The kinship/pronominal terms “បង” and “អូន” are correctly retained and pragmatically appropriate. The hypothesis correctly frames their usage as dependent on relative positioning, though “វ័យវឌ្ឍនៈ” narrows this mainly to age/development rather than broader “vai vế” or kinship hierarchy. Still, the core pragmatic distinction between elder/younger address is preserved.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary is evident. “រាប់អានគ្នា” is a legitimate Khmer expression meaning to associate with, value, or maintain close relations, and in context works well despite the dictionary listing “រាប់” separately with another regional meaning. “បងប្អូនធម៌”, “សាច់ឈាម”, “បងប្អូនបង្កើត”, “បង”, and “អូន” are legitimate Khmer lexical items. “វ័យវឌ្ឍនៈ” is somewhat awkward in this collocation but not fake.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally fluent and understandable in Khmer. The structure flows naturally: topic marker, addition, explanation of non-blood relation, comparison, and naming practice. The use of “អត់” is colloquial but acceptable. The only notable weakness is the somewhat unnatural/formal phrase “ទៅតាមវ័យវឌ្ឍនៈ”, which is less idiomatic than alternatives such as “ទៅតាមវ័យ” or “ទៅតាមឋានៈ/ខ្សែញាតិ”.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a strong translation with accurate core meaning and legitimate Khmer vocabulary. It slightly weakens the nuance of “vai vế” by rendering it as age/development rather than broader social or kinship rank, and this also introduces mild stylistic awkwardness. However, the translation remains clear, faithful, and pragmatically appropriate.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Tất cả những cách xưng hô và mối quan hệ này đều giúp giữ gìn nền tảng đạo đức và sự gắn kết cộng đồng Khmer từ đời này sang đời khác.
label: ពាក្យហៅ និងការទំនាក់ទំនងទាំងអស់នេះ ជួយរក្សានូវមូលដ្ឋានសីលធម៌ និងសាមគ្គីភាពនៃសហគមន៍ខ្មែរពីមួយជំនាន់ទៅមួយជំនាន់។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ របៀបហៅគ្នា និងទំនាក់ទំនងទាំងអស់នេះ សុទ្ធតែជួយរក្សាគ្រឹះសីលធម៌ និងការរួបរួមសាមគ្គីក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ ពីជំនាន់មួយទៅជំនាន់មួយ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Những cách xưng hô và các mối quan hệ này giúp gìn giữ nền tảng đạo đức và sự đoàn kết của cộng đồng Khmer từ thế hệ này sang thế hệ khác.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately transfers the source meaning. “អ្នកខ្មែរ៖” reflects the source label “Người Khmer:”. “របៀបហៅគ្នា និងទំនាក់ទំនងទាំងអស់នេះ” conveys “tất cả những cách xưng hô và mối quan hệ này,” and “សុទ្ធតែជួយរក្សាគ្រឹះសីលធម៌” correctly renders “đều giúp giữ gìn nền tảng đạo đức.” “ការរួបរួមសាមគ្គីក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ” captures the idea of community cohesion/solidarity, and “ពីជំនាន់មួយទៅជំនាន់មួយ” accurately expresses “từ đời này sang đời khác.” No substantive information is omitted or distorted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or socially sensitive kinship/honorific forms in this sentence. The phrase “របៀបហៅគ្នា” is pragmatically appropriate for ways of address among people. “អ្នកខ្មែរ” is an acceptable rendering of “Người Khmer” as a community label.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer, not false transliteration. Terms such as “របៀប,” “ទំនាក់ទំនង,” “គ្រឹះសីលធម៌,” “ការរួបរួមសាមគ្គី,” and “សហគមន៍ខ្មែរ” are standard and semantically appropriate. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any suspicious or hallucinated form; notably, “របៀប” should not be confused with the listed entry “រប.”
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and natural in Khmer. Word order and clause sequencing are fluent: topic label, coordinated noun phrase, universal quantifier “សុទ្ធតែ,” verb phrase, and generational time expression. The phrase “ក្នុងសហគមន៍ខ្មែរ” is natural and preserves the intended relation to community cohesion.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is highly accurate, fluent, and lexically legitimate. It preserves all key semantic components of the Vietnamese source and uses appropriate Khmer phrasing. Any differences from the human reference are stylistic rather than errors.

per_sample.text: Phỏng vấn viên: Cảm ơn anh đã chia sẻ những điều rất sâu sắc về cách người Khmer gìn giữ mối quan hệ đại gia đình một cách đầy nhân văn!
label: អរគុណបងដែលបានចែករំលែកការយល់ដឹងដ៏ជ្រាលជ្រៅអំពីរបៀបដែលប្រជាជនខ្មែររក្សាទំនាក់ទំនងគ្រួសារឱ្យកាន់តែទូលំទូលាយតាមរបៀបមនុស្សធម៌!
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ អរគុណបង ដែលបានចែករំលែករឿងដ៏ជ្រាលជ្រៅណាស់ អំពីរបៀបដែលបងប្អូនខ្មែររក្សាចំណងទាក់ទងក្នុងគ្រួសារធំ ដោយពោរពេញដោយមនុស្សធម៌!
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Cảm ơn anh/chị đã chia sẻ những hiểu biết sâu sắc về cách người Khmer gìn giữ và mở rộng các mối quan hệ gia đình một cách nhân văn!

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: the interviewer thanks the addressee for sharing profound insights/things about how Khmer people maintain extended-family relationships in a humane way. The inclusion of “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖” accurately reflects the source speaker label. “រឿងដ៏ជ្រាលជ្រៅណាស់” conveys 'very profound things,' though it is slightly less precise and less formal than the reference’s “ការយល់ដឹងដ៏ជ្រាលជ្រៅ” for 'deep insights/understanding.' “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ” is acceptable for 'người Khmer,' though it carries a more fraternal/community tone than the neutral “ប្រជាជនខ្មែរ.” Overall informational fidelity is strong with only minor nuance shifts.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The Vietnamese pronoun “anh” is appropriately rendered as “បង,” which is pragmatically suitable in Khmer for respectfully addressing an older male or socially senior interlocutor in a warm conversational context. The phrase “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ” is also socially natural as a community-oriented expression, though slightly more intimate than the neutral 'Khmer people.' No serious pronoun or hierarchy mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary: “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍,” “ចែករំលែក,” “ជ្រាលជ្រៅ,” “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ,” “រក្សាចំណងទាក់ទង,” “គ្រួសារធំ,” and “មនុស្សធម៌” are all valid lexical choices. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated forms. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic regional item here; none of the unusual dictionary entries are misused in the hypothesis.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and flows naturally overall. The structure follows Khmer discourse conventions well: speaker label, thanks, relative clause, and explanatory phrase. Minor stylistic awkwardness appears in “រឿងដ៏ជ្រាលជ្រៅណាស់,” which is understandable but slightly less elegant than a noun like “ការយល់ដឹង” or “គំនិត.” “ដោយពោរពេញដោយមនុស្សធម៌” is acceptable and natural enough, though somewhat emphatic. Overall fluency is good.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation that accurately conveys the source message with appropriate address terms and legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor semantic and stylistic issues include the less precise rendering of 'deep insights' as 'deep stories/things' and the more colloquial/community-oriented “បងប្អូនខ្មែរ” for 'Khmer people.' These do not substantially harm comprehension or fidelity.

per_sample.text: Anh có thể chia sẻ về những hoạt động giải trí truyền thống của người Khmer gắn liền với đời sống tinh thần không?
label: បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពីសកម្មភាពកម្សាន្តប្រពៃណីរបស់ជនជាតិខ្មែរដែលជាប់ទាក់ទងនឹងជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្តបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: បងអាចចែករំលែកពីការលេងកម្សាន្តបែបប្រពៃណីរបស់បងប្អូនខ្មែរ ដែលជាប់ទាក់ទងនឹងជីវភាពផ្លូវចិត្តបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Anh/chị có thể chia sẻ về các hoạt động giải trí truyền thống của người Khmer gắn liền với đời sống tinh thần không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: asking whether the addressee can share about traditional Khmer entertainment/recreational practices connected to spiritual or mental life. The phrase "ការលេងកម្សាន្តបែបប្រពៃណី" conveys traditional recreational play/entertainment, which is close to "những hoạt động giải trí truyền thống," though slightly narrower than the broader "activities." "បងប្អូនខ្មែរ" is an acceptable rendering of the Khmer people/community, though less formal than "ជនជាតិខ្មែរ." The main semantic weakness is "ជីវភាពផ្លូវចិត្ត," which is understandable but less precise/natural for "đời sống tinh thần" than "ជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្ត" or a more idiomatic equivalent.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of "បង" for Vietnamese "Anh" is pragmatically appropriate and matches the respectful/familiar second-person address used in the source and reference. There is no inappropriate shift in social hierarchy or politeness. "បងប្អូនខ្មែរ" functions as a community-oriented expression and is acceptable in this context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. "ចែករំលែក," "លេងកម្សាន្ត," "បែបប្រពៃណី," and "ជាប់ទាក់ទង" are valid expressions, not false transliterations. Although the localized dictionary lists regional forms related to entertainment such as "រំសានៅ/រមោនៅ," the use of standard "កម្សាន្ត" is also legitimate and should not be penalized. No hallucinated or fake phonetic copying is evident.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically coherent and follows natural Khmer question structure: "បងអាច...បានទេ?" The relative clause "ដែលជាប់ទាក់ទងនឹង..." is also well formed. Minor fluency issues arise from the collocation "ជីវភាពផ្លូវចិត្ត," which sounds less idiomatic than "ជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្ត" for spiritual/mental life, and "ការលេងកម្សាន្ត" may sound somewhat narrower than "សកម្មភាពកម្សាន្ត." Overall, the sentence remains fluent and understandable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is generally accurate, natural, and lexically legitimate. It successfully conveys the intended question and uses appropriate address forms. Minor issues involve semantic narrowing of "activities" to "play/recreation" and the less idiomatic phrase "ជីវភាពផ្លូវចិត្ត" for "đời sống tinh thần." These do not seriously impair comprehension.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer chúng tôi có nhiều hình thức giải trí độc đáo, kết hợp giữa âm nhạc, trò chơi dân gian và lễ hội cộng đồng.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរយើងមានទម្រង់កម្សាន្តពិសេសជាច្រើន ដែលផ្សំគ្នារវាងតន្ត្រី ល្បែងប្រជាប្រិយ និងពិធីបុណ្យសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្មែរយើងខ្ញុំមានបែបបទកម្សាន្តប្លែកៗជាច្រើន ដែលលាយបញ្ចូលគ្នារវាងភ្លេង ល្បែងប្រជាប្រិយ និងបុណ្យភូមិស្រុក។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer chúng ta có nhiều hình thức giải trí đặc sắc, kết hợp giữa âm nhạc, trò chơi dân gian và các lễ hội cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source: Khmer people have many distinctive forms of entertainment combining music, folk/popular games, and communal festivals. “បែបបទកម្សាន្តប្លែកៗជាច្រើន” adequately conveys “nhiều hình thức giải trí độc đáo,” though “ប្លែកៗ” is slightly less precise than “ពិសេស/độc đáo” and can mean unusual or different rather than uniquely distinctive. “លាយបញ្ចូលគ្នា” accurately renders “kết hợp.” “ភ្លេង” is acceptable for music, though slightly more colloquial than “តន្ត្រី.” “បុណ្យភូមិស្រុក” conveys local/village community festivals, which is close to “lễ hội cộng đồng,” though it narrows the meaning somewhat from general community festivals to village/local festivals.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: “ខ្មែរយើងខ្ញុំ” is pragmatically appropriate for “Người Khmer chúng tôi.” The form “យើងខ្ញុំ” is a respectful/humble first-person plural expression and fits the inclusive community self-reference. The omission of “ជនជាតិ” does not create a major pragmatic or referential problem because “ខ្មែរ” alone naturally denotes Khmer people in context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of false phonetic copying from Vietnamese. “កម្សាន្ត,” “បែបបទ,” “លាយបញ្ចូល,” “ភ្លេង,” “ល្បែងប្រជាប្រិយ,” and “បុណ្យភូមិស្រុក” are authentic and natural. The localized dictionary lists regional equivalents for entertainment such as “រមោនៅ/រំសានៅ,” but the use of standard “កម្សាន្ត” is valid and should not be penalized. “បុណ្យភូមិស្រុក” is a plausible community/local festival expression rather than a hallucination.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer. The relative clause introduced by “ដែល” is correctly structured, and the coordination with “រវាង ... និង ...” is clear. Word order is natural, and the overall phrasing is fluent. Minor stylistic differences from the reference do not affect grammaticality.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is strong overall, semantically faithful, fluent, and lexically legitimate. Minor semantic narrowing occurs with “បុណ្យភូមិស្រុក” for “lễ hội cộng đồng,” and “ប្លែកៗ” is slightly less exact than “độc đáo,” but these are not serious errors. Pronoun choice and morpho-syntactic structure are highly appropriate.

per_sample.text: Tôi nghe nhiều về nhạc Ngũ âm, anh có thể giới thiệu ý nghĩa và vai trò của loại nhạc này không?
label: ខ្ញុំបានឮច្រើនអំពីភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ ។ បងអាចណែនាំអំពីអត្ថន័យ និងតួនាទីរបស់ភ្លេងនេះបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយច្រើនអំពីភ្លេងង៉ាំ បងអាចណែនាំអំពីអត្ថន័យ និងតួនាទីរបស់ភ្លេងប្រភេទនេះបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Tôi đã nghe nhiều về nhạc Pinpeat (nhạc ngũ âm). Anh/chị có thể giới thiệu về ý nghĩa và vai trò của loại nhạc này được không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the general structure of the request: the speaker has heard a lot about a type of music and asks the addressee to introduce its meaning and role. The phrase "ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយច្រើន" is an acceptable rendering of "Tôi nghe nhiều" though slightly more explicit as 'I hear people talk a lot.' However, the central cultural term "nhạc Ngũ âm" is mistranslated as "ភ្លេងង៉ាំ," which does not convey the intended Khmer traditional musical concept reflected in the reference as "ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ." Because the key referent of the sentence is wrong or unclear, informational fidelity is significantly weakened, though the rest of the sentence remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The pronoun choices are appropriate. "ខ្ញុំ" correctly renders "Tôi," and "បង" is a natural and socially appropriate Khmer/K Khmer Krom form for addressing "anh" in this polite conversational context. There is no pragmatic or hierarchy mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The main lexical problem is "ភ្លេងង៉ាំ." This appears to be a faulty phonetic rendering or hallucinated transliteration of Vietnamese "Ngũ âm" rather than a legitimate Khmer or Khmer Krom musical term. The localized dictionary context does not support "ង៉ាំ" as a valid regional term for this music. In contrast, the human reference uses "ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ," a recognizable Khmer traditional music term. Other vocabulary such as "អត្ថន័យ," "តួនាទី," and "ភ្លេងប្រភេទនេះ" is legitimate and appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and flows naturally in Khmer: "ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយច្រើនអំពី..." and "បងអាចណែនាំអំពីអត្ថន័យ និងតួនាទី...បានទេ?" are syntactically acceptable. The use of "ភ្លេងប្រភេទនេះ" is also natural. The major issue is lexical rather than morpho-syntactic.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is fluent and pragmatically appropriate, and it conveys the general communicative intent of asking for an explanation of a type of music. However, it fails on the most important content term, rendering "nhạc Ngũ âm" as the nonstandard and unsupported "ភ្លេងង៉ាំ" instead of a culturally appropriate Khmer term such as "ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ." This substantially affects semantic fidelity and lexical legitimacy, while grammar and pronoun usage remain strong.

per_sample.text: Nhạc Ngũ âm gồm năm loại nhạc cụ truyền thống, âm thanh kết hợp tạo nên giai điệu thiêng liêng trong lễ hội, múa hát và đời sống tinh thần.
label: ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យមានឧបករណ៍ប្រពៃណីចំនួនប្រាំប្រភេទ សំឡេងដែលផ្សំគ្នាបង្កើតបានជាបទដ៏ពិសិដ្ឋក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យ ច្រៀងរាំ និងជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្ត។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ភ្លេងង៉ាំអ៊ឹម មានឧបករណ៍ភ្លេងប្រពៃណីប្រាំប្រភេទ សំឡេងលាយបញ្ចូលគ្នា បង្កើតជាទំនុកភ្លេងដ៏សក្ការៈ ក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យ រាំច្រៀង និងជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្ត។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Nhạc ngũ âm có năm loại nhạc cụ truyền thống, âm thanh hòa quyện tạo nên những bản nhạc thiêng liêng trong lễ hội, ca múa và đời sống tinh thần.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers most of the propositional content accurately: it states that the music has five types of traditional musical instruments, that the sounds combine together, and that they create a sacred melody in festivals, dancing/singing, and spiritual life. However, the key term 'Nhạc Ngũ âm' is rendered as 'ភ្លេងង៉ាំអ៊ឹម', which appears to be a phonetic transcription of Vietnamese rather than the established Khmer rendering in the reference, 'ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ'. This weakens fidelity for the central cultural term, though the surrounding explanation remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no explicit personal pronouns, kinship terms, or honorific relations in this sentence. The hypothesis does not introduce inappropriate social deixis or hierarchy. The phrasing is neutral and suitable for an informational/cultural description.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The phrase 'ភ្លេងង៉ាំអ៊ឹម' is the main lexical concern. It is not supported by the provided localized dictionary context and looks like a direct phonetic copying of Vietnamese 'Ngũ âm'. By contrast, the human reference uses the culturally appropriate Khmer term 'ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ'. Other lexical choices such as 'ឧបករណ៍ភ្លេងប្រពៃណី', 'សំឡេងលាយបញ្ចូលគ្នា', 'ទំនុកភ្លេង', and 'ជីវិតផ្លូវចិត្ត' are legitimate Khmer expressions. 'ដ៏សក្ការៈ' is understandable for sacred/reverential meaning, though 'ដ៏ពិសិដ្ឋ' would be more exact and natural here.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and fluent in Khmer. Word order is natural: subject plus predicate, followed by explanatory clauses. 'សំឡេងលាយបញ្ចូលគ្នា បង្កើតជា...' is syntactically acceptable, though slightly less polished than the reference's 'សំឡេងដែលផ្សំគ្នាបង្កើតបានជា...'. 'រាំច្រៀង' is acceptable, although the reference order 'ច្រៀងរាំ' may be more conventional. Overall morpho-syntactic flow is good.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is mostly understandable and conveys the main informational content, but it has a notable lexical-cultural problem in the title term, where 'Nhạc Ngũ âm' is transliterated rather than rendered with the appropriate Khmer cultural term. This affects semantic precision and lexical legitimacy more than grammar or pragmatics. Apart from that, the hypothesis is coherent and natural enough.

per_sample.text: Ngoài giá trị tinh thần, nhạc Ngũ âm có được giới trẻ ngày nay duy trì và học tập không?
label: ក្រៅពីតម្លៃខាងផ្លូវចិត្ត តើភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យនៅតែត្រូវបានយុវជនបច្ចុប្បន្នរក្សា និងរៀនសូត្រដែរឬទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ក្រៅពីតម្លៃខាងស្មារតី តើភ្លេងងũអំ ត្រូវបានយុវវ័យសព្វថ្ងៃថែរក្សា និងរៀនសូត្របន្តឬអត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Ngoài giá trị tinh thần, liệu nhạc ngũ âm hiện nay có còn được giới trẻ gìn giữ và học tập nữa không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis conveys the general question structure and most core information: 'besides spiritual value,' 'young people today,' 'maintain/preserve,' and 'continue learning.' However, the culturally central term 'nhạc Ngũ âm' is not properly rendered into Khmer as in the reference 'ភ្លេងពិណពាទ្យ.' Instead, it appears as 'ភ្លេងងũអំ,' a mixed-script phonetic form that does not reliably communicate the intended Khmer traditional music concept to Khmer readers. This significantly weakens informational fidelity for the key subject of the sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or honorifics in this sentence. 'យុវវ័យសព្វថ្ងៃ' is an acceptable rendering of 'giới trẻ ngày nay' / 'young people today.' The social-pragmatic level is neutral and appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The phrase 'ភ្លេងងũអំ' is lexically problematic. It contains the Latin-script Vietnamese diacritic 'ũ' embedded inside Khmer text, indicating a failed or false transliteration rather than a legitimate Khmer or Khmer Krom term. The localized dictionary context does not support this as a valid regional lexical item; 'ង' is listed only as a consonant or with unrelated meanings. Therefore, this is a serious lexical legitimacy issue, especially because it affects the main cultural term of the sentence.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: Apart from the corrupted term 'ងũអំ,' the sentence is mostly grammatical and understandable: 'ក្រៅពីតម្លៃខាងស្មារតី' is acceptable for 'besides spiritual value,' and 'ត្រូវបានយុវវ័យសព្វថ្ងៃថែរក្សា និងរៀនសូត្របន្តឬអត់' forms a natural yes/no question. The use of 'ឬអត់' is colloquial but acceptable. Overall flow is fair to good, though disrupted by the non-Khmer mixed-script term.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is largely understandable in structure and general intent, but it fails on the central lexical item 'nhạc Ngũ âm,' producing a mixed Vietnamese/Khmer pseudo-transliteration rather than a legitimate Khmer rendering. This causes a notable semantic and lexical defect, though pronoun use and general syntax remain acceptable.

per_sample.text: Dù chịu tác động của âm nhạc hiện đại, nhiều thanh niên Khmer vẫn tham gia lớp học để giữ gìn và truyền lại nét văn hóa này.
label: ទោះបីជាទទួលរងឥទ្ធិពលពីតន្ត្រីសម័យទំនើបក៏ដោយ យុវជនខ្មែរជាច្រើននៅតែចូលរួមវគ្គសិក្សាដើម្បីថែរក្សា និងបន្តវប្បធម៌នេះ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ទោះបីត្រូវឥទ្ធិពលពីភ្លេងសម័យថ្មីក៏ដោយ យុវជនខ្មែរក្រោមជាច្រើននាក់នៅតែចូលរួមថ្នាក់រៀន ដើម្បីថែរក្សា និងបន្តបញ្ជូនលក្ខណៈវប្បធម៌នេះទៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dù chịu ảnh hưởng của âm nhạc hiện đại, nhiều thanh niên Khmer vẫn tham gia các lớp học để gìn giữ và tiếp nối nền văn hóa này.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis transfers the main meaning accurately: despite the influence of modern music, many Khmer youths still attend classes in order to preserve and transmit this cultural feature. "ភ្លេងសម័យថ្មី" is an acceptable rendering of "âm nhạc hiện đại," and "ថែរក្សា និងបន្តបញ្ជូនលក្ខណៈវប្បធម៌នេះ" captures "giữ gìn và truyền lại nét văn hóa này." The addition of "ទៅជំនាន់ក្រោយ" makes explicit the implied idea of transmission to later generations and is not harmful. However, "យុវជនខ្មែរក្រោម" narrows "thanh niên Khmer" to Khmer Krom youths, which is an added specificity not present in the source/reference. Also, "ត្រូវឥទ្ធិពលពី" is semantically understandable but less precise than the expected "ទទួលរងឥទ្ធិពលពី" or "រងឥទ្ធិពលពី."
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no personal pronouns or complex honorific relations in this sentence. The subject is rendered as "យុវជនខ្មែរក្រោមជាច្រើននាក់." This is socially and pragmatically coherent, and "ខ្មែរក្រោម" is a legitimate ethnocommunity label, but it introduces a more specific group than the source's general "Khmer youths." No kinship or hierarchy misuse is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical items are legitimate Khmer forms, not false transliterations. "ភ្លេង," "សម័យថ្មី," "ថ្នាក់រៀន," "ថែរក្សា," "បន្តបញ្ជូន," and "លក្ខណៈវប្បធម៌" are valid vocabulary choices. The localized dictionary context does not indicate any problematic hallucinated form here. "ខ្មែរក្រោម" is a real sociolinguistic term and should not be penalized as fake vocabulary, though its semantic specificity is noted under fidelity.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally grammatical and flows naturally. The concessive frame "ទោះបី...ក៏ដោយ" is well formed. The phrase "ត្រូវឥទ្ធិពលពី" is somewhat awkward and less idiomatic than "ទទួលរងឥទ្ធិពលពី" or "រងឥទ្ធិពលពី," creating a minor morpho-syntactic/collocational issue. Otherwise, word order and clause linkage are clear and fluent.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is good and fully understandable, with strong lexical legitimacy and natural structure. The main issues are the slight semantic narrowing from Khmer youths to Khmer Krom youths and the awkward collocation "ត្រូវឥទ្ធិពលពី." These are not severe enough to obscure the meaning, but they prevent a perfect score in semantic fidelity and morpho-syntactic naturalness.

per_sample.text: Về trò chơi dân gian, người Khmer thường tham gia những loại hình nào?
label: ចំពោះល្បែងប្រជាប្រិយ ជនជាតិខ្មែរច្រើនតែលេងប្រភេទអ្វីខ្លះ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: និយាយពីល្បែងប្រជាប្រិយ ខ្មែរយើងធម្មតាចូលរួមលេងល្បែងប្រភេទណាខ្លះ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Đối với các trò chơi dân gian, người Khmer thường chơi những loại nào?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis accurately conveys the core meaning of the Vietnamese source: asking, with respect to folk/traditional games, what types Khmer people usually participate in or play. 'និយាយពីល្បែងប្រជាប្រិយ' is a natural rendering of 'Về trò chơi dân gian', though slightly more colloquial than the reference 'ចំពោះ...'. 'ចូលរួមលេង' captures 'tham gia' plus the game-playing context well. 'ធម្មតា' conveys 'usually/normally', close to 'thường'. The only minor semantic-pragmatic shift is 'ខ្មែរយើង' ('we/our Khmer'), which adds an inclusive speaker stance not explicit in the source.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The source neutrally says 'người Khmer'. The hypothesis uses 'ខ្មែរយើង', meaning 'we Khmer' or 'our Khmer people'. This is acceptable in many Khmer/K Khmer Krom communicative contexts if the speaker identifies with the Khmer community, and it does not distort the main referent. However, it introduces a first-person inclusive nuance absent from the source and reference, so it is slightly less pragmatically neutral.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of false transliteration or hallucinated vocabulary. 'ចូលរួម' and 'លេង' are standard and semantically appropriate for participating in/playing games. The localized dictionary confirms relevant legitimacy for 'ចូល' as 'vào/vô', supporting the compound 'ចូលរួម' as a normal Khmer formation. No unusual regional item requires penalty.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically well-formed and natural: 'និយាយពី...' sets the topic, followed by the subject 'ខ្មែរយើង', frequency adverb 'ធម្មតា', and predicate 'ចូលរួមលេង...'. The phrase 'លេងល្បែងប្រភេទណាខ្លះ' is understandable and fluent, though slightly redundant because both 'លេង' and 'ល្បែង' occur together. Overall syntactic flow is good and idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a strong translation with accurate meaning, natural Khmer grammar, and legitimate vocabulary. Minor issues include the added inclusive pronoun nuance in 'ខ្មែរយើង' and a slightly colloquial/redundant phrasing compared with the reference. These are not serious errors and do not impede comprehension.

per_sample.text: Các trò như kéo co, nhảy bao, đập niêu, hoặc dấu khăn được tổ chức trong lễ hội, vừa vui chơi vừa gắn kết cộng đồng.
label: ល្បែងដូចជាទាញព្រ័ត្រ លោតបាវ វាយឆ្នាំង ឬលាក់កន្សែង ត្រូវបានរៀបចំក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យ ដែលទាំងសប្បាយលេង និងពង្រឹងសាមគ្គីភាពក្នុងសហគមន៍។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ល្បែងដូចជា ទាញព្រ័ត្រ លោតបាវ វាយក្អម ឬលាក់កន្សែង តែងតែមានរៀបចំក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យ ដើម្បីឲ្យអ្នកស្រុកបានសប្បាយផង ហើយរួបរួមគ្នាក្នុងភូមិស្រុកផង។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Các trò chơi như kéo co, nhảy bao bố, đập niêu hay giấu khăn được tổ chức trong các lễ hội, vừa tạo niềm vui giải trí vừa thắt chặt tình đoàn kết trong cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source: traditional games such as tug-of-war, sack jumping, pot-smashing, and hiding the handkerchief are held during festivals and contribute to enjoyment and community bonding. The rendering of “đập niêu” as “វាយក្អម” is semantically acceptable, since ក្អម refers to an earthen jar/pot and is commonly compatible with the traditional pot-smashing game context. There are minor shifts: “តែងតែមានរៀបចំ” adds a habitual sense of “often/always organized,” while the source simply says “are organized.” “ដើម្បីឲ្យអ្នកស្រុក...” frames the result as purpose and narrows “cộng đồng” to “local villagers/community in the village-district,” but the intended communal meaning remains clear.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or honorifics. The use of “អ្នកស្រុក” for local people/villagers is pragmatically appropriate in a festival/community context and does not distort social relations. No inappropriate hierarchy or kinship term is introduced.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All key lexical items are legitimate Khmer: “ល្បែង,” “ទាញព្រ័ត្រ,” “លោតបាវ,” “វាយក្អម,” and “លាក់កន្សែង” are natural and meaningful. “ក្អម” is not a hallucinated transliteration; it is a real Khmer word referring to an earthen jar/pot and is acceptable for the traditional game. The localized dictionary context does not introduce any conflicting evidence, and no fake phonetic copying is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and idiomatic Khmer. The structure “ល្បែងដូចជា ... តែងតែមានរៀបចំក្នុងពិធីបុណ្យ” is understandable and natural, though slightly more habitual than the source. The paired construction “សប្បាយផង ហើយរួបរួមគ្នា...ផង” flows well and appropriately conveys the dual function of entertainment and social bonding.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is strong, natural, and semantically faithful. Minor informational shifts include the addition of habituality, a purpose framing, and a slight narrowing of “community” to local villagers/village-district. These do not significantly impair comprehension or fidelity. Lexically and syntactically, the hypothesis is very good.

per_sample.text: Ý nghĩa lớn nhất của những trò chơi dân gian này theo anh là gì?
